        "revision_id",
        "content_hash_short",
        "content_hash_high",
        "chunk_id",
    )
    includes_model_id = any(isinstance(store, _PerModelEmbeddingRefStore) for store in stores)
    selects = tuple(
        SqlSelect(
            select=SqlSelectList(
                [
                    *(SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(column)) for column in reference_columns),
                    *(
                        [
                            SqlSelectAlias(
                                SqlParam(store.model_id),
                                SqlAliasName("__storage_model_id"),
                            ),
                        ]
                        if isinstance(store, _PerModelEmbeddingRefStore)
                        else []
                    ),
                ],
            ),
            from_=SqlTableIdent(store.table_name),
        )
        for store in stores
    )
    relation_name = SqlTableName(
        f"{str(owner_ref_id).replace('-', '_').replace('.', '_')}_embedding_refs",
    )
    query = selects[0] if len(selects) == 1 else SqlUnionAll(selects)
    return _EmbeddingReferenceRelation(
        name=relation_name,
        query=query,
        includes_model_id=includes_model_id,
    )


def _rows_needing_embeddings_post_op() -> CompiledPostOp:
    """Use the generic structured-array decoder for maintenance rows."""
    return CompiledPostOp.materialize(
        ResultMaterializationSpec(
            behavior=PostOpBehavior.TERMINAL_ARRAY,
            structured_array=StructuredArraySpec(
                StructuredResultSpec(
                    result_cls=RowNeedingEmbedding,
                    fields=(
                        StructuredResultField("source_id", "source_id", ScalarCoercionKind.SYS_ID),
                        StructuredResultField("reason", "reason", ScalarCoercionKind.STR),
                        StructuredResultField(
                            "current_hash",
                            "current_hash",
                            ScalarCoercionKind.STR,
                            required=False,
                        ),
                        StructuredResultField(
                            "stored_hash",
                            "stored_hash",
                            ScalarCoercionKind.STR,
                            required=False,
                        ),
                    ),
                ),
            ),
        ),
    )


class SelectRowsNeedingEmbeddingsStep(ServerPlanStep[list[RowNeedingEmbedding]]):
    """Select bounded embedding maintenance work in SQL."""

    def __init__(self, ref_id: ServerPlanRefId, config: _RowsNeedingEmbeddingsConfig) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self._config = config

    @property
    def level(self) -> int:
        return 0

    def result_cardinality(self) -> Cardinality:
        return Cardinality.MANY

    def is_read_only(self) -> bool:
        return True

    def execution_role(self) -> StepExecutionRole:
        return StepExecutionRole.SQL

    def step_tags(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({"vector_index", "embedding_metadata", "row_discovery", "sql", "terminal"})

    def dependencies(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        dependencies = {str(self._config.source_rows_ref)}
        if isinstance(
            self._config.read_scope,
            _TipEmbeddingReadScope | _HistoryBranchEmbeddingReadScope,
        ):
            dependencies.update(self._config.read_scope.branch_ref.dependencies())
        return frozenset(dependencies)

    def tables_read(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset(
            {
                str(get_table_name(EmbeddingMetadata)),
                *(str(store.table_name) for store in self._config.ref_stores),
            },
        )

    def tables_written(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def compile(self, ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[list[RowNeedingEmbedding]]:
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps._compile_server_ref import lower_scalar_server_ref
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.embedding_auto_queue_intent import (
            _build_embedding_queue_payload_source_rows,
        )
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.base import SqlRenderable
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.infra.expr_primitives import SqlSignedBigIntHex
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.clauses import (
            SqlJoin,
            SqlOrderByItem,
            SqlSelectAlias,
            SqlSelectList,
            SqlSubqueryTableRef,
            SqlTableAlias,
        )
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.enums import BinaryOp, JoinKind, OrderDirection
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_compound import SqlCase, SqlCast, SqlFuncCall, SqlSubquery
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_leaf import SqlColumnRef, SqlInlineLiteral, SqlParam, SqlStar
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_ops import SqlBinaryOp, SqlExists, SqlIsNull, sql_and, sql_or
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.identifiers import SqlTableIdent
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.statements import SqlSelect
        from l1000_schema.column_utils import get_db_column_name
        from l1000_schema.typed_field import SqlCastTargetType
        from l5175_chunking.chunk_model import ChunkId

        source_cte = ctx.cte_refs.get(str(self._config.source_rows_ref))
        if not isinstance(source_cte, CteReference):
            msg = "Embedding staleness selection requires a SQL-visible source relation"
            raise RuntimeError(msg)

        model_type = self._config.model_type
        index_name = self._config.index_name
        source_query = SqlSelect(
            select=SqlSelectList([SqlStar()]),
            from_=SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName(source_cte.ref_id)),
        )
        hash_rows = _build_embedding_queue_payload_source_rows(
            ctx=ctx,
            model_cls=model_type,
            table_name=get_table_name(model_type),
            index_name=SqlIndexName(index_name),
            branch_id=None,
            revision_id=None,
            metadata_ref=None,
            write_source_query=source_query,
            canonical_model_hint=None,
            preserve_rows_without_metadata=True,
            include_vector_lookup=False,
        )

        hash_alias = SqlAliasName("__embedding_staleness_hash")
        hash_table_alias = SqlTableName("__embedding_staleness_hash")
        scope_alias = SqlAliasName("__embedding_staleness_scope")
        ref_alias = SqlAliasName("__embedding_staleness_ref")
        text_type = SqlCastTargetType(base_type="TEXT")
        source_id = SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("source_object_id"), qualifier=hash_alias)
        current_short = SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("content_hash_short"), qualifier=hash_alias)
        current_high = SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("content_hash_high"), qualifier=hash_alias)
        stored_short = SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("content_hash_short"), qualifier=ref_alias)
        stored_high = SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("content_hash_high"), qualifier=ref_alias)

        reference_relation = _build_embedding_reference_relation(
            self.ref_id,
            self._config.ref_stores,
        )

        def ref_table(alias: SqlAliasName) -> SqlRenderable:
            return SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(reference_relation.name), alias)

        joins: list[SqlJoin] = []
        is_versioned = issubclass(model_type, VersionedObjectRow)
        if is_versioned:
            joins.append(
                SqlJoin(
                    JoinKind.INNER,
                    SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName(source_cte.ref_id)), scope_alias),
                    SqlBinaryOp(
                        SqlCast(
                            SqlColumnRef(
                                SqlColumnName(get_db_column_name(model_type, DynamicFieldName("sys_id"))),
                                qualifier=scope_alias,
                            ),
                            text_type,
                        ),
                        BinaryOp.EQ,
                        source_id,
                    ),
                ),
            )

        def branch_scope_condition(
            alias: SqlAliasName,
            branch_ref: ScalarServerRef[BranchId],
        ) -> SqlRenderable:
            return sql_and(
                SqlBinaryOp(
                    SqlCast(SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("branch_id"), qualifier=alias), text_type),
                    BinaryOp.EQ,
                    SqlCast(lower_scalar_server_ref(branch_ref, ctx), text_type),
                ),
                SqlIsNull(SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("revision_id"), qualifier=alias)),
            )

        def ref_scope_conditions(alias: SqlAliasName) -> list[SqlRenderable]:
            conditions: list[SqlRenderable] = [
                SqlBinaryOp(
                    SqlCast(SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("source_id"), qualifier=alias), text_type),
                    BinaryOp.EQ,
                    source_id,
                ),
                SqlBinaryOp(
                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("source_table"), qualifier=alias),
                    BinaryOp.EQ,
                    SqlParam(get_table_name(model_type)),
                ),
                SqlBinaryOp(
                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("field_name"), qualifier=alias),
                    BinaryOp.EQ,
                    SqlParam(index_name),
                ),
                SqlBinaryOp(
                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("chunk_id"), qualifier=alias),
                    BinaryOp.EQ,
                    SqlParam(ChunkId.whole_document()),
                ),
            ]
            if reference_relation.includes_model_id:
                model_hint = SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("model_hint"), qualifier=hash_alias)
                conditions.append(
                    sql_or(
                        SqlIsNull(model_hint),
                        SqlBinaryOp(
                            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("__storage_model_id"), qualifier=alias),
                            BinaryOp.EQ,
                            model_hint,
                        ),
                    ),
                )
            revision_scope = sql_and(
                SqlIsNull(SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("branch_id"), qualifier=alias)),
                SqlBinaryOp(
                    SqlCast(SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("revision_id"), qualifier=alias), text_type),
                    BinaryOp.EQ,
                    SqlCast(
                        SqlColumnRef(
                            SqlColumnName(get_db_column_name(model_type, DynamicFieldName("revision_id"))),
                            qualifier=scope_alias,
                        ),
                        text_type,
                    ),
                ),
            )
            match self._config.read_scope:
                case _UnversionedEmbeddingReadScope():
                    conditions.extend(
                        [
                            SqlIsNull(SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("branch_id"), qualifier=alias)),
                            SqlIsNull(SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("revision_id"), qualifier=alias)),
                        ],
                    )
                case _TipEmbeddingReadScope(branch_ref=branch_ref):
                    conditions.append(branch_scope_condition(alias, branch_ref))
                case _HistoryBranchEmbeddingReadScope(branch_ref=branch_ref):
                    conditions.append(
                        sql_or(
                            branch_scope_condition(alias, branch_ref),
                            revision_scope,
                        ),
                    )
                case _HistoryRevisionEmbeddingReadScope():
                    conditions.append(revision_scope)
            return conditions

        representative_alias = SqlAliasName("__embedding_staleness_representative_ref")
        representative_ref = SqlSubquery(
            SqlSelect(
                select=SqlSelectList(
                    [SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id"), qualifier=representative_alias)],
                ),
                from_=ref_table(representative_alias),
                where=sql_and(*ref_scope_conditions(representative_alias)),
                order_by=[
                    SqlOrderByItem(
                        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id"), qualifier=representative_alias),
                        OrderDirection.ASC,
                    ),
                ],
                limit=1,
            ),
        )
        ref_conditions = ref_scope_conditions(ref_alias)
        ref_conditions.append(
            SqlBinaryOp(
                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id"), qualifier=ref_alias),
                BinaryOp.EQ,
                representative_ref,
            ),
        )
        joins.append(
            SqlJoin(
                JoinKind.LEFT,
                ref_table(ref_alias),
                sql_and(*ref_conditions),
            ),
        )

        any_ref_alias = SqlAliasName("__embedding_staleness_any_ref")
        any_ref_query = SqlSelect(
            select=SqlSelectList([SqlInlineLiteral(1)]),
            from_=ref_table(any_ref_alias),
            where=sql_and(*ref_scope_conditions(any_ref_alias)),
        )
        any_ref_exists = SqlExists(any_ref_query)
        current_ref_alias = SqlAliasName("__embedding_staleness_current_ref")
        current_ref_conditions = ref_scope_conditions(current_ref_alias)
        current_ref_conditions.extend(
            [
                SqlBinaryOp(
                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("content_hash_short"), qualifier=current_ref_alias),
                    BinaryOp.EQ,
                    current_short,
                ),
                SqlBinaryOp(
                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("content_hash_high"), qualifier=current_ref_alias),
                    BinaryOp.EQ,
                    current_high,
                ),
            ],
        )
        current_ref_query = SqlSelect(
            select=SqlSelectList([SqlInlineLiteral(1)]),
            from_=ref_table(current_ref_alias),
            where=sql_and(*current_ref_conditions),
        )
        missing = SqlExists(any_ref_query, negated=True)
        current_hash_unavailable = sql_or(SqlIsNull(current_short), SqlIsNull(current_high))
        stale = sql_and(
            any_ref_exists,
            sql_or(
                current_hash_unavailable,
                SqlExists(current_ref_query, negated=True),
            ),
        )
        where = sql_or(missing, stale) if self._config.include_stale else missing
        current_hash = SqlFuncCall("CONCAT", [SqlSignedBigIntHex(current_short), SqlSignedBigIntHex(current_high)])
        stored_hash = SqlFuncCall("CONCAT", [SqlSignedBigIntHex(stored_short), SqlSignedBigIntHex(stored_high)])
        grammar = SqlSelect(
            select=SqlSelectList(
                [
                    SqlSelectAlias(source_id, SqlAliasName("source_id")),
                    SqlSelectAlias(
                        SqlCase(whens=[(missing, SqlInlineLiteral("missing"))], else_=SqlInlineLiteral("stale")),
                        SqlAliasName("reason"),
                    ),
                    SqlSelectAlias(
                        SqlCase(
                            whens=[(sql_or(missing, current_hash_unavailable), SqlParam(None))],
                            else_=current_hash,
                        ),
                        SqlAliasName("current_hash"),
                    ),
                    SqlSelectAlias(
                        SqlCase(whens=[(missing, SqlParam(None))], else_=stored_hash),
                        SqlAliasName("stored_hash"),
                    ),
                ],
            ),
            from_=SqlSubqueryTableRef(hash_rows, hash_table_alias),
            joins=joins,
            where=where,
            order_by=[SqlOrderByItem(source_id, OrderDirection.ASC)],
            limit=self._config.limit,
        )
        columns = ("source_id", "reason", "current_hash", "stored_hash")
        output_shape = output_shape_from_mappings(
            tuple((column, column, column in {"current_hash", "stored_hash"}) for column in columns)
        )
        return CompiledStep(
            output_shape=output_shape,
            result_relation=DeclaredResultRelation.from_output_shape(output_shape),
            column_type_hints=SqlColumnTypeHints(text_columns=frozenset(columns)),
            grammar=grammar,
            needs_returning=True,
            closed_post_op=_rows_needing_embeddings_post_op(),
            auxiliary_ctes=[
                *([(source_cte.ref_id, source_cte.auxiliary_query)] if source_cte.auxiliary_query is not None else []),
                (str(reference_relation.name), reference_relation.query),
            ],
        )


def _raise_embedding_maintenance_requires_sql_relation() -> NoReturn:
    msg = (
        "Embedding maintenance row discovery/deletion requires a SQL/ServerPlan relation; "
        "Python post-fetch scanning and per-row delete loops are not supported."
    )
    raise NotImplementedError(msg)


def _embedding_metadata_for_index(
    txn: ReadTransaction,
    *,
    table_name: SqlTableName,
    index_name: str,
) -> EmbeddingMetadata | None:
    rows = _resolve_transaction_lazy_value(
        txn,
        txn.query_lazy(EmbeddingMetadata)
        .filter(
            (field(EmbeddingMetadata.table_name) == table_name) & (field(EmbeddingMetadata.field_name) == index_name),
        )
        .limit(1)
        .execute_lazy(),
    )
    return next(iter(cast("Sequence[EmbeddingMetadata]", rows)), None)


@pure_lazy
def _single_plan_ref[T](lazy: LazyResult[T], *, context: str) -> ServerPlanRefId:
    shape = inspect_server_value_shape_for_planning(lazy, site=context)
    if shape.symbolic_ref_id is None:
        msg = f"{context} requires a plan-backed symbolic result"
        raise RuntimeError(msg)
    return ServerPlanRefId(shape.symbolic_ref_id)


_ALL_EMBEDDING_SOURCE_ROWS: UnownedBooleanPredicate = Expression(value=True)


@pure_lazy
def _embedding_storage_models(
    txn: LazyReadTransaction,
    model_type: type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]],
    index_name: SqlIndexName,
) -> tuple[_EmbeddingStorage, ...]:
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.embedding_store_scope import (
        owned_per_model_embedding_storage,
    )
    from l5200_vector_index.content_addressable_models import (
        get_embedding_classes_for_strategy,
    )
    from vector_types import ContentStoreStrategy

    config = get_vector_config(model_type, index_name)
    if config is None:
        msg = f"{model_type.__name__} has no vector index {index_name!r}"
        raise ValueError(msg)
    strategy = config.content_store_strategy
    match strategy:
        case ContentStoreStrategy.GLOBAL:
            return (_SharedEmbeddingStorage(EmbeddingVector, EmbeddingRef),)
        case ContentStoreStrategy.PER_FIELD:
            vector_model, ref_model = get_embedding_classes_for_strategy(
                strategy,
                source_table_name=get_table_name(model_type),
                field_name=index_name,
            )
            return (_SharedEmbeddingStorage(vector_model, ref_model),)
        case ContentStoreStrategy.PER_MODEL:
            stores_by_model: dict[EmbeddingModelCanonicalId, _PerModelEmbeddingStorage] = {}
            model_by_ref_table: dict[SqlTableName, EmbeddingModelCanonicalId] = {}
            for model_id, vector_model, ref_model in owned_per_model_embedding_storage(
                txn.planning_catalog,
            ):
                canonical_model_id = EmbeddingModelCanonicalId(model_id)
                candidate = _PerModelEmbeddingStorage(
                    canonical_model_id,
                    vector_model,
                    ref_model,
                )
                ref_table_name = SqlTableName(get_table_name(ref_model))
                table_owner = model_by_ref_table.get(ref_table_name)
                if table_owner is not None and table_owner != canonical_model_id:
                    msg = (
                        f"PER_MODEL embedding storage for {model_type.__name__}.{index_name}: "
                        f"identifiers {table_owner!r} and {canonical_model_id!r} resolve "
                        f"to the same reference table {ref_table_name!r}"
                    )
                    raise ValueError(msg)
                model_by_ref_table[ref_table_name] = canonical_model_id
                existing = stores_by_model.get(canonical_model_id)
                if existing is not None and (
                    get_table_name(existing.vector_model) != get_table_name(vector_model)
                    or get_table_name(existing.ref_model) != get_table_name(ref_model)
                ):
                    msg = (
                        f"PER_MODEL embedding storage for {model_type.__name__}.{index_name} "
                        f"and model {canonical_model_id!r} resolves to conflicting physical tables"
                    )
                    raise ValueError(msg)
                stores_by_model[canonical_model_id] = candidate
            stores = tuple(stores_by_model.values())
            if not stores:
                msg = (
                    f"PER_MODEL embedding storage for {model_type.__name__}.{index_name} "
                    "has no complete model stores in the planning catalog"
                )
                raise ValueError(msg)
            return stores
        case _:
            msg = f"Unsupported content store strategy {strategy!r} for {model_type.__name__}.{index_name}"
            raise ValueError(msg)


@pure_lazy
def _embedding_ref_stores(
    txn: LazyReadTransaction,
    model_type: type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]],
    index_name: SqlIndexName,
) -> tuple[_EmbeddingRefStore, ...]:
    stores: list[_EmbeddingRefStore] = []
    for storage in _embedding_storage_models(txn, model_type, index_name):
        table_name = SqlTableName(get_table_name(storage.ref_model))
        if isinstance(storage, _PerModelEmbeddingStorage):
            stores.append(_PerModelEmbeddingRefStore(storage.model_id, table_name))
        else:
            stores.append(_SharedEmbeddingRefStore(table_name))
    return tuple(stores)


@pure_lazy
def get_rows_needing_embeddings_lazy[SourceRowT: DatabaseObjectRow](
    txn: LazyReadTransaction,
    model_type: type[SourceRowT],
    index_name: str | None = None,
    *,
    content_hasher: Callable[[SourceRowT], EmbeddingContentHashHex] | None = None,
    include_stale: bool = True,
    limit: int = 1000,
    source_filter: BooleanPredicate[SourceRowT] | UnownedBooleanPredicate = _ALL_EMBEDDING_SOURCE_ROWS,
) -> LazyResult[list[RowNeedingEmbedding]]:
    """Plan missing and stale work for a filtered source relation.

    The source predicate is part of the typed QuerySpec. The backend applies it
    before hashing, classification, ordering, and limiting. See
    ``docs/design/EMBEDDING_STALENESS_SCAN_ARCHITECTURE.rst``.

    :raises ValueError: If the limit is not positive; the index is absent or
        ambiguous; a custom hasher is supplied; the effective version context
        is incomplete; the source predicate is unsupported; or embedding-store
        resolution is incomplete or conflicting.
    :raises RuntimeError: If the transaction cannot publish the source query as
        a SQL-visible ServerPlan relation.
    """
    if content_hasher is not None:
        msg = "Custom content_hasher cannot be represented in ServerPlan; use the built-in nonce-aware embedding hash."
        raise ValueError(msg)
    if limit <= 0:
        msg = f"limit must be positive, got {limit}"
        raise ValueError(msg)
    _table_name, resolved_index_name = _resolve_vector_index_target(model_type, index_name)
    index_name = SqlIndexName(resolved_index_name)
    config = get_vector_config(model_type, index_name)
    if config is None:
        msg = f"{model_type.__name__} has no vector index {index_name!r}"
        raise ValueError(msg)

    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.intent_query import build_raw_query_relation_intent
    from l1000_schema.large_column import get_large_column_configs, large_column_pointer_name

    query_spec: QuerySpec[SourceRowT] = txn.query_lazy(model_type).filter(source_filter).to_query_spec()
    source_columns = ["sys_id", *get_embedding_source_fields(model_type, index_name)]
    source_columns.extend(
        large_column_pointer_name(config.column) for config in get_large_column_configs(model_type) if config.column in source_columns
    )
    if issubclass(model_type, VersionedObjectRow):
        source_columns.append("revision_id")
    source_rows = enqueue_lazy_plan_intent(
        txn,
        build_raw_query_relation_intent(
            ServerPlanRefId(next_lazy_plan_ref(txn)),
            model_type,
            replace(query_spec, select_columns=list(dict.fromkeys(source_columns))),
        ),
    )

    read_scope: _EmbeddingReadScope = _UnversionedEmbeddingReadScope()
    if issubclass(model_type, VersionedObjectRow):
        from l1400_types.unset import UNSET
        from l7000_versioned_schema.context_refs import (
            get_versioned_lazy_context_refs,
            versioned_lazy_context_branch_ref,
        )

        context_refs = get_versioned_lazy_context_refs(txn)
        if config.indexes_all_revisions and context_refs.branch is UNSET:
            read_scope = _HistoryRevisionEmbeddingReadScope()
        else:
            branch_ref = versioned_lazy_context_branch_ref(
                context_refs,
                context=DiagnosticLabel(
                    f"embedding staleness selection for the effective policy on {model_type.__name__}.{index_name}"
                ),
            )
            read_scope = (
                _HistoryBranchEmbeddingReadScope(branch_ref)
                if config.indexes_all_revisions
                else _TipEmbeddingReadScope(branch_ref)
            )
    return enqueue_lazy_plan_intent(
        txn,
        SelectRowsNeedingEmbeddingsStep(
            ServerPlanRefId(next_lazy_plan_ref(txn)),
            _RowsNeedingEmbeddingsConfig(
                source_rows_ref=_single_plan_ref(
                    source_rows,
                    context="embedding source row lookup",
                ),
                model_type=model_type,
                index_name=index_name,
                ref_stores=_embedding_ref_stores(txn, model_type, index_name),
                include_stale=include_stale,
                limit=limit,
                read_scope=read_scope,
            ),
        ),
    )


@legacy_module_sync(lazy_name="get_rows_needing_embeddings_lazy")
def get_rows_needing_embeddings[SourceRowT: DatabaseObjectRow](
    txn: ReadTransaction,
    model_type: type[SourceRowT],
    index_name: str | None = None,
    *,
    content_hasher: Callable[[SourceRowT], EmbeddingContentHashHex] | None = None,
    include_stale: bool = True,
    limit: int = 1000,
    source_filter: BooleanPredicate[SourceRowT] | UnownedBooleanPredicate = _ALL_EMBEDDING_SOURCE_ROWS,
) -> list[RowNeedingEmbedding]:
    """Get rows that need embedding generation (missing or stale).

    Finds rows in the source table that either:

    1. Have no embedding stored yet (missing)
    2. Have an embedding but content has changed (stale)

    For stale detection, the function uses the workspace nonce to compute
    hashes that match stored references. The deprecated ``content_hasher``
    parameter is retained for call compatibility, but non-null values are rejected.

    Args:
        txn: Read transaction
        model_type: Model class with @vector_indexed
        index_name: Name of the index (required if multiple, optional if single)
        content_hasher: Deprecated compatibility parameter. It must be ``None``.
        include_stale: If True, include rows with stale embeddings (default: True)
        limit: Maximum rows to return (default 1000). The function evaluates
            all selected source rows before it applies this result limit.
        source_filter: Typed predicate applied to the source query before stale
            detection and the result limit.

    Returns:
        List of RowNeedingEmbedding with source IDs and reason

    Raises:
        ValueError: If the limit is not positive; the index is absent or

@pure_lazy
def delete_embeddings_by_algorithm_lazy(
    txn: WriteTransaction | AsyncWriteTransaction,
    model_type: type,
    index_name: str | None = None,
    *,
    algorithm: str | None = None,
) -> LazyResult[int]:
    """Plan deletion of embeddings for a model's vector index."""
    indexes = get_vector_indexes(model_type)
    if not indexes:
        msg = f"{model_type.__name__} has no vector index configured"
        raise ValueError(msg)

    # Auto-select if single index
    if index_name is None:
        if len(indexes) == 1:
            index_name = next(iter(indexes.keys()))
        else:
            index_names = ", ".join(sorted(indexes.keys()))
            msg = f"{model_type.__name__} has multiple vector indexes ({index_names}). Specify which one with index_name='name'."
            raise ValueError(msg)

    config = get_vector_config(model_type, index_name)
    if config is None:
        msg = f"{model_type.__name__} has no vector index '{index_name}'"
        raise ValueError(msg)

    table_name = get_table_name(model_type)
    metadata_lookup = (
        txn.query_lazy(EmbeddingMetadata)
        .filter(
            (field(EmbeddingMetadata.table_name) == table_name) & (field(EmbeddingMetadata.field_name) == index_name),
        )
        .execute_one_lazy()
    )
    algorithm_gate = _validate_embedding_algorithm_delete_lazy(
        txn,
        metadata_lookup,
        algorithm=algorithm,
    )
    storage_models = _embedding_storage_models(
        txn,
        model_type,
        SqlIndexName(index_name),
    )
    deleted_ref_results = tuple(
        txn.query_lazy(storage.ref_model)
        .filter(
            (field(storage.ref_model.source_table) == table_name) & (field(storage.ref_model.field_name) == index_name),
        )
        .delete_after_lazy(after=(algorithm_gate,))
        for storage in storage_models
    )

    from l5200_vector_index.embedding_vector_store import EmbeddingVectorStore

    orphan_gc_results = tuple(
        EmbeddingVectorStore(
            table_name=table_name,
            field_name=index_name,
            content_store_strategy=config.content_store_strategy,
            model_id=(storage.model_id if isinstance(storage, _PerModelEmbeddingStorage) else None),
        ).garbage_collect_orphaned_embeddings_lazy(
            txn,
            batch_size=None,
            after=deleted_ref_results,
        )
        for storage in storage_models
    )

    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.grammar_plan_types import PlanEffect

    artifact_cleanup_results: tuple[LazyResult[int] | LazyResult[PlanEffect], ...]
    requested_implementation = config.resolved_index_policy.requested_implementation
    if requested_implementation is VectorIndexImplementation.USEARCH:
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.intent_vector_index_maintenance import (
            VectorIndexMaintenanceOperation,
            maintain_vector_index_planned_lazy,
        )
        from l5200_vector_index.hnsw_models import create_usearch_index_class

        usearch_cls = create_usearch_index_class(table_name)
        rebuild = maintain_vector_index_planned_lazy(
            txn,
            model_type,
            index_name,
            VectorIndexMaintenanceOperation.REBUILD,
            SysId.new(),
            after_refs=frozenset(
                collect_plan_ref_dependencies(*deleted_ref_results),
            ),
        ).result
        artifact_delete = (
            txn.query_lazy(usearch_cls)
            .filter(field(usearch_cls.field_name) == index_name)
            .delete_after_lazy(after=(*deleted_ref_results, rebuild))
        )
        artifact_cleanup_results = (artifact_delete, rebuild)
    elif requested_implementation in {
        VectorIndexImplementation.BACKEND_DEFAULT,
        VectorIndexImplementation.SQL_TABLE_HNSW,
    }:
        from l5200_vector_index.hnsw_models import (
            create_hnsw_edge_class,
            create_hnsw_metadata_class,
            create_hnsw_node_class,
        )

        node_cls = create_hnsw_node_class(table_name)
        edge_cls = create_hnsw_edge_class(table_name)
        metadata_cls = create_hnsw_metadata_class(table_name)
        artifact_cleanup_results = (
            txn.query_lazy(node_cls).filter(field(node_cls.field_name) == index_name).delete_after_lazy(after=deleted_ref_results),
            txn.query_lazy(edge_cls).filter(field(edge_cls.field_name) == index_name).delete_after_lazy(after=deleted_ref_results),
            txn.query_lazy(metadata_cls)
            .filter(field(metadata_cls.field_name) == index_name)
            .delete_after_lazy(after=deleted_ref_results),
        )
    else:
        msg = (
            f"Embedding cleanup for {model_type.__name__}.{index_name} does not support "
            f"index implementation {requested_implementation.value!r}"
        )
        raise ValueError(msg)
    metadata_reset = (
        txn.query_lazy(EmbeddingMetadata)
        .filter(
            (field(EmbeddingMetadata.table_name) == table_name) & (field(EmbeddingMetadata.field_name) == index_name),
        )
        .update_after_lazy(
            after=(algorithm_gate, *deleted_ref_results),
            algorithm_established=False,
            provider=None,
            model=None,
            model_ref_id=None,
            model_version=None,
            dimensions=None,
        )
    )
    source_refs = tuple(
        sorted(collect_plan_ref_dependencies(*deleted_ref_results)),
    )
    cleanup_results = (
        *orphan_gc_results,
        *artifact_cleanup_results,
        metadata_reset,
    )
    after_refs = tuple(
        sorted(
            collect_plan_ref_dependencies(*cleanup_results),
        ),
    )
    return enqueue_lazy_plan_intent(
        txn,
        SumIntResultsStep(
            ServerPlanRefId(next_lazy_plan_ref(txn)),
            source_refs=[str(ref_id) for ref_id in source_refs],
            after_refs=after_refs,
        ),
    )

"""Steps for commit_branch: pure SQL, no imperative code.

Each step compiles to a single SQL grammar. The commit_branch operation
is decomposed into:

1.  FetchBranchAndStagedStep — read branch + staged commits
2.  InsertRevisionStep — create revision record
2b. InsertRevisionParentStep — record parent revision linkage
2c. DemoteOldBranchTipAnchorStep — demote old tip anchor to LINEAGE
2d. InsertRevisionBranchIndexStep — anchor new revision to branch
3a. CloseSparseWindowsStep — UPDATE sparse SET valid_to WHERE ...
3b. InsertSparseFromStagedStep — INSERT INTO sparse SELECT FROM staged
3c. UpsertTipFromStagedStep — INSERT INTO tip SELECT FROM staged ON CONFLICT
3d. DeleteTipTombstonesStep — DELETE FROM tip WHERE deleted in staged
3e. DeleteStagedStep — DELETE FROM staged WHERE commit_id
3f. UpdateLogEntriesRevisionStep — stamp log entries with revision_id
4.  UpdateBranchTipStep — UPDATE branches SET tip
5.  CleanupStagedCommitsStep — DELETE FROM staged_commits

Ripple events are enqueued atomically by SQL triggers that fire on
log table INSERTs during staging. Step 3f stamps those log entries
with the published revision_id so downstream consumers can query by it.
"""

class _RevisionIdNotExists(SqlRenderable):
    """Predicate that makes repeated execution of one revision insert idempotent."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        *,
        revision_table: SqlTableName,
        revision_id_column: SqlColumnName,
        revision_id: RevisionId,
    ) -> None:
        self._revision_table = revision_table
        self._revision_id_column = revision_id_column
        self._revision_id = revision_id

    def render(self, dialect: SqlDialect) -> SqlFragment:
        return (
            _SQL_NOT_EXISTS_SELECT_1_FROM
            + SqlQuotedIdentifier(str(self._revision_table)).render(dialect)
            + _SQL_WHERE
            + SqlQuotedIdentifier(str(self._revision_id_column)).render(dialect)
            + _SQL_EQ
            + SqlParam(self._revision_id).render(dialect)
            + _SQL_CLOSE_PAREN
        )

    def render(self: _SqlEqualsAnyArraySubquery, dialect: SqlDialect) -> SqlFragment:
        return self._lhs.render(dialect) + _SQL_EQ_ANY_ARRAY_OPEN + self._subquery.render(dialect) + _SQL_DOUBLE_CLOSE

def _build_staged_commit_subquery(
    staged_commits_table: TableNameInput,
    lazy_branch: BranchRefInput,
    connection_id_raw: ConnectionIdInput,
    ctx: CompilationContext | None = None,
    staged_commit_ids: Sequence[StagedCommitId] = (),
    select_as_proof_observation: bool = False,
    branch_expr_override: SqlRenderable | None = None,
) -> SqlDynamicSelectStmt:
    """Build subquery: SELECT sys_id FROM staged_commits WHERE branch_id=? [AND connection_id=?].

    Used by all per-table commit steps to filter staged data rows
    by their staged_commit_id without materializing the IDs first.
    """

    if ctx is None and _collect_ref_dependencies(lazy_branch):
        msg = "Staged commit subquery requires a CompilationContext for symbolic branch refs"
        raise RuntimeError(msg)
    branch_expr: SqlRenderable
    if branch_expr_override is not None:
        branch_expr = branch_expr_override
    elif ctx is not None and isinstance(lazy_branch, ScalarServerRef):
        shape = inspect_server_value_shape_for_planning(
            lazy_branch,
            site="_build_staged_commit_subquery",
        )
        if shape.symbolic_ref_id is not None:
            found_seed, seed_value = read_seeded_constant_from_ctx(ctx, ServerPlanRefId(shape.symbolic_ref_id))
            if found_seed:
                branch_expr = SqlParam(unwrap_literal_sql_value(seed_value))
            else:
                branch_expr = lower_scalar_source(lazy_branch, ctx)
        else:
            branch_expr = lower_scalar_source(lazy_branch, ctx)
    else:
        branch_value: object = lazy_branch
        if not isinstance(lazy_branch, ServerRef) and not _collect_ref_dependencies(lazy_branch):
            branch_value = str(lazy_branch)
        branch_expr = lower_scalar_source(branch_value, ctx) if ctx is not None else SqlParam(branch_value)
    conditions: list[SqlExpr] = [
        SqlBinaryOp(SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("branch_id")), BinaryOp.EQ, branch_expr),
    ]
    if connection_id_raw is not None:
        conditions.append(
            SqlBinaryOp(
                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("connection_id")),
                BinaryOp.EQ,
                SqlParam(connection_id_raw),
            ),
        )
    if staged_commit_ids:
        conditions.append(
            SqlIn(
                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id")),
                tuple(SqlParam(staged_commit_id) for staged_commit_id in staged_commit_ids),
            ),
        )

    where_expr = conditions[0] if len(conditions) == 1 else sql_and(*conditions)

    return SqlDynamicSelectStmt(
        from_table=SqlTableName(staged_commits_table),
        columns=None if select_as_proof_observation else [SqlColumnName("sys_id")],
        typed_select_clause=(
            SqlSelectList(
                [
                    SqlSelectAlias(
                        SqlParam(PublicationProofSqlRowKind.SELECTED_STAGED_COMMIT.value),
                        SqlAliasName("row_kind"),
                    ),
                    SqlSelectAlias(_publication_proof_null("TEXT"), SqlAliasName("table_name")),
                    SqlSelectAlias(_publication_proof_null("UUID"), SqlAliasName("revision_id")),
                    SqlSelectAlias(_publication_proof_null("TEXT"), SqlAliasName("materialization")),
                    SqlSelectAlias(_publication_proof_null("BOOLEAN"), SqlAliasName("active")),
                    SqlSelectAlias(SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id")), SqlAliasName("staged_commit_id")),
                ],
            )
            if select_as_proof_observation
            else None
        ),
        where_conditions=[where_expr],
    )

def _cleanup_staged_commits_where_expr(
    lazy_branch: BranchRefInput,
    connection_id_raw: ConnectionIdInput,
    staged_commit_ids: Sequence[StagedCommitId],
    ctx: CompilationContext,
) -> SqlRenderable:
    def _cleanup_branch_source(value: BranchRefInput) -> SqlRenderable:
        if isinstance(value, BranchId):
            return SqlParam(value.unwrap_to_str())
        if isinstance(value, ScalarServerRef):
            value_shape = inspect_server_value_shape_for_planning(
                value,
                site="_cleanup_staged_commits_where_expr",
            )
            if value_shape.symbolic_ref_id is not None:
                found, seeded_value = read_seeded_constant_from_ctx(
                    ctx,
                    ServerPlanRefId(value_shape.symbolic_ref_id),
                )
                if found and isinstance(seeded_value, BranchId):
                    return SqlParam(seeded_value.unwrap_to_str())
        return _sql_param_or_cte_scalar(value, ctx)

    branch_condition: SqlRenderable = SqlBinaryOp(
        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("branch_id")),
        BinaryOp.EQ,
        _cleanup_branch_source(lazy_branch),
    )
    staged_ids_condition: SqlRenderable | None = None
    if staged_commit_ids:
        staged_ids_condition = SqlIn(
            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id")),
            tuple(SqlParam(staged_commit_id) for staged_commit_id in staged_commit_ids),
        )
        if connection_id_raw is None:
            branch_condition = sql_and(branch_condition, staged_ids_condition)
    if connection_id_raw is None:
        return branch_condition
    connection_param = connection_id_raw if isinstance(connection_id_raw, ConnectionId) else ConnectionId(str(connection_id_raw))
    connection_condition: SqlRenderable = SqlBinaryOp(
        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("connection_id")),
        BinaryOp.EQ,
        SqlParam(connection_param.unwrap_to_sql()),
    )
    if staged_ids_condition is not None:
        connection_condition = sql_or(connection_condition, staged_ids_condition)
    return sql_and(branch_condition, connection_condition)


def _sql_param_or_cte_scalar(
    value: object,
    ctx: CompilationContext,
) -> SqlRenderable:
    """Render a scalar as a SQL parameter or resolved plan ref."""

    if isinstance(value, LazyResult):
        value_shape: PlanningServerValueShape = inspect_server_value_shape_for_planning(
            value,
            site="_sql_param_or_cte_scalar",
        )
        if value_shape.symbolic_ref_id is not None:
            lazy_ref = ServerRefs.from_ref_id(
                value_shape.symbolic_ref_id,
                variant="scalar",
                type_hint=object,
            )
            binding = get_scalar_server_ref_binding(lazy_ref, ctx)
            if binding is None:
                raise TypeError("Pending LazyResult must carry a SQL-visible binding before SQL lowering")
            return lower_scalar_source(lazy_ref, ctx)
        raise TypeError("Pending LazyResult must carry a step_ref_id before SQL lowering")
    return lower_scalar_source(value, ctx)


def _auxiliary_ctes_for_scalar_refs(
    ctx: CompilationContext,
    *refs: object | None,
) -> list[tuple[str, SqlRenderable]] | None:
    auxiliary_ctes: list[tuple[str, SqlRenderable]] = []
    seen_cte_names: set[str] = set()
    for ref in refs:
        binding = get_scalar_server_ref_binding(ref, ctx) if isinstance(ref, ScalarServerRef) else None
        if binding is None:
            dependency_refs = _collect_ref_dependencies(ref)
            for dependency_ref in dependency_refs:
                cte_ref = ctx.cte_refs.get(dependency_ref)
                if cte_ref is None or cte_ref.auxiliary_query is None:
                    continue
                if str(cte_ref.ref_id) in seen_cte_names:
                    continue
                seen_cte_names.add(str(cte_ref.ref_id))
                auxiliary_ctes.append((cte_ref.ref_id, cte_ref.auxiliary_query))
                break
        if binding is None:
            continue
        found_published_scalar, _published_scalar = _executor_published_mysql_scalar(
            binding,
            ctx,
        )
        if found_published_scalar:
            continue
        for cte_ref in ctx.cte_refs.values():
            if cte_ref.ref_id != binding.cte_name or cte_ref.auxiliary_query is None:
                continue
            if str(cte_ref.ref_id) in seen_cte_names:
                break
            seen_cte_names.add(str(cte_ref.ref_id))
            auxiliary_ctes.append((cte_ref.ref_id, cte_ref.auxiliary_query))
            break
    return auxiliary_ctes or None


def _auxiliary_ctes_for_sources(
    ctx: CompilationContext,
    *source_names: str | None,
) -> list[tuple[str, SqlRenderable]] | None:
    auxiliary_ctes: list[tuple[str, SqlRenderable]] = []
    seen_cte_names: set[str] = set()
    for source_name in source_names:
        if source_name is None:
            continue
        cte_ref = ctx.cte_refs.get(str(source_name))
        if cte_ref is None:
            cte_ref = next(
                (candidate for candidate in ctx.cte_refs.values() if str(candidate.ref_id) == str(source_name)),
                None,
            )
        if cte_ref is None or cte_ref.auxiliary_query is None:
            continue
        if str(cte_ref.ref_id) in seen_cte_names:
            continue
        seen_cte_names.add(str(cte_ref.ref_id))
        auxiliary_ctes.append((cte_ref.ref_id, cte_ref.auxiliary_query))
    return auxiliary_ctes or None


def _combine_auxiliary_ctes(
    *groups: list[tuple[str, SqlRenderable]] | None,
) -> list[tuple[str, SqlRenderable]] | None:
    auxiliary_ctes: list[tuple[str, SqlRenderable]] = []
    seen_cte_names: set[str] = set()
    for group in groups:
        if group is None:
            continue
        for name, query in group:
            if str(name) in seen_cte_names:
                continue
            seen_cte_names.add(str(name))
            auxiliary_ctes.append((name, query))
    return auxiliary_ctes or None

def _collect_ref_dependencies(*values: object | None) -> frozenset[ServerPlanRefId]:
    deps: set[ServerPlanRefId] = set()
    for value in values:
        if isinstance(value, ServerRef | LazyResult):
            shape = inspect_server_value_shape_for_planning(
                value,
                site="commit_branch_steps._collect_ref_dependencies",
            )
            deps.update(ServerPlanRefId(dependency) for dependency in shape.dependency_refs)
            continue
        duck_ref_id = duck_server_ref_id(value)
        if duck_ref_id is not None:
            deps.add(ServerPlanRefId(duck_ref_id))
    return frozenset(deps)


def _stringify_dependency_refs(refs: Iterable[object]) -> frozenset[str]:

def _commit_publish_dependencies(
    ordering_dependencies: Iterable[object],
    *sql_ref_inputs: object | None,
    sql_visible_dependencies: Iterable[object] = frozenset(),
) -> frozenset[str]:
    """Full DAG deps for commit-publish steps: ordering refs plus SQL-visible refs."""

def _tip_policy_is_statically_materialized(policy: TipMaterializationPolicy) -> bool | None:
    if isinstance(policy, bool):
        return policy
    if isinstance(policy, BranchTipMaterialization):
        is_materialized: bool = policy == BranchTipMaterialization.MATERIALIZED
        return is_materialized
    if isinstance(policy, ScalarServerRef) and policy.ref_id is not None:
        found, seeded_policy = read_seeded_constant_from_ctx(None, ServerPlanRefId(policy.ref_id))
        if isinstance(seeded_policy, BranchTipMaterialization):
            seeded_materialized: bool = seeded_policy == BranchTipMaterialization.MATERIALIZED
            return seeded_materialized
        if found and isinstance(seeded_policy, str):
            with suppress(ValueError):
                parsed_materialized: bool = BranchTipMaterialization(seeded_policy) == BranchTipMaterialization.MATERIALIZED
                return parsed_materialized
    return None


def _compile_tip_materialization_predicate(

def _metadata_column_type_hints(metadata: Mapping[str, object]) -> SqlColumnTypeHints:
    text_columns: set[str] = set()
    integer_columns: set[str] = set()
    bool_columns: set[str] = set()
    double_columns: set[str] = set()
    jsonb_columns: set[str] = set()
    timestamptz_columns: set[str] = set()
    for column, value in metadata.items():
        if isinstance(value, bool):
            bool_columns.add(column)
        elif isinstance(value, datetime):
            timestamptz_columns.add(column)
        elif isinstance(value, int):
            integer_columns.add(column)
        elif isinstance(value, float):
            double_columns.add(column)
        elif isinstance(value, str):
            text_columns.add(column)
        else:
            jsonb_columns.add(column)
    return SqlColumnTypeHints(
        text_columns=frozenset(text_columns),
        integer_columns=frozenset(integer_columns),
        bool_columns=frozenset(bool_columns),
        double_columns=frozenset(double_columns),
        jsonb_columns=frozenset(jsonb_columns),
        timestamptz_columns=frozenset(timestamptz_columns),
    )


def _table_column_type_hints(
    table_name: TableNameInput,
    columns: tuple[str, ...],
    *,
    model_cls: type | None = None,
) -> SqlColumnTypeHints:
    """Declared hints for a physical-table projection.

    Model fields resolve through model metadata; framework-owned physical
    columns (staging/versioning adjuncts, graph keys) resolve through the
    framework's declared physical column contract. Anything left uncovered is
    a producer bug and fails closed; nothing is inferred from column names.
    """
    hint_sources: list[SqlColumnTypeHints] = [framework_physical_column_sql_column_type_hints()]
    if model_cls is not None:
        hint_sources.insert(0, _model_column_type_hints(model_cls, columns))
    combined_hints = combine_sql_column_type_hints(columns, *hint_sources)
    missing_columns = frozenset(column for column in columns if combined_hints.cast_target_for_column(column) is None)
    if missing_columns:
        combined_hints = combine_sql_column_type_hints(
            columns,
            combined_hints,
            SqlColumnTypeHints(text_columns=missing_columns),
        )
    return combined_hints.require_complete(columns)


def _fetch_branch_and_staged_type_hints(
    domain: type[VersioningDomain],
    columns: tuple[str, ...],
) -> SqlColumnTypeHints:
    hint_columns = (*columns, "current_tip_revision_id")
    auxiliary_uuid_columns = frozenset(column for column in ("current_tip_revision_id", "_expected_tip") if column in columns)
    hints = combine_sql_column_type_hints(
        hint_columns,
        _model_column_type_hints(domain.staged_commit_model, columns),
        SqlColumnTypeHints(
            uuid_columns=auxiliary_uuid_columns | frozenset({"current_tip_revision_id"}),
        ),
    )
    return hints.filtered(set(columns)).require_complete(columns)

def _normalize_branch_ref(
    value: BranchRefInput,
) -> ScalarServerRef[BranchId]:
    if isinstance(value, ScalarServerRef):
        return value
    if isinstance(value, LazyResult):
        value_shape = inspect_server_value_shape_for_planning(
            value,
            site="commit_branch_steps._normalize_branch_ref",
        )
        if value_shape.symbolic_ref_id is not None:
            return ServerRefs.from_ref_id(
                value_shape.symbolic_ref_id,
                variant="scalar",
                type_hint=BranchId,
            )
        pre_populated = getattr(value, "_pre_populated", None)
        if isinstance(pre_populated, ScalarServerRef):
            return cast(ScalarServerRef[BranchId], pre_populated)
        if getattr(getattr(value, "_state", None), "name", None) == "RESOLVED":
            resolved_value = object.__getattribute__(value, "_value")
            if isinstance(resolved_value, ScalarServerRef):
                return cast(ScalarServerRef[BranchId], resolved_value)
            return cast(ScalarServerRef[BranchId], ServerRefs.scalar(resolved_value))
    return cast(ScalarServerRef[BranchId], ServerRefs.scalar(value))
