def _resolve_staged_source(
    table_name: TableNameInput,
    ctx: CompilationContext,
    *,
    selector: _StagedCommitSelector | None = None,
) -> str:
    """Resolve a staged table to an overlay CTE that unions all prior writes.

    When multiple CTEs write to the same staged table (e.g. inserts + tombstones),
    the overlay CTE provides a unified view via UNION ALL.  The overlay is created
    lazily in the CTE strategy; this function just looks it up.

    Falls back to the literal table name when no overlay exists (e.g. when
    not running inside a CTE batch, or on backends without data-modifying CTEs).
    """
    resolved = resolve_staged_source(SqlTableName(table_name), ctx)
    if any(str(binding.ref_id) == resolved for binding in ctx.publication_selections.values()):
        return resolved
    if selector is not None and selector._connection_id_raw is not None:
        return str(table_name)
    return resolved


def _resolve_tip_upsert_staged_source(table_name: TableNameInput, ctx: CompilationContext) -> str:
    effective_staged = _resolve_staged_source(table_name, ctx)
    if not effective_staged.startswith("_compound_ov"):
        return effective_staged
    for cte_ref in reversed(tuple(ctx.cte_refs.values())):
        if (
            cte_ref.ref_id != effective_staged
            and cte_ref.ref_id.startswith("_compound_ov")
            and cte_ref.auxiliary_query is not None
            and cte_ref.source_tables is not None
            and any(str(source_table) == str(table_name) for source_table in cte_ref.source_tables)
        ):
            return cte_ref.ref_id
    return effective_staged


def _type_name_filter_conditions(
    *,
    column_ref: SqlColumnRef,
    type_name_filter: Sequence[str],
) -> tuple[SqlExpr, ...]:
    if not type_name_filter:
        return ()
    if len(type_name_filter) == 1:
        return (SqlBinaryOp(column_ref, BinaryOp.EQ, SqlParam(type_name_filter[0])),)
    return (SqlIn(column_ref, [SqlParam(type_name) for type_name in type_name_filter]),)


def _build_touched_tree_target_query(
    *,
    staged_table_name: TableNameInput,
    tip_table_name: TableNameInput | None = None,
    branch_id: BranchRefInput | BranchId,
    selector: _StagedCommitSelector,
    ctx: CompilationContext,
    include_deleted: bool,
    type_name_filter: Sequence[str] = (),
    affected_rows_ref: ServerPlanRefId | None = None,
    affected_source_override: str | None = None,
    affected_branch_exprs: Sequence[SqlRenderable] = (),
    validation_needed_expr: SqlRenderable | None = None,
) -> SqlRenderable:
    affected_source = affected_source_override or _affected_rows_source_table(affected_rows_ref, ctx)
    effective_staged = affected_source or _resolve_staged_source(SqlTableName(staged_table_name), ctx)
    staged_alias = SqlAliasName("staged")
    conditions: list[SqlRenderable] = []
    if validation_needed_expr is not None:
        conditions.append(validation_needed_expr)
    if affected_branch_exprs:
        conditions.append(
            sql_or(
                *(
                    SqlBinaryOp(
                        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("branch_id"), str(staged_alias)),
                        BinaryOp.EQ,
                        branch_expr,
                    )
                    for branch_expr in affected_branch_exprs
                ),
            ),
        )
    if affected_source is None:
        conditions.extend(
            (
                selector.match_expr(
                    column_name=SqlColumnName("sys_staged_commit_id"),
                    qualifier=str(staged_alias),
                    ctx=ctx,
                ),
                selector.latest_row_expr(
                    staged_table=effective_staged,
                    outer_qualifier=str(staged_alias),
                    ctx=ctx,
                ),
            ),
        )
    if not include_deleted:
        conditions.append(
            SqlUnaryOp(
                UnaryOp.NOT,
                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_deleted"), str(staged_alias)),
            ),
        )
    conditions.extend(
        _type_name_filter_conditions(
            column_ref=SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("type_name"), str(staged_alias)),
            type_name_filter=type_name_filter,
        ),
    )
    current_targets = SqlSelect(
        select_list=SqlSelectList(
            [
                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("target_sys_id"), str(staged_alias)),
                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("graph_sys_id"), str(staged_alias)),
            ],
        ),
        from_=SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName(effective_staged)), staged_alias),
        where=SqlWhereClause(sql_and(*conditions)),
        distinct=True,
    )
    if tip_table_name is None:
        return current_targets

    old_tip_alias = SqlAliasName("old_tip")
    override_alias = SqlAliasName("override")
    override_conditions: list[SqlRenderable] = []
    if validation_needed_expr is not None:
        override_conditions.append(validation_needed_expr)
    if affected_source is None:
        override_conditions.extend(
            (
                selector.match_expr(
                    column_name=SqlColumnName("sys_staged_commit_id"),
                    qualifier=str(override_alias),
                    ctx=ctx,
                ),
                selector.latest_row_expr(
                    staged_table=effective_staged,
                    outer_qualifier=str(override_alias),
                    ctx=ctx,
                ),
            ),
        )
    old_targets = SqlSelect(
        select_list=SqlSelectList(
            [
                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("target_sys_id"), str(old_tip_alias)),
                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("graph_sys_id"), str(old_tip_alias)),
            ],
        ),
        from_=SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName(tip_table_name)), old_tip_alias),
        joins=[
            SqlJoin(
                JoinKind.INNER,
                SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName(effective_staged)), override_alias),
                SqlBinaryOp(
                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id"), str(override_alias)),
                    BinaryOp.EQ,
                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id"), str(old_tip_alias)),
                ),
            ),
        ],
        where=SqlWhereClause(
            sql_and(
                SqlBinaryOp(
                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("branch_id"), str(old_tip_alias)),
                    BinaryOp.EQ,
                    affected_branch_exprs[0] if affected_branch_exprs else _sql_param_or_cte_scalar(branch_id, ctx),
                ),
                *override_conditions,
                *_type_name_filter_conditions(
                    column_ref=SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("type_name"), str(old_tip_alias)),
                    type_name_filter=type_name_filter,
                ),
            ),
        ),
        distinct=True,
    )
    return SqlUnionDistinct([current_targets, old_targets])


def _build_dirty_graph_tree_working_set_ctes(
    *,
    staged_table_name: TableNameInput,
    tip_table_name: TableNameInput,
    branch_id: BranchRefInput | BranchId,
    selector: _StagedCommitSelector,
    ctx: CompilationContext,
    extra_staged_conditions: Sequence[SqlExpr] = (),
    type_name_filter: Sequence[str] = (),
    affected_rows_ref: ServerPlanRefId | None = None,
    cte_prefix: str = "dirty_tree",
) -> tuple[Any, Any, Any]:
    selected_staged_rows_name = SqlTableName(f"{cte_prefix}_selected_staged_rows")
    dirty_graphs_name = SqlTableName(f"{cte_prefix}_dirty_graphs")
    visible_parent_edges_name = SqlTableName(f"{cte_prefix}_visible_parent_edges")
    affected_source = _affected_rows_source_table(affected_rows_ref, ctx)
    effective_staged = affected_source or _resolve_staged_source(SqlTableName(staged_table_name), ctx)
    staged_alias = SqlAliasName("staged")
    dirty_graph_alias = SqlAliasName("dg")
    tip_alias = SqlAliasName("tip")
    staged_override_alias = SqlAliasName("so")
    old_tip_alias = SqlAliasName("old_tip")
    tip_type_conditions = _type_name_filter_conditions(
        column_ref=SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("type_name"), str(tip_alias)),
        type_name_filter=type_name_filter,
    )
    staged_scope_conditions: tuple[SqlExpr, ...] = (
        ()
        if affected_source is not None
        else (
            selector.match_expr(
                column_name=SqlColumnName("sys_staged_commit_id"),
                qualifier=str(staged_alias),
                ctx=ctx,
            ),
            selector.latest_row_expr(
                staged_table=effective_staged,
                outer_qualifier=str(staged_alias),
                ctx=ctx,
            ),
        )
    )
    staged_row_conditions = (*staged_scope_conditions, *extra_staged_conditions)
    selected_staged_rows_cte = SqlCteDefinition(
        f"{selected_staged_rows_name}(sys_id, source_sys_id, target_sys_id, graph_sys_id, sys_deleted, type_name)",
        SqlSelect(
            select_list=SqlSelectList(
                [
                    SqlSelectAlias(SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id"), str(staged_alias)), SqlAliasName("sys_id")),
                    SqlSelectAlias(
                        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("source_sys_id"), str(staged_alias)),
                        SqlAliasName("source_sys_id"),
                    ),
                    SqlSelectAlias(
                        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("target_sys_id"), str(staged_alias)),
                        SqlAliasName("target_sys_id"),
                    ),
                    SqlSelectAlias(
                        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("graph_sys_id"), str(staged_alias)),
                        SqlAliasName("graph_sys_id"),
                    ),
                    SqlSelectAlias(
                        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_deleted"), str(staged_alias)),
                        SqlAliasName("sys_deleted"),
                    ),
                    SqlSelectAlias(
                        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("type_name"), str(staged_alias)),
                        SqlAliasName("type_name"),
                    ),
                ],
            ),
            from_=SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName(effective_staged)), staged_alias),
            where=(SqlWhereClause(sql_and(*staged_row_conditions)) if staged_row_conditions else None),
        ),
        materialized=(ctx.backend_profile.traits.versioned_staging_transport is VersionedStagingTransport.SAME_STATEMENT_RELATION),
    )

    dirty_graphs_cte = SqlCteDefinition(
        f"{dirty_graphs_name}(graph_sys_id)",
        SqlUnionDistinct(
            [
                SqlSelect(
                    select_list=SqlSelectList(
                        [
                            SqlSelectAlias(
                                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("graph_sys_id"), str(staged_alias)),
                                SqlAliasName("graph_sys_id"),
                            ),
                        ],
                    ),
                    from_=SqlTableAlias(
                        SqlTableIdent(selected_staged_rows_name),
                        staged_alias,
                    ),
                    where=SqlWhereClause(
                        sql_and(
                            *_type_name_filter_conditions(
                                column_ref=SqlColumnRef(
                                    SqlColumnName("type_name"),
                                    str(staged_alias),
                                ),
                                type_name_filter=type_name_filter,
                            ),
                        ),
                    )
                    if type_name_filter
                    else None,
                    distinct=True,
                ),
                SqlSelect(
                    select_list=SqlSelectList(
                        [
                            SqlSelectAlias(
                                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("graph_sys_id"), str(old_tip_alias)),
                                SqlAliasName("graph_sys_id"),
                            ),
                        ],
                    ),
                    from_=SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName(tip_table_name)), old_tip_alias),
                    joins=[
                        SqlJoin(
                            JoinKind.INNER,
                            SqlTableAlias(
                                SqlTableIdent(selected_staged_rows_name),
                                staged_override_alias,
                            ),
                            SqlBinaryOp(
                                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id"), str(staged_override_alias)),
                                BinaryOp.EQ,
                                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id"), str(old_tip_alias)),
                            ),
                        ),
                    ],
                    where=SqlWhereClause(
                        sql_and(
                            SqlBinaryOp(
                                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("branch_id"), str(old_tip_alias)),
                                BinaryOp.EQ,
                                _sql_param_or_cte_scalar(branch_id, ctx),
                            ),
                            *_type_name_filter_conditions(
                                column_ref=SqlColumnRef(
                                    SqlColumnName("type_name"),
                                    str(old_tip_alias),
                                ),
                                type_name_filter=type_name_filter,
                            ),
                        ),
                    ),
                    distinct=True,
                ),
            ],
        ),
        materialized=(ctx.backend_profile.traits.versioned_staging_transport is VersionedStagingTransport.SAME_STATEMENT_RELATION),
    )

    tip_scope_joins = [
        SqlJoin(
            JoinKind.INNER,
            SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(dirty_graphs_name), dirty_graph_alias),
            SqlBinaryOp(
                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("graph_sys_id"), str(dirty_graph_alias)),
                BinaryOp.EQ,
                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("graph_sys_id"), str(tip_alias)),
            ),
        ),
    ]

    visible_parent_edges_cte = SqlCteDefinition(
        f"{visible_parent_edges_name}(source_sys_id, target_sys_id, graph_sys_id)",
        SqlUnionAll(
            [
                SqlSelect(
                    select_list=SqlSelectList(
                        [
                            SqlSelectAlias(
                                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("source_sys_id"), str(tip_alias)),
                                SqlAliasName("source_sys_id"),
                            ),
                            SqlSelectAlias(
                                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("target_sys_id"), str(tip_alias)),
                                SqlAliasName("target_sys_id"),
                            ),
                            SqlSelectAlias(
                                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("graph_sys_id"), str(tip_alias)),
                                SqlAliasName("graph_sys_id"),
                            ),
                        ],
                    ),
                    from_=SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName(tip_table_name)), tip_alias),
                    joins=[
                        *tip_scope_joins,
                        SqlJoin(
                            JoinKind.LEFT,
                            SqlTableAlias(
                                SqlTableIdent(selected_staged_rows_name),
                                staged_override_alias,
                            ),
                            SqlBinaryOp(
                                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id"), str(staged_override_alias)),
                                BinaryOp.EQ,
                                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id"), str(tip_alias)),
                            ),
                        ),
                    ],
                    where=SqlWhereClause(
                        sql_and(
                            SqlBinaryOp(
                                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("branch_id"), str(tip_alias)),
                                BinaryOp.EQ,
                                _sql_param_or_cte_scalar(branch_id, ctx),
                            ),
                            SqlIsNull(
                                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id"), str(staged_override_alias)),
                            ),
                            *tip_type_conditions,
                        ),
                    ),
                    distinct=True,
                ),
                SqlSelect(
                    select_list=SqlSelectList(
                        [
                            SqlSelectAlias(
                                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("source_sys_id"), str(staged_alias)),
                                SqlAliasName("source_sys_id"),
                            ),
                            SqlSelectAlias(
                                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("target_sys_id"), str(staged_alias)),
                                SqlAliasName("target_sys_id"),
                            ),
                            SqlSelectAlias(
                                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("graph_sys_id"), str(staged_alias)),
                                SqlAliasName("graph_sys_id"),
                            ),
                        ],
                    ),
                    from_=SqlTableAlias(
                        SqlTableIdent(selected_staged_rows_name),
                        staged_alias,
                    ),
                    where=SqlWhereClause(
                        sql_and(
                            SqlUnaryOp(
                                UnaryOp.NOT,
                                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_deleted"), str(staged_alias)),
                            ),
                            *_type_name_filter_conditions(
                                column_ref=SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("type_name"), str(staged_alias)),
                                type_name_filter=type_name_filter,
                            ),
                        ),
                    ),
                    distinct=True,
                ),
            ],
        ),
        materialized=(ctx.backend_profile.traits.versioned_staging_transport is VersionedStagingTransport.SAME_STATEMENT_RELATION),
    )
    return (
        selected_staged_rows_cte,
        dirty_graphs_cte,
        visible_parent_edges_cte,
    )


def _latest_staged_not_exists_condition(
    *,
    staged_table: str,
    commit_subquery: SqlDynamicSelectStmt,
    outer_qualifier: str | None,
    ctx: CompilationContext,
    partition_by_branch: bool = True,
) -> SqlExpr:
    """Filter to latest staged row per sys_id for selected commits."""
    del ctx
    return _latest_staged_not_exists_expr(
        staged_table=staged_table,
        staged_commit_filter=commit_subquery,
        outer_qualifier=outer_qualifier,
        partition_by_branch=partition_by_branch,
    )


def _explicit_staged_commit_id_expr(
    *,
    column_name: SqlColumnName,
    qualifier: str | None = None,
    staged_commit_ids: Sequence[StagedCommitId],
) -> SqlExpr:
    if not staged_commit_ids:
        msg = "Explicit staged commit ID predicates require at least one staged commit ID"
        raise ValueError(msg)
    return SqlIn(
        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(column_name), qualifier=qualifier),
        [SqlParam(staged_commit_id) for staged_commit_id in staged_commit_ids],
    )


def _latest_staged_not_exists_condition_for_ids(
    *,
    staged_table: str,
    staged_commit_ids: Sequence[StagedCommitId],
    outer_qualifier: str | None,
    ctx: CompilationContext,
    partition_by_branch: bool = True,
) -> SqlExpr:
    """Filter to the latest staged row per sys_id for explicit staged IDs."""
    del ctx

    return _latest_staged_not_exists_expr(
        staged_table=staged_table,
        staged_commit_filter=[SqlParam(staged_commit_id) for staged_commit_id in staged_commit_ids],
        outer_qualifier=outer_qualifier,
        partition_by_branch=partition_by_branch,
    )


def _latest_staged_not_exists_expr(
    *,
    staged_table: str,
    staged_commit_filter: SqlRenderable | Sequence[SqlRenderable] | None,
    outer_qualifier: str | None,
    partition_by_branch: bool = False,
) -> SqlExpr:
    inner_qualifier = "s2"

    def _outer_col(column_name: SqlColumnName) -> SqlColumnRef:
        return SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(column_name), qualifier=outer_qualifier or staged_table)

    inner_select = SqlSelect(
        select_list=SqlIntegerLiteral(1),
        from_=SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName(staged_table)), SqlAliasName(inner_qualifier)),
        where=sql_and(
            *(
                (
                    SqlBinaryOp(
                        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("branch_id"), qualifier=inner_qualifier),
                        BinaryOp.EQ,
                        _outer_col(SqlColumnName("branch_id")),
                    ),
                )
                if partition_by_branch and outer_qualifier is not None
                else ()
            ),
            SqlBinaryOp(
                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id"), qualifier=inner_qualifier),
                BinaryOp.EQ,
                _outer_col(SqlColumnName("sys_id")),
            ),
            *(
                (
                    SqlIn(
                        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_staged_commit_id"), qualifier=inner_qualifier),
                        staged_commit_filter,
                    ),
                )
                if staged_commit_filter is not None
                else ()
            ),
            sql_or(
                SqlBinaryOp(
                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_staged_commit_id"), qualifier=inner_qualifier),
                    BinaryOp.GT,
                    _outer_col(SqlColumnName("sys_staged_commit_id")),
                ),
                sql_and(
                    SqlBinaryOp(
                        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_staged_commit_id"), qualifier=inner_qualifier),
                        BinaryOp.EQ,
                        _outer_col(SqlColumnName("sys_staged_commit_id")),
                    ),
                    sql_or(
                        SqlBinaryOp(
                            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_updated_at"), qualifier=inner_qualifier),
                            BinaryOp.GT,
                            _outer_col(SqlColumnName("sys_updated_at")),
                        ),
                        sql_and(
                            SqlBinaryOp(
                                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_updated_at"), qualifier=inner_qualifier),
                                BinaryOp.EQ,
                                _outer_col(SqlColumnName("sys_updated_at")),
                            ),
                            SqlBinaryOp(
                                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_deleted"), qualifier=inner_qualifier),
                                BinaryOp.GT,
                                _outer_col(SqlColumnName("sys_deleted")),
                            ),
                        ),
                    ),
                ),
            ),
        ),
    )
    return SqlExists(inner_select, negated=True)


def _build_open_sparse_sys_id_subquery(
    *,
    sparse_table: str,
    lazy_branch: BranchRefInput,
    ctx: CompilationContext,
    exclude_revision_id: RevisionId | None = None,
) -> SqlDynamicSelectStmt:
    where_conditions: list[SqlExpr] = [
        SqlBinaryOp(
            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("branch_id")),
            BinaryOp.EQ,
            _sql_param_or_cte_scalar(lazy_branch, ctx),
        ),
        SqlIsNull(SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_valid_to_revision_id"))),
    ]
    if exclude_revision_id is not None:
        where_conditions.append(
            SqlBinaryOp(
                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_valid_from_revision_id")),
                BinaryOp.NE,
                SqlParam(exclude_revision_id),
            ),
        )
    return SqlDynamicSelectStmt(
        from_table=SqlTableName(sparse_table),
        columns=[SqlColumnName("sys_id")],
        where_conditions=where_conditions,
    )


@final
class _StagedCommitSelector:
    __plan_payload_fields__ = (
        "_commit_subquery",
        "_branch_scope_token",
        "_connection_id_raw",
        "_lazy_branch",
        "_staged_commit_ids",
        "_staged_commits_table",
        "_tables_read",
        "_uses_commit_subquery",
    )
    __slots__ = (
        "_commit_subquery",
        "_branch_scope_token",
        "_connection_id_raw",
        "_lazy_branch",
        "_staged_commit_ids",
        "_staged_commits_table",
        "_tables_read",
        "_uses_commit_subquery",
    )

    def __init__(
        self: _StagedCommitSelector,
        *,
        commit_subquery: SqlDynamicSelectStmt | None = None,
        staged_commit_ids: Sequence[StagedCommitId] = (),
        tables_read: frozenset[str] = frozenset(),
        staged_commits_table: TableNameInput | None = None,
        lazy_branch: BranchScopeSource | None = None,
        branch_scope_token: BranchScopeToken | None = None,
        connection_id_raw: ConnectionIdInput = None,
    ) -> None:
        self._commit_subquery = commit_subquery
        self._branch_scope_token = branch_scope_token or opaque_scope_token(lazy_branch)
        self._staged_commit_ids = tuple(staged_commit_ids)
        self._tables_read = tables_read
        self._staged_commits_table = staged_commits_table
        self._lazy_branch = lazy_branch
        self._connection_id_raw = connection_id_raw
        self._uses_commit_subquery = commit_subquery is not None or staged_commits_table is not None

    @classmethod
    def branch_scope(
        cls,
        *,
        staged_commits_table: TableNameInput,
        lazy_branch: BranchScopeSource,
        branch_scope_token: BranchScopeToken | None = None,
        connection_id_raw: ConnectionIdInput,
        staged_commit_ids: Sequence[StagedCommitId] = (),
    ) -> _StagedCommitSelector:
        commit_subquery = None
        if not isinstance(lazy_branch, ServerRef) and not _collect_ref_dependencies(lazy_branch):
            commit_subquery = _build_staged_commit_subquery(
                staged_commits_table,
                lazy_branch,
                connection_id_raw,
                staged_commit_ids=staged_commit_ids,
            )
        return cls(
            commit_subquery=commit_subquery,
            staged_commit_ids=staged_commit_ids,
            tables_read=frozenset({staged_commits_table}),
            staged_commits_table=staged_commits_table,
            lazy_branch=lazy_branch,
            branch_scope_token=branch_scope_token,
            connection_id_raw=connection_id_raw,
        )

    @classmethod
    def explicit_ids(
        cls,
        *,
        staged_commit_ids: Sequence[StagedCommitId],
        branch_scope_token: BranchScopeToken | None = None,
    ) -> _StagedCommitSelector:
        return cls(staged_commit_ids=staged_commit_ids, branch_scope_token=branch_scope_token)

    def tables_read(self: _StagedCommitSelector) -> frozenset[str]:
        return self._tables_read

    def dependencies(self: _StagedCommitSelector) -> frozenset[str]:
        return _collect_ref_dependencies(self._lazy_branch)

    def _resolve_commit_subquery(
        self: _StagedCommitSelector,
        ctx: CompilationContext,
        *,
        select_as_proof_observation: bool = False,
        branch_expr_override: SqlRenderable | None = None,
    ) -> SqlDmlBase | SqlCte:
        """Return the commit subquery, resolving the staged_commits table via CTE if possible."""
        if self._staged_commits_table is not None and self._lazy_branch is not None:
            connection_id_raw = self._connection_id_raw
            effective = (
                str(self._staged_commits_table)
                if connection_id_raw is not None
                else _resolve_staged_source(SqlTableName(self._staged_commits_table), ctx)
            )
            binding = ctx.cte_refs.get(effective)
            if connection_id_raw is not None and effective != str(self._staged_commits_table):
                binding_columns = set(binding.columns or ()) if binding is not None else set()
                if "connection_id" not in binding_columns:
                    connection_id_raw = None
            subquery = _build_staged_commit_subquery(
                effective,
                self._lazy_branch,
                connection_id_raw,
                ctx,
                staged_commit_ids=self._staged_commit_ids if connection_id_raw is None else (),
                select_as_proof_observation=select_as_proof_observation,
                branch_expr_override=branch_expr_override,
            )
            if binding is not None and binding.auxiliary_query is not None:
                return SqlCte([(binding.ref_id, binding.auxiliary_query)], subquery)
            return subquery
        assert self._commit_subquery is not None
        return self._commit_subquery

    def match_expr(
        self: _StagedCommitSelector,
        *,
        column_name: SqlColumnName,
        qualifier: str | None = None,
        ctx: CompilationContext | None = None,
        branch_expr_override: SqlRenderable | None = None,
    ) -> SqlExpr:
        explicit_expr = (
            _explicit_staged_commit_id_expr(
                column_name=column_name,
                qualifier=qualifier,
                staged_commit_ids=self._staged_commit_ids,
            )
            if self._staged_commit_ids
            else None
        )
        if self._uses_commit_subquery:
            subquery = (
                self._resolve_commit_subquery(
                    ctx,
                    branch_expr_override=branch_expr_override,
                )
                if ctx is not None
                else self._commit_subquery
            )
            if subquery is None:
                msg = "Branch-scoped staged commit selector requires a CompilationContext for symbolic branch refs"
                raise RuntimeError(msg)
            subquery_expr = SqlIn(SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(column_name), qualifier=qualifier), subquery)
            return subquery_expr if explicit_expr is None else cast("SqlExpr", sql_or(subquery_expr, explicit_expr))
        if explicit_expr is None:
            msg = "Explicit staged commit selector requires at least one staged commit ID"
            raise ValueError(msg)
        return explicit_expr

    def latest_row_expr(
        self: _StagedCommitSelector,
        *,
        staged_table: str,
        outer_qualifier: str | None = None,
        ctx: CompilationContext,
        partition_by_branch: bool = True,
        branch_expr_override: SqlRenderable | None = None,
    ) -> SqlExpr:
        if is_latest_wins_staged_source(staged_table, ctx):
            return SQL_EXPR_ALWAYS_TRUE
        explicit_expr = (
            _latest_staged_not_exists_condition_for_ids(
                staged_table=staged_table,
                staged_commit_ids=self._staged_commit_ids,
                outer_qualifier=outer_qualifier,
                ctx=ctx,
                partition_by_branch=partition_by_branch,
            )
            if self._staged_commit_ids
            else None
        )
        if self._uses_commit_subquery:
            resolved_subquery = self._resolve_commit_subquery(
                ctx,
                branch_expr_override=branch_expr_override,
            )
            assert resolved_subquery is not None
            subquery_expr = _latest_staged_not_exists_condition(
                staged_table=staged_table,
                commit_subquery=cast("SqlDynamicSelectStmt", resolved_subquery),
                outer_qualifier=outer_qualifier,
                ctx=ctx,
                partition_by_branch=partition_by_branch,
            )
            return subquery_expr if explicit_expr is None else cast("SqlExpr", sql_or(subquery_expr, explicit_expr))
        if explicit_expr is None:
            msg = "Explicit latest-row selector requires at least one staged commit ID"
            raise ValueError(msg)
        return explicit_expr

class VersionedDeltaEventClass(StrEnum):
    """Final committed change class for one versioned row."""

    INSERT = "insert"
    UPDATE = "update"
    DELETE = "delete"


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class VersionedDeltaRowState:
    """Backend-neutral state used to classify one committed row delta."""

    deleted: bool
    values: tuple[object, ...]


def classify_versioned_commit_delta(
    *,
    prior: VersionedDeltaRowState | None,
    final: VersionedDeltaRowState,
) -> VersionedDeltaEventClass | None:
    """Classify the final committed state against the prior visible state."""
    prior_present = prior is not None and not prior.deleted
    if final.deleted:
        return VersionedDeltaEventClass.DELETE if prior_present else None
    if not prior_present:
        return VersionedDeltaEventClass.INSERT
    assert prior is not None
    return VersionedDeltaEventClass.UPDATE if prior.values != final.values else None


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class ExactGraphRouteDescriptor:
    """Exact physical and polymorphic route for one graph object."""

    graph_table: SqlTableName
    object_kind: Literal["node", "edge"]
    object_table: SqlTableName
    model_type_name: str | None = None
    type_discriminator_column: SqlColumnName | None = None
    type_discriminator_value: str | None = None

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        if (self.type_discriminator_column is None) != (self.type_discriminator_value is None):
            raise ValueError("Graph route discriminator column and value must be present together")
        if self.type_discriminator_value == "":
            raise ValueError("Graph route discriminator value cannot be empty")
        if self.model_type_name == "":
            raise ValueError("Graph route model type name cannot be empty")
        if self.model_type_name is None and self.type_discriminator_column is None:
            raise ValueError("Graph route requires a model or discriminator identity")


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class VersionedCommitDeltaSource:
    """Immutable commit-owned source for one physical versioned table."""

    model_cls: type[BaseModel]
    logical_table: SqlTableName
    staged_table: SqlTableName
    sparse_table: SqlTableName
    selector: _StagedCommitSelector
    branch_ref: ScalarServerRef[BranchId]
    revision_ref: ScalarServerRef[RevisionId]
    data_columns: tuple[SqlColumnName, ...]
    type_discriminator_columns: tuple[SqlColumnName, ...]
    graph_routes: tuple[ExactGraphRouteDescriptor, ...]
    sparse_publish_tail: ServerPlanRefId
    staged_cleanup_boundary: ServerPlanRefId
    affected_rows_ref: ServerPlanRefId | None = None
    branch_relation_ref: ServerPlanRefId | None = None

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        if self.sparse_publish_tail == self.staged_cleanup_boundary:
            raise ValueError("Sparse publish tail and staged cleanup boundary must be different steps")
        if len(set((*self.data_columns, *self.type_discriminator_columns))) != len(
            self.data_columns,
        ) + len(self.type_discriminator_columns):
            raise ValueError("Commit delta data and discriminator columns must not overlap")
        if any(
            SqlTableName(derive_versioned_table_names(VersionedBaseTableName(str(SchemaObjectName(str(route.object_table))))).staged)
            != self.staged_table
            for route in self.graph_routes
        ):
            raise ValueError("Graph route object table must match the source physical table")
        discriminator_columns = frozenset(self.type_discriminator_columns)
        if any(
            route.type_discriminator_column is not None and route.type_discriminator_column not in discriminator_columns
            for route in self.graph_routes
        ):
            raise ValueError("Graph route discriminator must be part of the commit delta columns")

    @property
    def delta_columns(self) -> tuple[SqlColumnName, ...]:
        return (*self.data_columns, *self.type_discriminator_columns)

    @property
    def completion_ref(self) -> ServerPlanRefId:
        return self.sparse_publish_tail

    def result_transport_for_backend(self, backend_type: BackendType) -> DmlResultTransport:
        from l2070_batching.backend_profile import dml_result_transport_for_backend

        return dml_result_transport_for_backend(backend_type)

class SpeculativePublicationFactsMiss(SpeculativePublicationMiss):
    """Carry exact domain facts from one typed SQL publication proof."""

    def __init__(self, frame: PublicationProofFrame) -> None:
        super().__init__("Typed speculative publication miss")
        if frame.admitted or not frame.complete:
            raise ValueError("A publication miss requires one complete failed proof frame")
        touched = tuple(fact.table_name for fact in frame.facts if isinstance(fact, TableSetPublicationProofFact))
        non_insert = tuple(fact.table_name for fact in frame.facts if isinstance(fact, InsertOnlyPublicationProofFact))
        tombstone = tuple(fact.table_name for fact in frame.facts if isinstance(fact, TombstonePublicationProofFact))
        selected = tuple(fact.staged_commit_id for fact in frame.facts if isinstance(fact, SelectedStagedCommitProofFact))
        current_tips = tuple(fact.revision_id for fact in frame.facts if isinstance(fact, CurrentTipPublicationProofFact))
        if not touched and not non_insert and not tombstone:
            raise ValueError("A publication miss requires mismatch facts")
        if not selected:
            raise ValueError("A publication miss requires selected staged-commit IDs")
        if len(current_tips) != 1:
            raise ValueError("A publication miss requires one locked branch-tip fact")
        self.missing_table_names = touched
        self.non_insert_table_names = non_insert
        self.tombstone_table_names = tombstone
        self.selected_staged_commit_ids = selected
        self.current_tip_revision_id = current_tips[0]


class _SpeculativePublicationAdmissionQuery(SqlRenderable):
    __slots__ = ("_missing_query",)

    def __init__(self, missing_query: SqlRenderable) -> None:
        self._missing_query = missing_query

    @memoize_in_read_only_scope
    def render(self, dialect: SqlDialect) -> SqlFragment:
        missing_alias = SqlQuotedIdentifier(_SQL_SPEC_GUARD_MISSING_CTE).render(dialect)
        return _SQL_SPEC_GUARD_ADMISSION_OPEN + self._missing_query.render(dialect) + _SQL_SPEC_GUARD_AS_DERIVED_ALIAS + missing_alias

def _selector_for_scope(scope: SparsePublishScope) -> _StagedCommitSelector:
    return (
        _StagedCommitSelector.branch_scope(
            staged_commits_table=scope.staged_commits_table,
            lazy_branch=scope.branch_id,
            branch_scope_token=scope.branch_scope_token,
            connection_id_raw=scope.visibility_scope_value,
            staged_commit_ids=scope.inline_staged_commit_ids,
        )
        if isinstance(scope, BranchScopedSparsePublish)
        else _StagedCommitSelector.explicit_ids(
            staged_commit_ids=scope.staged_commit_ids,
            branch_scope_token=scope.branch_scope_token,
        )
    )


def _scope_descriptor_from_selector(
    branch_id: BranchRefInput,
    selector: _StagedCommitSelector,
) -> PublishScopeDescriptor:
    branch_scope_token = selector._branch_scope_token
    if branch_scope_token == opaque_scope_token(None):
        branch_scope_token = opaque_scope_token(branch_id)
    if selector._uses_commit_subquery:
        return PublishScopeDescriptor(
            kind="branch",
            branch_scope_token=branch_scope_token,
            staged_commits_table=selector._staged_commits_table,
            connection_id_raw=(str(selector._connection_id_raw) if selector._connection_id_raw is not None else None),
            staged_commit_ids=tuple(str(staged_commit_id) for staged_commit_id in selector._staged_commit_ids),
        )
    return PublishScopeDescriptor(
        kind="explicit",
        branch_scope_token=branch_scope_token,
        staged_commit_ids=tuple(str(staged_commit_id) for staged_commit_id in selector._staged_commit_ids),
    )


def _captured_staging_read(table: SqlTableName, branch: BranchRefInput, selector: _StagedCommitSelector) -> StagedReadRequirement:
    return StagedReadRequirement(
        source_keys=(StagedSourceKey(staged_table_name=str(table), branch_scope_token=selector._branch_scope_token),),
        scope=_scope_descriptor_from_selector(branch, selector),
    )


def _logical_model_for_sparse_publication(
    sparse_table_name: SqlTableName,
    publication_model_cls: type | None,
) -> type | None:
    """Prefer the registered logical owner of a shared physical sparse table."""
    owners = versioned_models_for_physical_table(sparse_table_name)
    return owners[0] if owners else publication_model_cls


def _sparse_versioned_fk_validation_steps(
    *,
    ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
    publication_model_cls: type | None,
    publication_table_name: SqlTableName | None,
    sparse_table_name: SqlTableName,
    staged_table_name: SqlTableName,
    branch_id: BranchRefInput,
    selector: _StagedCommitSelector,
    depends_on: frozenset[ServerPlanRefId],
    versioning_domain: type[VersioningDomain] | None = None,
) -> tuple[ServerPlanStep[None], ...]:
    """Validate only FK declarations owned by the publishing logical domain.

    A shared polymorphic table can contain model declarations from unrelated
    domains. Those declarations must not expand this commit's validation plan.
    """
    base_model = _logical_model_for_sparse_publication(sparse_table_name, publication_model_cls)
    if base_model is None:
        return ()

    from l1050_polymorphism.type_filter_helper import get_all_concrete_subtypes

    steps: list[ServerPlanStep[None]] = []
    seen_constraints: set[tuple[str, str, tuple[str, ...], tuple[str, ...], tuple[tuple[str, str], ...]]] = set()
    ref_counts: dict[str, int] = {}

    declared_domain_models = frozenset(versioning_domain.all_versioned_models()) if versioning_domain is not None else None
    source_models = tuple(
        model
        for model in dict.fromkeys((base_model, *get_all_concrete_subtypes(base_model)))
        if model is base_model or declared_domain_models is None or model in declared_domain_models
    )
    for source_model in source_models:
        for fk in iter_model_fks(source_model):
            if source_model is not base_model and not fk.target_type_names and not fk.scope_column_pairs:
                continue
            if fk.db_column == "sys_id":
                continue
            if not fk.is_versioned_target:
                continue
            if get_table_name(fk.target_model) == "graphs":
                continue
            parent_table_name = get_table_name(fk.target_model)
            constraint_key = (
                fk.db_column,
                parent_table_name,
                fk.source_type_names,
                fk.target_type_names,
                fk.scope_column_pairs,
            )
            if constraint_key in seen_constraints:
                continue
            seen_constraints.add(constraint_key)
            parent_staged_table_name = derive_versioned_table_names(
                VersionedBaseTableName(str(SchemaObjectName(str(parent_table_name))))
            ).staged
            parent_sparse_table_name = derive_versioned_table_names(
                VersionedBaseTableName(str(SchemaObjectName(str(parent_table_name))))
            ).sparse
            parent_tip_table_name = derive_versioned_table_names(
                VersionedBaseTableName(str(SchemaObjectName(str(parent_table_name))))
            ).tip
            if get_model_for_table(SqlTableName(parent_sparse_table_name)) is None:
                continue
            parent_tip_table = (
                SqlTableName(parent_tip_table_name) if get_model_for_table(SqlTableName(parent_tip_table_name)) is not None else None
            )
            target_domains = versioning_domains_for(fk.target_model)
            parent_domain = (
                versioning_domain
                if versioning_domain is not None and versioning_domain in target_domains
                else get_versioning_domain(fk.target_model)
            )
            revision_branch_index_table = get_table_name(parent_domain.revision_branch_index_model)
            parent_staged_table = SqlTableName(parent_staged_table_name)
            parent_sparse_table = SqlTableName(parent_sparse_table_name)
            ref_count = ref_counts.get(fk.db_column, 0)
            ref_counts[fk.db_column] = ref_count + 1
            ref_suffix = fk.db_column if ref_count == 0 else f"{fk.db_column}_{ref_count}"
            steps.append(
                ValidateSparseVersionedFkStep(
                    ServerPlanRefId(f"{ref_id}_validate_sparse_fk_{ref_suffix}"),
                    staged_table_name=staged_table_name,
                    parent_staged_table_name=parent_staged_table,
                    parent_sparse_table_name=parent_sparse_table,
                    parent_tip_table_name=parent_tip_table,
                    revision_branch_index_table_name=revision_branch_index_table,
                    fk_column=SqlColumnName(fk.db_column),
                    target_column=SqlColumnName(fk.target_column),
                    cross_domain=parent_domain not in versioning_domains_for(source_model),
                    source_type_names=fk.source_type_names,
                    target_type_names=fk.target_type_names,
                    scope_column_pairs=fk.scope_column_pairs,
                    branch_id=branch_id,
                    selector=selector,
                    depends_on=depends_on,
                ),
            )

    parent_table_name = publication_table_name or get_table_name(base_model)
    reverse_constraints: set[tuple[str, str, tuple[str, ...], tuple[str, ...], tuple[tuple[str, str], ...]]] = set()
    fk_edges_by_target = get_fk_edges_by_target(source_is_versioned=True)
    declared_parent_domains = versioning_domains_for(base_model)
    parent_domains = (
        (versioning_domain,)
        if versioning_domain is not None and versioning_domain in declared_parent_domains
        else declared_parent_domains
    )
    for parent_domain in parent_domains:
        for target_model, target_edges in fk_edges_by_target.items():
            if get_table_name(target_model) != parent_table_name:
                continue
            for source_model, fk in target_edges:
                if not issubclass(source_model, DatabaseObjectRow):
                    continue
                if declared_domain_models is not None and source_model not in declared_domain_models:
                    continue
                if parent_domain not in versioning_domains_for(source_model):
                    continue
                if not fk.target_type_names and not fk.scope_column_pairs:
                    continue
                child_table_name = get_table_name(source_model)
                reverse_constraint_key = (
                    str(child_table_name),
                    fk.db_column,
                    fk.source_type_names,
                    fk.target_type_names,
                    fk.scope_column_pairs,
                )
                if reverse_constraint_key in reverse_constraints:
                    continue
                reverse_constraints.add(reverse_constraint_key)
                child_sparse_table_name = derive_versioned_table_names(
                    VersionedBaseTableName(str(SchemaObjectName(str(child_table_name))))
                ).sparse
                child_staged_table_name = derive_versioned_table_names(
                    VersionedBaseTableName(str(SchemaObjectName(str(child_table_name))))
                ).staged
                if get_model_for_table(SqlTableName(child_sparse_table_name)) is None:
                    continue
                reverse_ref = ServerPlanRefId(
                    f"{ref_id}_validate_reverse_sparse_fk_{fk.db_column}_{len(reverse_constraints) - 1}",
                )
                steps.append(
                    ValidateSparseVersionedFkReverseStep(
                        reverse_ref,
                        child_staged_table_name=SqlTableName(child_staged_table_name),
                        child_sparse_table_name=SqlTableName(child_sparse_table_name),
                        parent_staged_table_name=staged_table_name,
                        parent_sparse_table_name=sparse_table_name,
                        revision_branch_index_table_name=get_table_name(
                            parent_domain.revision_branch_index_model,
                        ),
                        fk_column=SqlColumnName(fk.db_column),
                        target_column=SqlColumnName(fk.target_column),
                        source_type_names=fk.source_type_names,
                        target_type_names=fk.target_type_names,
                        scope_column_pairs=fk.scope_column_pairs,
                        branch_id=branch_id,
                        selector=selector,
                        depends_on=depends_on,
                    ),
                )
    return tuple(steps)


class StagedRowsExistStep(SqlRelationPublisherStep[bool]):
    """Return whether any staged rows exist for the selected commit scope."""

    def __init__(
        self: StagedRowsExistStep,
        ref_id: StepRefId,
        *,
        staged_table_names: Sequence[TableNameInput],
        scope: SparsePublishScope,
        config: _StagedRowsExistConfig = _StagedRowsExistConfig(),
        depends_on: DependencyRefs = frozenset(),
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        unique_tables = tuple(dict.fromkeys(staged_table_names))
        if not unique_tables:
            msg = "StagedRowsExistStep requires at least one staged table name"
            raise ValueError(msg)
        self._staged_tables = unique_tables
        self._branch_id = _normalize_branch_ref(scope.branch_id)
        self._selector = _selector_for_scope(scope)
        if config.require_non_deleted and config.require_deleted:
            msg = "StagedRowsExistStep cannot require both deleted and non-deleted rows"
            raise ValueError(msg)
        self._require_non_deleted = config.require_non_deleted
        self._require_deleted = config.require_deleted
        self._dependencies = depends_on

    def dependencies(self: StagedRowsExistStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return _commit_publish_dependencies(self._dependencies, self._branch_id)

    def sql_visible_dependencies(self: StagedRowsExistStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return _commit_publish_sql_visible_dependencies(self._branch_id)

    def preprocess(self: StagedRowsExistStep, resolved: ResolvedRefs) -> None:
        del resolved

    @property
    def level(self: StagedRowsExistStep) -> int:
        return 0

    ) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({str(self._staged_commits_table)}) if self._dependencies else frozenset()

    def compile(self: ValidateCommitBranchAdmissionStep, ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[None]:
        proof_auxiliary_ctes: tuple[tuple[str, SqlRenderable], ...] = ()
        if self._admission.allow_empty:
            ok_expr: SqlRenderable = SqlInlineLiteral(True)
        else:
            effective_staged_commits = SqlTableName(
                _resolve_staged_source(self._staged_commits_table, ctx),
            )
            selected_commit_where = SqlWhereClause(
                sql_and(
                    SqlBinaryOp(
                        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("branch_id")),
                        BinaryOp.EQ,
                        _sql_param_or_cte_scalar(self._branch_id, ctx),
                    ),
                    self._selector.match_expr(column_name=SqlColumnName("sys_id"), ctx=ctx),
                ),
            )
            proof_exists: tuple[SqlRenderable, ...] = ()
            if self._sql_proof is not None:
                producer_bindings = tuple(ctx.cte_refs.get(str(producer_ref)) for producer_ref in self._sql_proof.producer_effect_refs)
                sql_visible_bindings = tuple(
                    binding for binding in producer_bindings if isinstance(binding, CteReference) and binding.auxiliary_query is not None
                )
                if producer_bindings and len(sql_visible_bindings) == len(producer_bindings):
                    proof_auxiliary_ctes = tuple(
                        (str(binding.ref_id), binding.auxiliary_query)
                        for binding in sql_visible_bindings
                        if binding.auxiliary_query is not None
                    )
                    proof_exists = tuple(
                        SqlExists(
                            SqlSimpleSelect(
                                SqlTableName(str(binding.ref_id)),
                                SqlIntegerLiteral(1),
                            ),
                        )
                        for binding in sql_visible_bindings
                    )
                else:
                    selected_commit_ids = SqlSimpleSelect(
                        effective_staged_commits,
                        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id")),
                        selected_commit_where,
                    )
                    proof_exists = tuple(
                        SqlExists(
                            SqlSimpleSelect(
                                SqlTableName(_resolve_staged_source(source.staged_table_name, ctx)),
                                SqlIntegerLiteral(1),
                                SqlWhereClause(
                                    SqlIn(
                                        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_staged_commit_id")),
                                        selected_commit_ids,
                                    ),
                                ),
                            ),
                        )
                        for source, _generation in self._sql_proof.source_generations
                    )
            ok_expr = sql_or(
                lower_scalar_source(self._admission.is_new_branch, ctx),
                *proof_exists,
            )
        ok_query = SqlSelect(
            select_list=SqlSelectList(
                [
                    SqlSelectAlias(
                        ok_expr,
                        SqlAliasName("__result"),
                    ),
                ],
            ),
        )
        error_message = "No staged commits found for branch"
        output_shape = sql_assertion_output_shape()
        return CompiledStep(
            grammar=true_column_assertion_query(
                ok_query,
                error_message=error_message,
            ),
            needs_returning=True,
            result_relation=_result_relation_from_output_shape(output_shape),
            closed_post_op=sql_assertion_post_op(
                error_message,
                exc_type=db_exc.ProgrammingError,
            ),
            auxiliary_ctes=tuple(
                (
                    *(_auxiliary_ctes_for_dependencies(ctx, self.sql_visible_dependencies()) or ()),
                    *proof_auxiliary_ctes,
                ),
            )
            or None,
            output_shape=output_shape,
            column_type_hints=sql_assertion_column_type_hints(),
        )


def revision_identity_tables(
    ctx: LoweringContext,
    domain: type[VersioningDomain],
) -> tuple[SqlTableName, ...]:
    """Return catalog revision tables and always include the active domain."""
    catalog_models = ctx.planning_catalog.tables if ctx.planning_catalog is not None else {}
    identity_models = (*catalog_models, domain.revision_model)
    tables = tuple(
        SqlTableName(name)
        for name in sorted(
            {get_table_name(model) for model in identity_models if isinstance(model, type) and issubclass(model, BaseRevision)},
        )
    )
    if not tables:
        msg = "Global revision identity validation requires at least one revision table"
        raise RuntimeError(msg)
    return tables

def _versioned_fk_error_message(
    prefix: str,
    fk_column: SqlColumnName,
    target_type_names: tuple[str, ...],
    scope_column_pairs: tuple[tuple[str, str], ...],
) -> str:
    """Build a stable FK error with conditional constraint details."""
    details = [f"field={fk_column}"]
    if target_type_names:
        details.append(f"target_types={','.join(target_type_names)}")
    if scope_column_pairs:
        scopes = ",".join(f"{source}={target}" for source, target in scope_column_pairs)
        details.append(f"scope={scopes}")
    return f"{prefix}: {'; '.join(details)}"

                        SqlAliasName("child_sys_id"),
                    ),
                    SqlSelectAlias(
                        SqlColumnRef(self._fk_column, qualifier=staged_alias),
                        SqlAliasName("target_value"),
                    ),
                    SqlSelectAlias(
                        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("branch_id"), qualifier=staged_alias),
                        SqlAliasName("branch_id"),
                    ),
                ],
            ),
            from_=SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName(effective_staged)), staged_alias),
            where=SqlWhereClause(
                sql_and(
                    SqlBinaryOp(
                        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("branch_id"), qualifier=staged_alias),
                        BinaryOp.EQ,
                        _sql_param_or_cte_scalar(self._branch_id, ctx),
                    ),
                    self._selector.match_expr(
                        column_name=SqlColumnName("sys_staged_commit_id"),
                        qualifier=str(staged_alias),
                        ctx=ctx,
                    ),
                    self._selector.latest_row_expr(
                        staged_table=effective_staged,
                        outer_qualifier=str(staged_alias),
                        ctx=ctx,
                    ),
                    SqlIsNull(SqlColumnRef(self._fk_column, qualifier=staged_alias), negated=True),
                    *(
                        (
                            SqlIn(
                                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("type_name"), qualifier=staged_alias),
                                [SqlParam(type_name) for type_name in self._source_type_names],
                            ),
                        )
                        if self._source_type_names
                        else ()
                    ),
                    SqlUnaryOp(
                        UnaryOp.NOT,
                        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_deleted"), qualifier=staged_alias),
                    ),
                    parent_missing,
                ),
            ),
        )
        output_shape = sql_assertion_output_shape()
        auxiliary_dependency_refs = set(self.sql_visible_dependencies())
        for source_table, source_ref in (
            *ctx.staged_source_cte_by_table.items(),
            *ctx.overlay_cte_by_table.items(),
        ):
            if str(source_table) in {str(self._staged_table), str(self._parent_staged_table)}:
                auxiliary_dependency_refs.add(str(source_ref))
        error_message = _versioned_fk_error_message(
            "FK violation",
            self._fk_column,
            self._target_type_names,
            self._scope_column_pairs,
        )
        return CompiledStep(
            grammar=invalid_fk_rows_assertion_query(
                inner,
                error_message=error_message,
            ),
            needs_returning=True,
            closed_post_op=sql_assertion_post_op(
                error_message,
                exc_type=db_exc.IntegrityError,
            ),
            auxiliary_ctes=_auxiliary_ctes_for_dependencies(
                ctx,
                frozenset(auxiliary_dependency_refs),
            ),
            output_shape=output_shape,
            result_relation=_result_relation_from_output_shape(output_shape),
            column_type_hints=sql_assertion_column_type_hints(),
        )


class ValidateSparseVersionedFkReverseStep(NonPublishingStep[None]):
    """Reject parent changes that invalidate visible projected-FK children.

    The reverse check uses the pre-change target value. This preserves the
    contract in ``docs/design/versioned_fk_constraints.rst`` during key updates.
    """

    def __init__(
        self: ValidateSparseVersionedFkReverseStep,
        ref_id: StepRefId,
        *,
        child_staged_table_name: TableNameInput,
        child_sparse_table_name: TableNameInput,
        parent_staged_table_name: TableNameInput,
        parent_sparse_table_name: TableNameInput,
        revision_branch_index_table_name: TableNameInput,
        fk_column: ColumnNameInput,
        branch_id: BranchRefInput,
        target_column: ColumnNameInput = "sys_id",
        source_type_names: Sequence[str] = (),
        target_type_names: Sequence[str] = (),
        scope_column_pairs: Sequence[tuple[str, str]] = (),
        selector: _StagedCommitSelector,
        depends_on: DependencyRefs = frozenset(),
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self._child_staged_table = SqlTableName(child_staged_table_name)
        self._child_sparse_table = SqlTableName(child_sparse_table_name)
        self._parent_staged_table = SqlTableName(parent_staged_table_name)
        self._parent_sparse_table = SqlTableName(parent_sparse_table_name)
        self._revision_branch_index_table = SqlTableName(revision_branch_index_table_name)
        self._fk_column = SqlColumnName(fk_column)
        self._target_column = SqlColumnName(target_column)
        self._branch_id = _normalize_branch_ref(branch_id)
        self._source_type_names = tuple(source_type_names)
        self._target_type_names = tuple(target_type_names)
        self._scope_column_pairs = tuple(scope_column_pairs)
        self._selector = selector
        self._dependencies = depends_on

    def dependencies(self: ValidateSparseVersionedFkReverseStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return _commit_publish_dependencies(
            self._dependencies,
            self._branch_id,
            sql_visible_dependencies=self._selector.dependencies(),
        )

    def sql_visible_dependencies(self: ValidateSparseVersionedFkReverseStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return _commit_publish_sql_visible_dependencies(
            self._branch_id,
            sql_visible_dependencies=self._selector.dependencies(),
        )

    def preprocess(self: ValidateSparseVersionedFkReverseStep, resolved: ResolvedRefs) -> None:
        del resolved

    @property
    def level(self: ValidateSparseVersionedFkReverseStep) -> int:
        return 0

    def result_cardinality(self: ValidateSparseVersionedFkReverseStep) -> Cardinality:
        return Cardinality.NONE

    def is_read_only(self: ValidateSparseVersionedFkReverseStep) -> bool:
        return True

    def step_tags(self: ValidateSparseVersionedFkReverseStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({"read", "fk", "grammar", "validation", "reverse", "__exists"})

    def supports_sql_batch_transport(self: ValidateSparseVersionedFkReverseStep) -> bool:
        return True

    def consumes_repeatable_post_write_relations(self: ValidateSparseVersionedFkReverseStep) -> bool:
        return True

    def tables_read(self: ValidateSparseVersionedFkReverseStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return (
            frozenset(
                {
                    self._child_staged_table,
                    self._child_sparse_table,
                    self._parent_staged_table,
                    self._parent_sparse_table,
                    self._revision_branch_index_table,
                },
            )
            | self._selector.tables_read()
        )

    def tables_written(self: ValidateSparseVersionedFkReverseStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def cte_rewritable_read_tables(self: ValidateSparseVersionedFkReverseStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset(str(table) for table in self.tables_read())

    def staged_read_descriptor(self: ValidateSparseVersionedFkReverseStep) -> StagedReadRequirement | None:
        return StagedReadRequirement(
            source_keys=(
                StagedSourceKey(
                    staged_table_name=self._child_staged_table,
                    branch_scope_token=self._selector._branch_scope_token,
                ),
                StagedSourceKey(
                    staged_table_name=self._parent_staged_table,
                    branch_scope_token=self._selector._branch_scope_token,
                ),
            ),
            scope=_scope_descriptor_from_selector(self._branch_id, self._selector),
        )

    def compile(self: ValidateSparseVersionedFkReverseStep, ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[None]:
        effective_child_staged = _resolve_staged_source(self._child_staged_table, ctx)
        effective_parent_staged = _resolve_staged_source(self._parent_staged_table, ctx)
        child_alias = SqlAliasName("reverse_fk_child")
        parent_alias = SqlAliasName("reverse_fk_parent_staged")
        old_parent_alias = SqlAliasName("reverse_fk_parent_published")
        old_parent_branch_index_alias = SqlAliasName("reverse_fk_parent_branch_index")
        child_override_alias = SqlAliasName("reverse_fk_child_staged_override")
        branch_index_alias = SqlAliasName("reverse_fk_child_branch_index")
        valid_to_index_alias = SqlAliasName("reverse_fk_child_valid_to_index")
        tombstone_alias = SqlAliasName("reverse_fk_child_tombstone")

        inherited_child_branch_match = SqlExists(
            SqlSelect(
                select_list=SqlIntegerLiteral(1),
                from_=SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(self._revision_branch_index_table), branch_index_alias),
                where=sql_and(
                    SqlBinaryOp(
                        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("revision_sys_id"), qualifier=branch_index_alias),
                        BinaryOp.EQ,
                        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_valid_from_revision_id"), qualifier=child_alias),
                    ),
                    SqlBinaryOp(
                        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("branch_sys_id"), qualifier=branch_index_alias),
                        BinaryOp.EQ,
                        _sql_param_or_cte_scalar(self._branch_id, ctx),
                    ),
                ),
            ),
        )
        child_valid_to_visible = SqlExists(
            SqlSelect(
                select_list=SqlIntegerLiteral(1),
                from_=SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(self._revision_branch_index_table), valid_to_index_alias),
                where=sql_and(
                    SqlBinaryOp(
                        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("revision_sys_id"), qualifier=valid_to_index_alias),
                        BinaryOp.EQ,
                        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_valid_to_revision_id"), qualifier=child_alias),
                    ),
                    SqlBinaryOp(
                        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("branch_sys_id"), qualifier=valid_to_index_alias),
                        BinaryOp.EQ,
                        _sql_param_or_cte_scalar(self._branch_id, ctx),
                    ),
                ),
            ),
        )
        current_branch_tombstone = SqlExists(
            SqlSelect(
                select_list=SqlIntegerLiteral(1),
                from_=SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(self._child_sparse_table), tombstone_alias),
                where=sql_and(
                    SqlBinaryOp(
                        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id"), qualifier=tombstone_alias),
                        BinaryOp.EQ,
                        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id"), qualifier=child_alias),
                    ),
                    SqlBinaryOp(
                        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("branch_id"), qualifier=tombstone_alias),
                        BinaryOp.EQ,
                        _sql_param_or_cte_scalar(self._branch_id, ctx),
                    ),
                    SqlIsNull(SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_valid_to_revision_id"), qualifier=tombstone_alias)),
                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_deleted"), qualifier=tombstone_alias),
                ),
            ),
        )
        child_staged_override = SqlExists(
            SqlSelect(
                select_list=SqlIntegerLiteral(1),
                from_=SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName(effective_child_staged)), child_override_alias),
                where=sql_and(
                    SqlBinaryOp(
                        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id"), qualifier=child_override_alias),
                        BinaryOp.EQ,
                        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id"), qualifier=child_alias),
                    ),
                    SqlBinaryOp(
                        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("branch_id"), qualifier=child_override_alias),
                        BinaryOp.EQ,
                        _sql_param_or_cte_scalar(self._branch_id, ctx),
                    ),
                    self._selector.match_expr(
                        column_name=SqlColumnName("sys_staged_commit_id"),
                        qualifier=str(child_override_alias),
                        ctx=ctx,
                    ),
                    self._selector.latest_row_expr(
                        staged_table=effective_child_staged,
                        outer_qualifier=str(child_override_alias),
                        ctx=ctx,
                    ),
                ),
            ),
        )
        valid_parent_conditions: list[SqlRenderable] = [
            SqlBinaryOp(
                SqlColumnRef(self._target_column, qualifier=parent_alias),
                BinaryOp.EQ,
                SqlColumnRef(self._target_column, qualifier=old_parent_alias),
            ),
        ]
        if self._target_type_names:
            valid_parent_conditions.append(
                SqlIn(
                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("type_name"), qualifier=parent_alias),
                    [SqlParam(type_name) for type_name in self._target_type_names],
                ),
            )
        valid_parent_conditions.extend(
            SqlBinaryOp(
                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(target_column), qualifier=parent_alias),
                BinaryOp.EQ,
                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(source_column), qualifier=child_alias),
            )
            for source_column, target_column in self._scope_column_pairs
        )
        old_parent_inherited_branch_match = SqlExists(
            SqlSelect(
                select_list=SqlIntegerLiteral(1),
                from_=SqlTableAlias(
                    SqlTableIdent(self._revision_branch_index_table),
                    old_parent_branch_index_alias,
                ),
                where=sql_and(
                    SqlBinaryOp(
                        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("revision_sys_id"), qualifier=old_parent_branch_index_alias),
                        BinaryOp.EQ,
                        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_valid_from_revision_id"), qualifier=old_parent_alias),
                    ),
                    SqlBinaryOp(
                        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("branch_sys_id"), qualifier=old_parent_branch_index_alias),
                        BinaryOp.EQ,
                        _sql_param_or_cte_scalar(self._branch_id, ctx),
                    ),
                ),
            ),
        )
        inner = SqlSelect(
            select_list=SqlIntegerLiteral(1),
            from_=SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(self._child_sparse_table), child_alias),
            joins=(
                SqlJoin(
                    "INNER",
                    SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName(effective_parent_staged)), parent_alias),
                    sql_and(
                        SqlBinaryOp(
                            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("branch_id"), qualifier=parent_alias),
                            BinaryOp.EQ,
                            _sql_param_or_cte_scalar(self._branch_id, ctx),
                        ),
                        self._selector.match_expr(
                            column_name=SqlColumnName("sys_staged_commit_id"),
                            qualifier=str(parent_alias),
                            ctx=ctx,
                        ),
                        self._selector.latest_row_expr(
                            staged_table=effective_parent_staged,
                            outer_qualifier=str(parent_alias),
                            ctx=ctx,
                        ),
                        SqlUnaryOp(
                            UnaryOp.NOT,
                            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_deleted"), qualifier=parent_alias),
                        ),
                    ),
                ),
                SqlJoin(
                    "INNER",
                    SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(self._parent_sparse_table), old_parent_alias),
                    sql_and(
                        SqlBinaryOp(
                            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id"), qualifier=old_parent_alias),
                            BinaryOp.EQ,
                            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id"), qualifier=parent_alias),
                        ),
                        SqlBinaryOp(
                            SqlColumnRef(self._target_column, qualifier=old_parent_alias),
                            BinaryOp.EQ,
                            SqlColumnRef(self._fk_column, qualifier=child_alias),
                        ),
                        sql_or(
                            SqlBinaryOp(
                                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("branch_id"), qualifier=old_parent_alias),
                                BinaryOp.EQ,
                                _sql_param_or_cte_scalar(self._branch_id, ctx),
                            ),
                            old_parent_inherited_branch_match,
                        ),
                        SqlUnaryOp(
                            UnaryOp.NOT,
                            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_deleted"), qualifier=old_parent_alias),
                        ),
                    ),
                ),
            ),
            where=SqlWhereClause(
                sql_and(
                    sql_or(
                        SqlBinaryOp(
                            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("branch_id"), qualifier=child_alias),
                            BinaryOp.EQ,
                            _sql_param_or_cte_scalar(self._branch_id, ctx),
                        ),
                        inherited_child_branch_match,
                    ),
                    sql_or(
                        SqlIsNull(SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_valid_to_revision_id"), qualifier=child_alias)),
                        SqlUnaryOp(UnaryOp.NOT, child_valid_to_visible),
                    ),
                    SqlUnaryOp(UnaryOp.NOT, SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_deleted"), qualifier=child_alias)),
                    SqlUnaryOp(UnaryOp.NOT, current_branch_tombstone),
                    SqlUnaryOp(UnaryOp.NOT, child_staged_override),
                    SqlIsNull(SqlColumnRef(self._fk_column, qualifier=child_alias), negated=True),
                    *(
                        (
                            SqlIn(
                                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("type_name"), qualifier=child_alias),
                                [SqlParam(type_name) for type_name in self._source_type_names],
                            ),
                        )
                        if self._source_type_names
                        else ()
                    ),
                    SqlUnaryOp(UnaryOp.NOT, sql_and(*valid_parent_conditions)),
                ),
            ),
        )
        grammar = SqlSelectExistsFromSubquery(inner)
        output_shape = sql_assertion_output_shape()
        error_message = _versioned_fk_error_message(
            "FK violation after parent update",
            self._fk_column,
            self._target_type_names,
            self._scope_column_pairs,
        )
        return CompiledStep(
            grammar=false_exists_assertion_query(grammar, error_message=error_message),
            needs_returning=True,
            closed_post_op=sql_assertion_post_op(error_message, exc_type=db_exc.IntegrityError),
            auxiliary_ctes=_auxiliary_ctes_for_dependencies(ctx, self.sql_visible_dependencies()),
            output_shape=output_shape,
            result_relation=_result_relation_from_output_shape(output_shape),
            column_type_hints=sql_assertion_column_type_hints(),
        )
