def _physical_projection_tables_read(columns: frozenset[str]) -> frozenset[str]:
    tables: set[str] = set()
    if {"branch_ord", "sys_valid_from_seq", "sys_valid_to_seq", "sys_revision_seq"} & columns:
        tables.update(("sys_branch_physical_keys", "sys_revision_physical_keys"))
    if {"graph_key", "source_node_key", "target_node_key"} & columns:
        tables.update(("sys_graph_physical_keys", "sys_graph_node_physical_keys"))
    return frozenset(tables)


def _physical_projection_columns_proven_by_schema(
    table_name: SqlTableName,
    columns: frozenset[str],
    ctx: CompilationContext,
) -> frozenset[str]:
    if not columns:
        return frozenset()
    model_cls = get_model_for_table(table_name)
    if model_cls is not None:
        return columns.intersection(get_db_column_map(model_cls).values())
    if ctx.schema_column_cache is None:
        return frozenset()

    cached_columns = ctx.schema_column_cache.get(str(table_name), frozenset())
    return columns.intersection(cached_columns)


def _publication_source_model_for_physical_table(
    table_name: SqlTableName,
) -> type[BaseModel] | None:
    """Return the logical model whose generated columns must not be copied during publish."""

    table_name_text = str(table_name)
    for suffix in ("_sparse", "_tip"):
        if table_name_text.endswith(suffix):
            logical_model = get_model_for_table(SqlTableName(table_name_text.removesuffix(suffix)))
            if isinstance(logical_model, type) and issubclass(logical_model, BaseModel):
                return logical_model
    logical_model = get_model_for_table(SqlTableName(table_name_text))
    if isinstance(logical_model, type) and issubclass(logical_model, BaseModel):
        return logical_model
    return None


def _publish_columns_for_model(model: type[BaseModel] | None) -> set[str] | None:
    """Return writable physical columns for one sparse publication target."""
    if model is None:
        return None
    column_map = get_db_column_map(model)
    return {
        column_map[DynamicFieldName(field_name)]
        for field_name, field_info in model.model_fields.items()
        if not is_database_generated_column(field_info)
    }


def _physical_key_source(ctx: CompilationContext, table_name: SqlTableName) -> str:
    """Resolve a physical-key lookup source, preferring same-statement overlays."""
    return ctx.overlay_cte_by_table.get(table_name, table_name)


def _derived_publish_expr_for_data_column(
    model: type[BaseModel] | None,
    column_name: SqlColumnName,
    *,
    ctx: CompilationContext,
    source_qualifier: str | None,
) -> SqlRenderable | None:
    if model is None:
        return None
    column_map = get_db_column_map(model)
    for field_name, field_info in model.model_fields.items():
        if column_map[DynamicFieldName(field_name)] != column_name:
            continue
        if not is_derived_column(field_info):
            return None
        derived_expr = get_derived_expression(field_info)
        if derived_expr is None:
            return None
        dialect = ctx.sql_render_dialect()
        from impl.common.l3000_schema_builder.ddl_expression import expression_to_ddl_grammar

        column_refs = {
            model_field_name: SqlColumnRef(
                SqlColumnName(column_map[DynamicFieldName(model_field_name)]),
                source_qualifier,
            )
            for model_field_name in model.model_fields
        }
        return expression_to_ddl_grammar(
            derived_expr,
            dialect,
            cast("dict[str, SqlRenderable]", column_refs),
        )
    return None


def _tip_fk_parent_tables_requiring_prior_visibility(
    publication_model_cls: type | None,
    sparse_table_name: SqlTableName,
) -> frozenset[SqlTableName]:
    model_cls = _logical_model_for_sparse_publication(sparse_table_name, publication_model_cls)
    if model_cls is None:
        return frozenset()

    parent_tip_tables: set[SqlTableName] = set()
    for fk in iter_model_fks(model_cls):
        if not fk.is_versioned_target:
            continue
        parent_tip_table_name = derive_versioned_table_names(
            VersionedBaseTableName(str(SchemaObjectName(str(get_table_name(fk.target_model)))))
        ).tip
        if get_model_for_table(SqlTableName(parent_tip_table_name)) is not None:
            parent_tip_tables.add(SqlTableName(parent_tip_table_name))
    return frozenset(parent_tip_tables)

def _with_default_schema_revision_metadata(revision_metadata: Mapping[str, object]) -> dict[str, object]:
    metadata = dict(revision_metadata)
    has_schema_hash = bool(str(metadata.get("schema_hash") or ""))
    has_schema_epoch = metadata.get("json_schema_epoch") is not None
    if has_schema_hash and has_schema_epoch:
        return metadata
    if has_schema_hash != has_schema_epoch:
        msg = (
            "Revision metadata must publish schema_hash and json_schema_epoch together; "
            "runtime schema metadata capture is forbidden for partial metadata."
        )
        raise db_exc.ProgrammingError(msg)
    snapshot = capture_schema_metadata_snapshot()
    metadata["schema_hash"] = snapshot.schema_hash
    metadata["json_schema_epoch"] = snapshot.json_schema_epoch
    return metadata


def _with_planning_schema_revision_metadata(revision_metadata: Mapping[str, object]) -> dict[str, object]:
    """Include defaulted schema metadata columns without runtime snapshot capture."""
    metadata = dict(revision_metadata)
    has_schema_hash = bool(str(metadata.get("schema_hash") or ""))
    has_schema_epoch = metadata.get("json_schema_epoch") is not None
    if has_schema_hash != has_schema_epoch:
        msg = (
            "Revision metadata must publish schema_hash and json_schema_epoch together; "
            "runtime schema metadata capture is forbidden for partial metadata."
        )
        raise db_exc.ProgrammingError(msg)
    metadata.setdefault("schema_hash", "")
    metadata.setdefault("json_schema_epoch", 0)
    return metadata


def _revision_metadata_db_columns[MetadataValueT](
    revision_model_cls: type[BaseRevision],
    revision_metadata: Mapping[str, MetadataValueT],
) -> tuple[tuple[str, str, MetadataValueT], ...]:
    model_fields = revision_model_cls.model_fields
    return tuple(
        (
            key,
            get_db_column_name(revision_model_cls, DynamicFieldName(key)) if key in model_fields else key,
            value,
        )
        for key, value in revision_metadata.items()
    )

def build_sparse_publish_steps(
    *,
    ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
    scope: SparsePublishScope,
    new_revision_id: RevisionId | ScalarServerRef[RevisionId],
    sparse_table_name: SqlTableName,
    staged_table_name: SqlTableName,
    tip_table_name: SqlTableName,
    publication_model_cls: type | None = None,
    publication_table_name: SqlTableName | None = None,
    sparse_data_columns: Sequence[str],
    tip_data_columns: Sequence[str],
    log_table_name: SqlTableName | None,
    staged_returning_columns: Sequence[str] | None = None,
    initial_dependencies: frozenset[ServerPlanRefId] = frozenset(),
    before_close_step_factory: Callable[
        [frozenset[ServerPlanRefId], ServerPlanRefId | None],
        Sequence[ServerPlanStep[Any]],
    ]
    | None = None,
    after_close_step_factory: Callable[
        [frozenset[ServerPlanRefId], ServerPlanRefId | None],
        Sequence[ServerPlanStep[Any]],
    ]
    | None = None,
    after_insert_step_factory: Callable[
        [frozenset[ServerPlanRefId], ServerPlanRefId | None],
        Sequence[ServerPlanStep[Any]],
    ]
    | None = None,
    commit_delta_step_builder: CommitDeltaStepBuilder | None = None,
    commit_delta_type_discriminator_columns: Sequence[SqlColumnName] = (),
    commit_delta_graph_routes: Sequence[ExactGraphRouteDescriptor] = (),
    commit_delta_staged_cleanup_boundary: ServerPlanRefId | None = None,
    log_depends_on_publish_chain: bool = True,
    materialize_tip: TipMaterializationPolicy = True,
    collect_deleted_count: bool = True,
    include_delete_staged: bool = True,
    enable_postgres_shared_rowset: bool = False,
    version_key_dependency_ref: ServerPlanRefId | None = None,
    speculative_insert_only: bool = False,
    tip_fk_parent_tables_requiring_prior_visibility: frozenset[SqlTableName] | None = None,
    versioning_domain: type[VersioningDomain] | None = None,
    affected_rows_sql_transport: bool | None = None,
    affected_rows_branch_source_ref: ServerPlanRefId | None = None,
) -> list[ServerPlanStep[Any]]:
    """Build the shared sparse publish chain for branch and explicit-ID commit flows.

    Cleanup (``DeleteStagedForCommitStep``) is always included in the returned
    publish chain so the optimizer can fuse it with the upstream CTE writes.
    The staged-publish fusion optimizer and overlay-aware DMCTE strategy are
    responsible for preserving same-statement staged visibility on
    CTE-snapshot-isolated backends; see
    ``docs/design/BATCHING_FAILURE_COMMIT_PUBLISH_ANALYSIS.md``.
    """

    steps: list[ServerPlanStep[Any]] = []
    current_dependencies = initial_dependencies
    close_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{ref_id}_close_sparse")
    branch_id = _normalize_branch_ref(scope.branch_id)
    revision_ref = _normalize_revision_ref(new_revision_id)
    sparse_table = sparse_table_name
    staged_table = staged_table_name
    tip_table = tip_table_name
    log_table = log_table_name
    selector = _selector_for_scope(scope)
    sparse_columns = set(sparse_data_columns)
    tip_columns = set(tip_data_columns)
    if staged_returning_columns is not None:
        staged_columns = set(staged_returning_columns)
    else:
        staged_model = get_model_for_table(SqlTableName(staged_table_name))
        staged_columns = (
            {get_db_column_name(staged_model, DynamicFieldName(name)) for name in staged_model.model_fields}
            if staged_model is not None
            else sparse_columns | tip_columns
        )
    sparse_model = get_model_for_table(SqlTableName(sparse_table_name))
    tip_model = get_model_for_table(SqlTableName(tip_table_name))
    sparse_writable_columns = _publish_columns_for_model(
        sparse_model or _publication_source_model_for_physical_table(sparse_table_name),
    )
    if sparse_writable_columns is not None:
        sparse_data_columns = tuple(column for column in sparse_data_columns if str(column) in sparse_writable_columns)
        sparse_columns = set(sparse_data_columns)
    tip_writable_columns = _publish_columns_for_model(
        tip_model or _publication_source_model_for_physical_table(tip_table_name),
    )
    if tip_writable_columns is not None:
        tip_data_columns = tuple(column for column in tip_data_columns if str(column) in tip_writable_columns)
        tip_columns = set(tip_data_columns)
    projection_policy = publish_projection_policy(
        sparse_model=sparse_model,
        tip_model=tip_model,
        sparse_columns=frozenset(SqlColumnName(column) for column in sparse_columns),
        tip_columns=frozenset(SqlColumnName(column) for column in tip_columns),
        staged_columns=frozenset(SqlColumnName(column) for column in staged_columns),
    )
    sparse_physical_projection_columns = projection_policy.sparse_projection_columns
    tip_physical_projection_columns = projection_policy.tip_projection_columns
    if publication_model_cls is not None:
        assert issubclass(publication_model_cls, BaseModel)
        declared_db_columns = {
            str(get_db_column_name(publication_model_cls, DynamicFieldName(field_name)))
            for field_name in publication_model_cls.model_fields
        }

        def _retain_framework_projection(column: str) -> bool:
            return column not in declared_db_columns or is_framework_physical_db_column(
                publication_model_cls,
                SqlColumnName(column),
            )

        sparse_physical_projection_columns = frozenset(
            column for column in sparse_physical_projection_columns if _retain_framework_projection(column)
        )
        tip_physical_projection_columns = frozenset(
            column for column in tip_physical_projection_columns if _retain_framework_projection(column)
        )
    tip_fk_parent_visibility_tables = (
        tip_fk_parent_tables_requiring_prior_visibility
        if tip_fk_parent_tables_requiring_prior_visibility is not None
        else _tip_fk_parent_tables_requiring_prior_visibility(publication_model_cls, sparse_table)
    )
    shared_rowset_ref: ServerPlanRefId | None = None

    if projection_policy.ensure_version_keys:
        if version_key_dependency_ref is not None:
            current_dependencies = current_dependencies | frozenset({version_key_dependency_ref})
        else:
            branch_key_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{ref_id}_insert_branch_key")
            steps.append(
                InsertBranchPhysicalKeyStep(
                    branch_key_ref,
                    branch_id,
                    depends_on=current_dependencies,
                ),
            )
            revision_key_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{ref_id}_insert_revision_key")
            steps.append(
                InsertRevisionPhysicalKeyStep(
                    revision_key_ref,
                    revision_ref,
                    depends_on=frozenset({branch_key_ref}),
                ),
            )
            current_dependencies = frozenset({revision_key_ref})

    shared_projection_columns = sparse_physical_projection_columns | tip_physical_projection_columns
    shared_payload_columns = (
        column
        for column in (*sparse_data_columns, *tip_data_columns)
        if not (
            is_framework_physical_db_column(sparse_model, SqlColumnName(column))
            or is_framework_physical_db_column(tip_model, SqlColumnName(column))
        )
    )
    shared_data_columns = tuple(SqlColumnName(column) for column in dict.fromkeys(shared_payload_columns))
    if enable_postgres_shared_rowset and before_close_step_factory is None and after_close_step_factory is None:
        shared_rowset_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{ref_id}_affected_rows")
        steps.append(
            AffectedStagedRowsStep(
                shared_rowset_ref,
                staged_table,
                branch_id,
                selector,
                data_columns=shared_data_columns,
                publication_model_cls=publication_model_cls,
                depends_on=current_dependencies,
            ),
        )
        current_dependencies = frozenset({shared_rowset_ref})

    if before_close_step_factory is not None:
        for step in before_close_step_factory(current_dependencies, shared_rowset_ref):
            steps.append(step)
            current_dependencies = frozenset({step.ref_id})

    if not speculative_insert_only:
        steps.append(
            CloseSparseWindowsStep(
                close_ref,
                sparse_table,
                staged_table,
                branch_id,
                selector,
                revision_ref,
                depends_on=current_dependencies,
                project_valid_to_seq=_step_flag("sys_valid_to_seq" in sparse_physical_projection_columns),
                affected_rows_ref=shared_rowset_ref,
            ),
        )
        current_dependencies = frozenset({close_ref})

    if after_close_step_factory is not None:
        for step in after_close_step_factory(current_dependencies, shared_rowset_ref):
            steps.append(step)
            current_dependencies = frozenset({step.ref_id})

    for step in _sparse_versioned_fk_validation_steps(
        ref_id=ref_id,
        publication_model_cls=publication_model_cls,
        publication_table_name=publication_table_name,
        sparse_table_name=sparse_table,
        staged_table_name=staged_table,
        branch_id=branch_id,
        selector=selector,
        depends_on=current_dependencies,
        versioning_domain=versioning_domain,
    ):
        steps.append(step)
        current_dependencies = frozenset({step.ref_id})

    if projection_policy.ensure_graph_keys:
        graph_key_steps: tuple[ServerPlanStep[Any], ...] = (
            InsertGraphPhysicalKeysStep(
                ServerPlanRefId(f"{ref_id}_insert_graph_keys"),
                staged_table,
                branch_id,
                selector,
                depends_on=current_dependencies,
            ),
            InsertGraphNodePhysicalKeysStep(
                ServerPlanRefId(f"{ref_id}_insert_node_keys"),
                staged_table,
                SqlColumnName("source_sys_id"),
                branch_id,
                selector,
                additional_node_columns=(SqlColumnName("target_sys_id"),),
                depends_on=frozenset({ServerPlanRefId(f"{ref_id}_insert_graph_keys")}),
            ),
        )
        for step in graph_key_steps:
            steps.append(step)
            current_dependencies = frozenset({step.ref_id})

    if commit_delta_step_builder is not None and shared_rowset_ref is None:
        shared_rowset_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{ref_id}_affected_rows")
        steps.append(
            AffectedStagedRowsStep(
                shared_rowset_ref,
                staged_table,
                branch_id,
                selector,
                data_columns=shared_data_columns,
                publication_model_cls=publication_model_cls,
                depends_on=current_dependencies,
                sql_transport=affected_rows_sql_transport,
                branch_source_ref=affected_rows_branch_source_ref,
            ),
        )
        current_dependencies = frozenset({shared_rowset_ref})

    if _tip_policy_is_statically_materialized(materialize_tip) is not False:
        delete_tip_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{ref_id}_delete_tip_tombstones")
        if not speculative_insert_only:
            steps.append(
                DeleteTipTombstonesStep(
                    delete_tip_ref,
                    tip_table,
                    staged_table,
                    branch_id,
                    selector,
                    depends_on=current_dependencies,
                    affected_rows_ref=shared_rowset_ref,
                    materialize_tip=materialize_tip,
                ),
            )
            current_dependencies = frozenset({delete_tip_ref})

        upsert_tip_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{ref_id}_upsert_tip")
        steps.append(
            UpsertTipFromStagedStep(
                upsert_tip_ref,
                tip_table,
                staged_table,
                branch_id,
                selector,
                revision_ref,
                config=_SparseDataColumnsConfig(
                    data_columns=tuple(tip_data_columns),
                    physical_projection_columns=tip_physical_projection_columns,
                    depends_on=current_dependencies,
                    affected_rows_ref=shared_rowset_ref,
                    tip_fk_parent_tables_requiring_prior_visibility=tip_fk_parent_visibility_tables,
                ),
                materialize_tip=materialize_tip,
            ),
        )
        current_dependencies = frozenset({upsert_tip_ref})

    insert_sparse_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{ref_id}_insert_sparse")
    steps.append(
        InsertSparseFromStagedStep(
            insert_sparse_ref,
            sparse_table,
            staged_table,
            branch_id,
            selector,
            revision_ref,
            config=_SparseDataColumnsConfig(
                data_columns=tuple(sparse_data_columns),
                physical_projection_columns=sparse_physical_projection_columns,
                depends_on=current_dependencies,
                affected_rows_ref=shared_rowset_ref,
            ),
        ),
    )
    current_dependencies = frozenset({insert_sparse_ref})

    from l9600_graphs.graph import GraphEdge
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.incident_posting_steps import MaintainIncidentPostingsStep

    if publication_model_cls is not None and issubclass(publication_model_cls, GraphEdge):
        posting_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{ref_id}_incident_postings")
        steps.append(
            MaintainIncidentPostingsStep(
                posting_ref,
                sparse_table=SqlTableName(sparse_table),
                edge_table=SqlTableName(str(get_table_name(publication_model_cls))),
                branch_ref=branch_id,
                revision_ref=revision_ref,
                depends_on=current_dependencies,
            )
        )
        current_dependencies = frozenset({posting_ref})

    if commit_delta_step_builder is not None:
        cleanup_boundary = commit_delta_staged_cleanup_boundary
        if cleanup_boundary is None:
            if not include_delete_staged:
                raise ValueError("A commit delta source requires a staged cleanup boundary")
            cleanup_boundary = ServerPlanRefId(f"{ref_id}_delete_staged")
        if publication_model_cls is None:
            raise ValueError("A commit delta source requires a publication model")
        delta_source = VersionedCommitDeltaSource(
            model_cls=publication_model_cls,
            logical_table=publication_table_name or get_table_name(publication_model_cls),
            staged_table=staged_table,
            sparse_table=sparse_table,
            selector=selector,
            branch_ref=branch_id,
            revision_ref=revision_ref,
            data_columns=tuple(
                column
                for column in shared_data_columns
                if str(column) in staged_columns and column not in commit_delta_type_discriminator_columns
            ),
            type_discriminator_columns=tuple(commit_delta_type_discriminator_columns),
            graph_routes=tuple(commit_delta_graph_routes),
            sparse_publish_tail=insert_sparse_ref,
            staged_cleanup_boundary=cleanup_boundary,
            affected_rows_ref=shared_rowset_ref,
            branch_relation_ref=(shared_rowset_ref if affected_rows_branch_source_ref is not None else None),
        )
        for step in commit_delta_step_builder.build(delta_source):
            steps.append(step)
            current_dependencies = frozenset({step.ref_id})

    if after_insert_step_factory is not None:
        for step in after_insert_step_factory(current_dependencies, shared_rowset_ref):
            steps.append(step)
            current_dependencies = frozenset({step.ref_id})

    if log_table is not None:
        log_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{ref_id}_update_log")
        log_dependencies = current_dependencies if log_depends_on_publish_chain else frozenset()
        log_step = UpdateLogEntriesStep(
            log_ref,
            log_table,
            revision_ref,
            selector,
            depends_on=log_dependencies,
        )
        steps.append(log_step)
        if log_depends_on_publish_chain:
            current_dependencies = frozenset({log_ref})

    if include_delete_staged:
        delete_staged_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{ref_id}_delete_staged")
        cleanup_collect_deleted_count = collect_deleted_count
        if enable_postgres_shared_rowset:
            cleanup_collect_deleted_count = False
        steps.append(
            DeleteStagedForCommitStep(
                delete_staged_ref,
                staged_table,
                branch_id,
                selector,
                config=_DeleteStagedForCommitConfig(
                    returning_columns=None,
                    collect_deleted_count=cleanup_collect_deleted_count,
                ),
                publication_model_cls=publication_model_cls,
                depends_on=current_dependencies,
            ),
        )
        current_dependencies = frozenset({delete_staged_ref})

    return steps


def _affected_rows_source_table(
    affected_rows_ref: ServerPlanRefId | None,
    ctx: CompilationContext,
    *,
    required_columns: frozenset[str] = frozenset({"sys_id"}),
) -> str | None:
    if (
        affected_rows_ref is None
        or ctx.backend_profile.traits.versioned_staging_transport is not VersionedStagingTransport.SAME_STATEMENT_RELATION
    ):
        return None
    binding = ctx.cte_refs.get(str(affected_rows_ref))
    if binding is None:
        return None
    if binding.columns is not None and not required_columns.issubset(frozenset(binding.columns)):
        return None
    if binding.ref_id.startswith("published_") and binding.auxiliary_query is None:
        return None
    return binding.ref_id

def _known_columns_for_sql_source(
    table_or_cte: TableNameInput,
    ctx: CompilationContext,
) -> frozenset[str] | None:
    source_name = str(table_or_cte)
    cte_ref = ctx.cte_refs.get(source_name) if ctx.cte_refs is not None else None
    if cte_ref is not None and cte_ref.columns:
        return frozenset(cte_ref.columns)
    if ctx.schema_column_cache is None:
        return None
    return ctx.schema_column_cache.get(source_name)


def _filter_columns_known_to_sql_sources(
    columns: Sequence[str],
    ctx: CompilationContext,
    *sources: TableNameInput,
) -> tuple[str, ...]:
    filtered = tuple(dict.fromkeys(columns))
    if not sources:
        return filtered
    known_sources = tuple(
        known_columns for source in sources if (known_columns := _known_columns_for_sql_source(source, ctx)) is not None
    )
    if not known_sources:
        return filtered
    return tuple(
        column
        for column in filtered
        if column == "sys_fts_content_hash" or all(column in known_columns for known_columns in known_sources)
    )


def _compile_close_sparse_windows_step(
    *,
    sparse_table_name: SqlTableName,
    staged_table_name: SqlTableName,
    branch_id: BranchId | LazyResult[BranchId] | ScalarServerRef[BranchId],
    revision_id: RevisionId | ScalarServerRef[RevisionId],
    selector: _StagedCommitSelector,
    ctx: CompilationContext,
    project_valid_to_seq: bool,
    affected_rows_ref: ServerPlanRefId | None = None,
) -> CompiledStep[None]:
    effective_staged = _resolve_staged_source(
        SqlTableName(staged_table_name),
        ctx,
        selector=selector,
    )
    affected_source = _affected_rows_source_table(affected_rows_ref, ctx)
    staged_where = sql_and(
        SqlBinaryOp(
            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("branch_id")),
            BinaryOp.EQ,
            _sql_param_or_cte_scalar(branch_id, ctx),
        ),
        selector.match_expr(column_name=SqlColumnName("sys_staged_commit_id"), ctx=ctx),
    )
    if ctx.backend_profile.traits.sparse_window_transport is SparseWindowTransport.UPDATE_FROM:
        from l2070_batching.output_shape import CompiledOutputShape, DeclaredResultRelation, synthetic_output_field

        sparse_alias = "sparse"
        updated_rows_cte = f"{sparse_table_name}_closed_sparse_rows"
        source_table = SqlTableName(affected_source or effective_staged)
        staged_source = SqlDynamicSelectStmt(
            from_table=source_table,
            columns=[SqlColumnName("sys_id")],
            where_conditions=(
                []
                if affected_source is not None
                else [
                    staged_where,
                    selector.latest_row_expr(
                        staged_table=effective_staged,
                        outer_qualifier=effective_staged,
                        ctx=ctx,
                    ),
                ]
            ),
        )
        sparse_sys_id_matches_staged = _SqlEqualsAnyArraySubquery(
            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id"), qualifier=sparse_alias),
            staged_source,
        )
        sparse_close_target = sparse_sys_id_matches_staged
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.versioning.revision_ancestry_lowering import (
            lower_revision_in_ancestry_condition,
        )

        sibling_sparse_alias = SqlAliasName("sibling_sparse")
        no_sibling_branch_row = SqlExists(
            SqlSelect(
                select=SqlSelectList(
                    [
                        SqlSelectAlias(
                            SqlIntegerLiteral(1),
                            SqlAliasName("one"),
                        ),
                    ],
                ),
                from_=SqlTableAlias(
                    SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName(sparse_table_name)),
                    sibling_sparse_alias,
                ),
                where=sql_and(
                    SqlBinaryOp(
                        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id"), qualifier=sibling_sparse_alias),
                        BinaryOp.EQ,
                        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id"), qualifier=sparse_alias),
                    ),
                    SqlBinaryOp(
                        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("branch_id"), qualifier=sibling_sparse_alias),
                        BinaryOp.IS_DISTINCT_FROM,
                        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("branch_id"), qualifier=sparse_alias),
                    ),
                    SqlIsNull(
                        SqlColumnRef(
                            SqlColumnName("sys_valid_to_revision_id"),
                            qualifier=sibling_sparse_alias,
                        ),
                    ),
                ),
            ),
            negated=True,
        )
        updated_rows_stmt = SqlUpdate(
            table=SqlTableAlias(
                SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName(sparse_table_name)),
                SqlAliasName(sparse_alias),
            ),
            set_items=[
                SqlSetItem(
                    SqlColumnName("sys_valid_to_revision_id"),
                    _sql_param_or_cte_scalar(revision_id, ctx),
                ),
                *(
                    [
                        SqlSetItem(
                            SqlColumnName("sys_valid_to_seq"),
                            SqlRevisionPhysicalKeyScalar(
                                _sql_param_or_cte_scalar(revision_id, ctx),
                                source_table=_physical_key_source(ctx, SqlTableName("sys_revision_physical_keys")),
                            ),
                        ),
                    ]
                    if project_valid_to_seq
                    else []
                ),
            ],
            where=SqlWhereClause(
                sql_and(
                    sql_or(
                        SqlBinaryOp(
                            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("branch_id"), qualifier=sparse_alias),
                            BinaryOp.EQ,
                            _sql_param_or_cte_scalar(branch_id, ctx),
                        ),
                        sql_and(
                            lower_revision_in_ancestry_condition(
                                seed=_sql_param_or_cte_scalar(revision_id, ctx),
                                candidate_revision=SqlColumnRef(
                                    SqlColumnName("sys_valid_from_revision_id"),
                                    qualifier=sparse_alias,
                                ),
                            ),
                            no_sibling_branch_row,
                        ),
                    ),
                    sparse_close_target,
                    SqlIsNull(
                        SqlColumnRef(
                            SqlColumnName("sys_valid_to_revision_id"),
                            qualifier=sparse_alias,
                        ),
                    ),
                ),
            ),
            returning=SqlReturningClause([SqlInlineLiteral(1)]),
        )
        stmt: SqlRenderable = SqlCte(
            [
                (
                    updated_rows_cte,
                    updated_rows_stmt,
                )
            ],
            SqlSelect(
                select=SqlSelectList(
                    [
                        SqlSelectAlias(
                            SqlAggregate(AggregateKind.COUNT_STAR),
                            alias=SqlAliasName("count"),
                        )
                    ]
                ),
                from_=SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName(updated_rows_cte)),
            ),
        )
        output_shape = CompiledOutputShape((synthetic_output_field("count"),))
        return CompiledStep(
            output_shape=output_shape,
            column_type_hints=SqlColumnTypeHints(bigint_columns=frozenset({"count"})),
            result_relation=DeclaredResultRelation.from_output_shape(output_shape),
            grammar=stmt,
            needs_returning=True,
            closed_post_op=scalar_column_post_op(
                "count",
                default_value=0,
                use_default_on_empty=True,
                scalar_coercion=ScalarCoercionKind.INT,
            ),
            auxiliary_ctes=(
                *(
                    _auxiliary_ctes_for_sources(
                        ctx,
                        affected_source or effective_staged,
                    )
                    or ()
                ),
                *(
                    _auxiliary_ctes_for_scalar_refs(
                        ctx,
                        revision_id if isinstance(revision_id, ScalarServerRef) else None,
                        branch_id if isinstance(branch_id, ScalarServerRef) else None,
                    )
                    or ()
                ),
                (updated_rows_cte, updated_rows_stmt),
            ),
        )

    subquery: SqlRenderable = SqlDynamicSelectStmt(
        from_table=SqlTableName(effective_staged),
        columns=[SqlColumnName("sys_id")],
        where_conditions=[staged_where],
    )
    source_auxiliary_ctes = _auxiliary_ctes_for_sources(
        ctx,
        affected_source or effective_staged,
    )
    scalar_auxiliary_ctes = _auxiliary_ctes_for_scalar_refs(ctx, revision_id, branch_id)
    auxiliary_ctes = _combine_auxiliary_ctes(
        source_auxiliary_ctes,
        scalar_auxiliary_ctes,
    )
    if ctx.backend_profile.traits.sparse_window_transport is SparseWindowTransport.JOIN_UPDATE and source_auxiliary_ctes:
        subquery = SqlCte(source_auxiliary_ctes, subquery, recursive=True)
        auxiliary_ctes = scalar_auxiliary_ctes
    set_items = [
        SqlSetItem(
            SqlColumnName("sys_valid_to_revision_id"),
            _sql_param_or_cte_scalar(revision_id, ctx),
        ),
    ]
    if project_valid_to_seq:
        set_items.append(
            SqlSetItem(
                SqlColumnName("sys_valid_to_seq"),
                SqlRevisionPhysicalKeyScalar(
                    _sql_param_or_cte_scalar(revision_id, ctx),
                    source_table=_physical_key_source(ctx, SqlTableName("sys_revision_physical_keys")),
                ),
            ),
        )
    stmt = SqlUpdate(
        table=SqlTableIdent(sparse_table_name),
        set_items=set_items,
        where=SqlWhereClause(
            sql_and(
                SqlBinaryOp(
                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("branch_id")),
                    BinaryOp.EQ,
                    _sql_param_or_cte_scalar(branch_id, ctx),
                ),
                SqlIn(SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id")), subquery),
                SqlIsNull(SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_valid_to_revision_id"))),
            ),
        ),
    )
    return CompiledStep(
        grammar=stmt,
        auxiliary_ctes=auxiliary_ctes,
    )


def _dependency_relation_name(ctx: CompilationContext, ref_id: ServerPlanRefId) -> str:
    from l2070_batching.compilation import CteReference

    binding = ctx.cte_refs.get(str(ref_id))
    return binding.ref_id if isinstance(binding, CteReference) else str(ref_id)


_GRAPH_INSERTED_KEY_ALIAS = SqlAliasName("graph_inserted_key")
_GRAPH_BASE_KEY_ALIAS = SqlAliasName("graph_base_key")
_SOURCE_NODE_INSERTED_KEY_ALIAS = SqlAliasName("source_node_inserted_key")
_SOURCE_NODE_BASE_KEY_ALIAS = SqlAliasName("source_node_base_key")
_TARGET_NODE_INSERTED_KEY_ALIAS = SqlAliasName("target_node_inserted_key")
_TARGET_NODE_BASE_KEY_ALIAS = SqlAliasName("target_node_base_key")


def _graph_node_key_join_condition(
    *,
    lookup_alias: SqlAliasName,
    node_column: str,
    source_qualifier: str | None,
) -> SqlRenderable:
    return sql_and(
        SqlBinaryOp(
            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("graph_sys_id"), lookup_alias),
            BinaryOp.EQ,
            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("graph_sys_id"), source_qualifier),
        ),
        SqlBinaryOp(
            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("node_sys_id"), lookup_alias),
            BinaryOp.EQ,
            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(node_column), source_qualifier),
        ),
    )


def _resolved_graph_node_key_expr(
    *,
    inserted_alias: SqlAliasName,
    base_alias: SqlAliasName,
    inserted_source_available: bool,
) -> SqlRenderable:
    base_key = SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id"), base_alias)
    if not inserted_source_available:
        return base_key
    return SqlCoalesceExpr(SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id"), inserted_alias), base_key)


def _publish_graph_node_physical_key_joins(
    *,
    ctx: CompilationContext,
    source_qualifier: str | None,
    data_columns: Sequence[str],
    physical_projection_columns: frozenset[str],
    inserted_source_ref: ServerPlanRefId | None = None,
) -> tuple[SqlJoin, ...]:
    table_name = "sys_graph_node_physical_keys"
    base_source = _physical_key_source(ctx, SqlTableName(table_name))
    inserted_source: str | None
    if inserted_source_ref is not None:
        inserted_source = _dependency_relation_name(ctx, inserted_source_ref)
    else:
        inserted_sources = ctx.write_cte_by_table.get(table_name, ())
        inserted_source = inserted_sources[-1] if inserted_sources else None
    joins: list[SqlJoin] = []
    for projected_column, node_column, inserted_alias, base_alias in (
        ("source_node_key", "source_sys_id", _SOURCE_NODE_INSERTED_KEY_ALIAS, _SOURCE_NODE_BASE_KEY_ALIAS),
        ("target_node_key", "target_sys_id", _TARGET_NODE_INSERTED_KEY_ALIAS, _TARGET_NODE_BASE_KEY_ALIAS),
    ):
        if projected_column not in data_columns or projected_column not in physical_projection_columns:
            continue
        if inserted_source is not None:
            joins.append(
                SqlJoin(
                    JoinKind.LEFT,
                    SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName(inserted_source)), inserted_alias),
                    _graph_node_key_join_condition(
                        lookup_alias=inserted_alias,
                        node_column=node_column,
                        source_qualifier=source_qualifier,
                    ),
                ),
            )
        joins.append(
            SqlJoin(
                JoinKind.LEFT,
                SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName(base_source)), base_alias),
                _graph_node_key_join_condition(
                    lookup_alias=base_alias,
                    node_column=node_column,
                    source_qualifier=source_qualifier,
                ),
            ),
        )
    return tuple(joins)


def _publish_graph_physical_key_joins(
    *,
    ctx: CompilationContext,
    source_qualifier: str,
    data_columns: Sequence[str],
    physical_projection_columns: frozenset[str],
    inserted_source_ref: ServerPlanRefId | None,
) -> tuple[SqlJoin, ...]:
    if "graph_key" not in data_columns or "graph_key" not in physical_projection_columns:
        return ()
    joins: list[SqlJoin] = []
    if inserted_source_ref is not None:
        joins.append(
            SqlJoin(
                JoinKind.LEFT,
                SqlTableAlias(
                    SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName(_dependency_relation_name(ctx, inserted_source_ref))),
                    _GRAPH_INSERTED_KEY_ALIAS,
                ),
                SqlBinaryOp(
                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("graph_sys_id"), _GRAPH_INSERTED_KEY_ALIAS),
                    BinaryOp.EQ,
                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("graph_sys_id"), source_qualifier),
                ),
            ),
        )
    joins.append(
        SqlJoin(
            JoinKind.LEFT,
            SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName("sys_graph_physical_keys")), _GRAPH_BASE_KEY_ALIAS),
            SqlBinaryOp(
                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("graph_sys_id"), _GRAPH_BASE_KEY_ALIAS),
                BinaryOp.EQ,
                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("graph_sys_id"), source_qualifier),
            ),
        ),
    )
    return tuple(joins)


def _publish_select_expr_for_data_column(
    column_name: SqlColumnName,
    *,
    branch_id: LazyResult[BranchId] | ScalarServerRef[BranchId],
    revision_id: RevisionId | ScalarServerRef[RevisionId],
    ctx: CompilationContext,
    source_qualifier: str | None,
    physical_projection_columns: frozenset[str],
    source_model: type | None,
) -> SqlRenderable:
    """Return the publish-time projection expression for a sparse/tip data column."""
    if column_name == "branch_ord" and column_name in physical_projection_columns:
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.versioning.physical_keys import (
            SqlBranchPhysicalKeyScalar,
        )

        return SqlBranchPhysicalKeyScalar(
            _sql_param_or_cte_scalar(branch_id, ctx),
            source_table=_physical_key_source(ctx, SqlTableName("sys_branch_physical_keys")),
        )
    if column_name in {"sys_valid_from_seq", "sys_revision_seq"} and column_name in physical_projection_columns:
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.versioning.physical_keys import (
            SqlRevisionPhysicalKeyScalar,
        )

        return SqlRevisionPhysicalKeyScalar(
            _sql_param_or_cte_scalar(revision_id, ctx),
            source_table=_physical_key_source(ctx, SqlTableName("sys_revision_physical_keys")),
        )
    if column_name == "sys_valid_to_seq" and column_name in physical_projection_columns:
        return SqlParam(None)
    hash_source_column = {
        "branch_hash32": "branch_id",
        "graph_hash32": "graph_sys_id",
        "source_hash32": "source_sys_id",
        "target_hash32": "target_sys_id",
    }.get(column_name)
    if hash_source_column is not None and column_name in physical_projection_columns:
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.infra.expr_primitives import (
            SqlHashExpr,
            SqlHashExprKind,
        )

        return SqlHashExpr(
            SqlHashExprKind.UUID_HASH32,
            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(hash_source_column), source_qualifier),
        )
    if column_name == "graph_key" and column_name in physical_projection_columns:
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.graph.physical_keys import (
            SqlGraphPhysicalKeyScalar,
        )

        return SqlGraphPhysicalKeyScalar(
            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("graph_sys_id"), source_qualifier),
            source_table=_physical_key_source(ctx, SqlTableName("sys_graph_physical_keys")),
        )
    if column_name == "source_node_key" and column_name in physical_projection_columns:
        return _resolved_graph_node_key_expr(
            inserted_alias=_SOURCE_NODE_INSERTED_KEY_ALIAS,
            base_alias=_SOURCE_NODE_BASE_KEY_ALIAS,
            inserted_source_available=bool(ctx.write_cte_by_table.get("sys_graph_node_physical_keys")),
        )
    if column_name == "target_node_key" and column_name in physical_projection_columns:
        return _resolved_graph_node_key_expr(
            inserted_alias=_TARGET_NODE_INSERTED_KEY_ALIAS,
            base_alias=_TARGET_NODE_BASE_KEY_ALIAS,
            inserted_source_available=bool(ctx.write_cte_by_table.get("sys_graph_node_physical_keys")),
        )
    derived_expr = _derived_publish_expr_for_data_column(
        source_model,
        column_name,
        ctx=ctx,
        source_qualifier=source_qualifier,
    )
    if derived_expr is not None:
        return derived_expr
    return SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(column_name), source_qualifier)


def _count_only_publish_returning_clause(ctx: CompilationContext) -> SqlReturningClause:
    """RETURNING clause for a publish write whose contract declares ``('count',)``.

    On dialects with data-modifying CTEs the batching strategy projects the write
    CTE through ``COUNT(*)``, so the RETURNING relation only has to identify rows.
    Elsewhere the write runs as a standalone statement and its RETURNING relation
    reaches publication unchanged, so it must already be the declared count
    relation rather than a row-identity relation.
    """
    supports_returning = ctx.sql_render_dialect().supports_returning()
    if supports_returning and not ctx.supports_data_modifying_ctes:
        return SqlReturningClause([SqlSelectAlias(SqlParam(1), alias=SqlAliasName("count"))])
    return SqlReturningClause([SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id"))])


def _compile_insert_sparse_from_staged_step(
    *,
    sparse_table_name: SqlTableName,
    staged_table_name: SqlTableName,
    data_columns: Sequence[str],
    branch_id: LazyResult[BranchId] | ScalarServerRef[BranchId],
    revision_id: RevisionId | ScalarServerRef[RevisionId],
    selector: _StagedCommitSelector,
    ctx: CompilationContext,
    physical_projection_columns: frozenset[str],
    source_model: type | None,
    affected_rows_ref: ServerPlanRefId | None = None,
) -> CompiledStep[None]:
    effective_staged = _resolve_staged_source(
        SqlTableName(staged_table_name),
        ctx,
        selector=selector,
    )
    affected_source = _affected_rows_source_table(
        affected_rows_ref,
        ctx,
        required_columns=frozenset({"sys_id", "sys_deleted"}),
    )
    source_data_columns = _filter_columns_known_to_sql_sources(
        data_columns,
        ctx,
        affected_source or effective_staged,
        sparse_table_name,
    )
    # Framework adjuncts are reconstructed by the publish projection rather than copied from
    # the staged source. A column name alone cannot decide that: an application table may
    # declare its own ``graph_key`` or ``branch_ord``, so only the model's declared adjunct
    # fields and the policy-derived projection set are authoritative here.
    source_data_columns = tuple(
        column
        for column in source_data_columns
        if not is_framework_physical_db_column(source_model, SqlColumnName(column)) and column not in physical_projection_columns
    )
    data_columns = tuple(
        dict.fromkeys(
            (
                *source_data_columns,
                *sorted(physical_projection_columns),
            ),
        ),
    )
    source_qualifier = affected_source or effective_staged
    select_data_exprs = [
        _publish_select_expr_for_data_column(
            SqlColumnName(column_name),
            branch_id=branch_id,
            revision_id=revision_id,
            ctx=ctx,
            source_qualifier=source_qualifier,
            physical_projection_columns=physical_projection_columns,
            source_model=source_model,
        )
        for column_name in data_columns
    ]
    sparse_model = get_model_for_table(SqlTableName(sparse_table_name))
    sparse_model_columns = (
        {str(get_db_column_name(sparse_model, DynamicFieldName(field_name))) for field_name in sparse_model.model_fields}
        if sparse_model is not None
        else set()
    )
    sparse_has_sys_deleted = sparse_model is None or "sys_deleted" in sparse_model_columns
    include_sys_deleted = sparse_has_sys_deleted and "sys_deleted" not in data_columns
    target_cols = [
        "sys_id",
        "branch_id",
        "sys_valid_from_revision_id",
        "sys_valid_to_revision_id",
        *(("sys_deleted",) if include_sys_deleted else ()),
        *data_columns,
    ]
    select_exprs: list[SqlRenderable] = [
        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id"), source_qualifier),
        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("branch_id"), source_qualifier),
        _sql_param_or_cte_scalar(revision_id, ctx),
        SqlParam(None),
        *((SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_deleted"), source_qualifier),) if include_sys_deleted else ()),
        *select_data_exprs,
    ]
    stmt = SqlInsertFromSelect(
        target_table=SqlTableName(sparse_table_name),
        target_columns=target_cols,
        source_table=SqlTableName(affected_source or effective_staged),
        select_exprs=select_exprs,
        joins=_publish_graph_node_physical_key_joins(
            ctx=ctx,
            source_qualifier=source_qualifier,
            data_columns=data_columns,
            physical_projection_columns=physical_projection_columns,
        ),
        where=(
            SQL_EXPR_ALWAYS_TRUE
            if affected_source is not None
            else sql_and(
                SqlBinaryOp(
                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("branch_id")),
                    BinaryOp.EQ,
                    _sql_param_or_cte_scalar(branch_id, ctx),
                ),
                selector.match_expr(column_name=SqlColumnName("sys_staged_commit_id"), ctx=ctx),
                selector.latest_row_expr(
                    staged_table=effective_staged,
                    outer_qualifier=effective_staged,
                    ctx=ctx,
                ),
                *(
                    ()
                    if sparse_has_sys_deleted
                    else (
                        SqlUnaryOp(
                            UnaryOp.NOT,
                            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_deleted"), source_qualifier),
                        ),
                    )
                ),
            )
        ),
        conflict_columns=["branch_id", "sys_id", "sys_valid_from_revision_id"],
        update_columns=[
            "sys_valid_to_revision_id",
            *(("sys_deleted",) if include_sys_deleted else ()),
            *data_columns,
        ],
        order_by=["sys_staged_commit_id", "sys_deleted"],
        returning=_count_only_publish_returning_clause(ctx),
    )
    return CompiledStep(
        grammar=stmt,
        auxiliary_ctes=_combine_auxiliary_ctes(
            _auxiliary_ctes_for_sources(ctx, affected_source or effective_staged),
            _auxiliary_ctes_for_scalar_refs(ctx, revision_id, branch_id),
        ),
    )


def _compile_delete_tip_tombstones_step(
    *,
    tip_table_name: TableNameInput,
    staged_table_name: TableNameInput,
    branch_id: BranchRefInput,
    selector: _StagedCommitSelector,
    ctx: CompilationContext,
    affected_rows_ref: ServerPlanRefId | None = None,
    materialize_tip: TipMaterializationPolicy = True,
) -> CompiledStep[None]:
    from l2070_batching.output_shape import CompiledOutputShape, DeclaredResultRelation, synthetic_output_field

    effective_staged = _resolve_tip_upsert_staged_source(staged_table_name, ctx)
    affected_source = _affected_rows_source_table(affected_rows_ref, ctx)
    tip_policy_condition = _compile_tip_materialization_predicate(materialize_tip, ctx)
    deleted_rows_cte = f"{str(tip_table_name).strip().replace('.', '_').replace('"', '')}_deleted_tip_rows"
    subquery: SqlRenderable = SqlDynamicSelectStmt(
        from_table=SqlTableName(affected_source or effective_staged),
        columns=[SqlColumnName("sys_id")],
        where_conditions=[
            (
                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_deleted"), qualifier=affected_source)
                if affected_source is not None
                else sql_and(
                    SqlBinaryOp(
                        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("branch_id")),
                        BinaryOp.EQ,
                        _sql_param_or_cte_scalar(branch_id, ctx),
                    ),
                    selector.match_expr(column_name=SqlColumnName("sys_staged_commit_id"), ctx=ctx),
                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_deleted")),
                )
            ),
        ],
    )
    source_auxiliary_ctes = _auxiliary_ctes_for_sources(
        ctx,
        affected_source or effective_staged,
    )
    scalar_auxiliary_ctes = _auxiliary_ctes_for_scalar_refs(
        ctx,
        branch_id,
        materialize_tip,
    )
    auxiliary_ctes = _combine_auxiliary_ctes(
        source_auxiliary_ctes,
        scalar_auxiliary_ctes,
    )
    if (
        ctx.backend_profile.traits.versioned_staging_transport is VersionedStagingTransport.MATERIALIZED_RELATION
        and source_auxiliary_ctes
    ):
        subquery = SqlCte(source_auxiliary_ctes, subquery, recursive=True)
        auxiliary_ctes = scalar_auxiliary_ctes
    delete_where = sql_and(
        SqlBinaryOp(
            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("branch_id")),
            BinaryOp.EQ,
            _sql_param_or_cte_scalar(branch_id, ctx),
        ),
        SqlIn(SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id")), subquery),
    )
    if tip_policy_condition is not None:
        delete_where = sql_and(tip_policy_condition, delete_where)
    supports_returning = ctx.sql_render_dialect().supports_returning()
    output_shape = CompiledOutputShape((synthetic_output_field("count", role="count"),))
    column_type_hints = SqlColumnTypeHints(bigint_columns=frozenset({"count"}))
    if supports_returning and not ctx.supports_data_modifying_ctes:
        # Without data-modifying CTEs the DELETE's own output cannot be projected
        # through COUNT(*) in the same statement, but the ``count_only`` relation
        # this step publishes is only read for row existence, so RETURNING one
        # literal per deleted row is the declared shape (see
        # _count_only_publish_returning_clause). Pre-counting with a paired SELECT
        # would cost a second statement per commit table for a value nothing reads.
        returning_delete = SqlDelete(
            table=SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName(tip_table_name)),
            where=SqlWhereClause(delete_where),
            returning=_count_only_publish_returning_clause(ctx),
        )
        counted_delete: SqlRenderable = SqlCte(auxiliary_ctes, returning_delete) if auxiliary_ctes else returning_delete
        return CompiledStep(
            output_shape=output_shape,
            result_relation=DeclaredResultRelation.from_output_shape(output_shape),
            column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
            grammar=counted_delete,
            needs_returning=True,
            closed_post_op=scalar_column_post_op(
                "count",
                default_value=0,
                use_default_on_empty=True,
                scalar_coercion=ScalarCoercionKind.INT,
            ),
        )
    if not (supports_returning and ctx.supports_data_modifying_ctes):
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.infra.stmt_compound_write import (
            SqlStatementBatch,
            SqlStatementBatchCategory,
        )

        count_stmt = SqlSelect(
            select=SqlSelectList(
                [
                    SqlSelectAlias(
                        SqlAggregate(AggregateKind.COUNT_STAR),
                        alias=SqlAliasName("count"),
                    )
                ]
            ),
            from_clause=SqlFrom(SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName(tip_table_name)))),
            where=SqlWhereClause(delete_where),
        )
        delete_stmt = SqlDelete(
            table=SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName(tip_table_name)),
            where=SqlWhereClause(delete_where),
        )
        batch_count_stmt: SqlRenderable = count_stmt
        batch_delete_stmt: SqlRenderable = delete_stmt
        if auxiliary_ctes:
            batch_count_stmt = SqlCte(auxiliary_ctes, count_stmt)
            batch_delete_stmt = SqlCte(auxiliary_ctes, delete_stmt)
        return CompiledStep(
            output_shape=output_shape,
            result_relation=DeclaredResultRelation.from_output_shape(output_shape),
            column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
            grammar=SqlStatementBatch(
                [batch_count_stmt, batch_delete_stmt],
                category=SqlStatementBatchCategory.ORDERED_SEMANTIC,

def _compile_upsert_tip_from_staged_step(
    *,
    tip_table_name: SqlTableName,
    staged_table_name: SqlTableName,
    data_columns: Sequence[str],
    branch_id: LazyResult[BranchId] | ScalarServerRef[BranchId],
    revision_id: RevisionId | ScalarServerRef[RevisionId],
    selector: _StagedCommitSelector,
    ctx: CompilationContext,
    physical_projection_columns: frozenset[str],
    source_model: type | None,
    affected_rows_ref: ServerPlanRefId | None = None,
    materialize_tip: TipMaterializationPolicy = True,
) -> CompiledStep[None]:
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_ops import SqlBinaryOp, SqlUnaryOp, sql_and

    effective_staged = _resolve_tip_upsert_staged_source(staged_table_name, ctx)
    affected_source = _affected_rows_source_table(affected_rows_ref, ctx)
    tip_policy_condition = _compile_tip_materialization_predicate(materialize_tip, ctx)
    source_data_columns = _filter_columns_known_to_sql_sources(
        data_columns,
        ctx,
        affected_source or effective_staged,
        tip_table_name,
    )
    # Framework adjuncts are reconstructed by the publish projection rather than copied from
    # the staged source. A column name alone cannot decide that: an application table may
    # declare its own ``graph_key`` or ``branch_ord``, so only the model's declared adjunct
    # fields and the policy-derived projection set are authoritative here.
    source_data_columns = tuple(
        column
        for column in source_data_columns
        if not is_framework_physical_db_column(source_model, SqlColumnName(column)) and column not in physical_projection_columns
    )
    data_columns = tuple(
        dict.fromkeys(
            (
                *source_data_columns,
                *sorted(physical_projection_columns),
            ),
        ),
    )
    source_qualifier = affected_source or effective_staged
    select_data_exprs = [
        _publish_select_expr_for_data_column(
            SqlColumnName(column_name),
            branch_id=branch_id,
            revision_id=revision_id,
            ctx=ctx,
            source_qualifier=source_qualifier,
            physical_projection_columns=physical_projection_columns,
            source_model=source_model,
        )
        for column_name in data_columns
    ]
    upsert_where = (
        SqlUnaryOp(
            UnaryOp.NOT,
            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_deleted"), qualifier=affected_source),
        )
        if affected_source is not None
        else sql_and(
            SqlBinaryOp(
                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("branch_id")),
                BinaryOp.EQ,
                _sql_param_or_cte_scalar(branch_id, ctx),
            ),
            selector.match_expr(column_name=SqlColumnName("sys_staged_commit_id"), ctx=ctx),
            selector.latest_row_expr(
                staged_table=effective_staged,
                outer_qualifier=effective_staged,
                ctx=ctx,
            ),
            SqlUnaryOp(UnaryOp.NOT, SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_deleted"))),
        )
    )
    if tip_policy_condition is not None:
        upsert_where = sql_and(tip_policy_condition, upsert_where)
    stmt = SqlInsertFromSelect(
        target_table=tip_table_name,
        target_columns=["sys_id", "branch_id", "sys_revision_id", *data_columns],
        source_table=SqlTableName(affected_source or effective_staged),
        select_exprs=[
            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id"), source_qualifier),
            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("branch_id"), source_qualifier),
            _sql_param_or_cte_scalar(revision_id, ctx),
            *select_data_exprs,
        ],
        joins=_publish_graph_node_physical_key_joins(
            ctx=ctx,
            source_qualifier=source_qualifier,
            data_columns=data_columns,
            physical_projection_columns=physical_projection_columns,
        ),
        where=upsert_where,
        conflict_columns=["branch_id", "sys_id"],
        update_columns=["sys_revision_id", *data_columns],
        returning=_count_only_publish_returning_clause(ctx),
    )
    return CompiledStep(
        grammar=stmt,
        auxiliary_ctes=_combine_auxiliary_ctes(
            _auxiliary_ctes_for_sources(ctx, affected_source or effective_staged),
            _auxiliary_ctes_for_scalar_refs(ctx, revision_id, branch_id, materialize_tip),
        ),
    )

        return Cardinality.NONE

    def is_read_only(self: FinalizeConnectionRippleBatchesStep) -> bool:

        return False

    def step_tags(self: FinalizeConnectionRippleBatchesStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({"write", "rippling", "connection_batches"})

    def tables_read(self: FinalizeConnectionRippleBatchesStep) -> frozenset[str]:

    def requires_prior_statement_visibility_after_writes(
        self: FinalizeConnectionRippleBatchesStep,
    ) -> frozenset[str]:

        from l9800_rippling.models import RippleConnectionBatch

    def compile(self: FinalizeConnectionRippleBatchesStep, ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[None]:
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.ddl.ddl_connection_ripple import (

        branch_sql, branch_params = render_to_sql(_sql_param_or_cte_scalar(self._branch_id, ctx), dialect)
        revision_expr = _sql_param_or_cte_scalar(self._revision_id, ctx)

        selector_sql, selector_params = render_to_sql(
            self._selector.match_expr(column_name=SqlColumnName("staged_commit_id"), ctx=ctx),

        needs_revision_literal = (self._trigger_where is not None and contains_graph_predicates(self._trigger_where)) or (
            self._connected_where is not None and contains_graph_predicates(self._connected_where)
        )
        graph_revision_id = revision_expr if needs_revision_literal else None
        planning_catalog = ctx.planning_catalog if needs_revision_literal else None
        if needs_revision_literal and planning_catalog is None:

        trigger_where_sql: str | None = None

                build_connection_expression_grammar(
                    self._trigger_where,

        connected_where_sql: str | None = None

        if self._connected_where is not None:

def _extract_count_from_raw_result(raw_result: RawResult) -> int:
    if not raw_result:
        return 0
    row = dict(raw_result[0]) if not isinstance(raw_result[0], dict) else raw_result[0]

def _merge_staged_commit_ids(
    *groups: Sequence[StagedCommitId],
) -> list[StagedCommitId]:
    merged: list[StagedCommitId] = []
    seen: set[str] = set()
    for group in groups:
        for staged_commit_id in group:
            raw = staged_commit_id.unwrap_to_str()
            if raw in seen:
                continue
            seen.add(raw)
            merged.append(staged_commit_id)
    return merged

def _validate_fetch_branch_tip_result(
    *,
    raw_result: RawResult,
    branch_label: str,
    allow_empty: bool,
    expected_tip_raw: str | None,
    tip_revision_column: str = "current_tip_revision_id",
) -> FetchBranchResult:
    if not raw_result:
        if allow_empty:
            return FetchBranchResult(current_tip_revision_id=None)
        raise db_exc.ProgrammingError("Branch does not exist")

    row = raw_result[0]
    row_dict = dict(row) if not isinstance(row, dict) else row
    tip_raw = row_dict.get(tip_revision_column)
    current_tip = RevisionId(str(tip_raw)) if tip_raw else None

    if expected_tip_raw is not None:
        current_display = current_tip.unwrap_to_str() if current_tip is not None else None
        if current_display != expected_tip_raw:
            raise db_exc.ConcurrentBranchUpdateError(
                f"Branch {branch_label} tip has changed: "
                f"expected {expected_tip_raw}, "
                f"current {current_display}. "
                "Another transaction has committed. Please retry.",
            )

    return FetchBranchResult(current_tip_revision_id=current_tip)

def _build_fetch_branch_and_staged_stmt(
    *,
    domain: type[VersioningDomain],
    branch_id: ScalarServerRef[BranchId],
    connection_id: ScalarServerRef[ConnectionId] | None,
    expected_tip_revision_id: ScalarServerRef[RevisionId] | None = None,
    use_for_update: bool,
    for_update_nowait: bool,
    ctx: CompilationContext,
) -> SqlRenderable:
    from l1000_schema.schema_def import get_db_column_name
    from impl.common.l2050_sql_types.sql_branded_types import SqlTableName
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps._compile_server_ref import lower_scalar_source
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.clauses import SqlSelectAlias, SqlSelectList
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.identifiers import SqlTableIdent
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.statements import SqlSelect

    del connection_id

    branch_table = get_table_name(domain.branch_model)
    branch_id_column = get_db_column_name(domain.branch_model, DynamicFieldName("sys_id"))
    tip_revision_column = get_db_column_name(domain.branch_model, DynamicFieldName("tip_revision_sys_id"))
    select_items: list[SqlRenderable] = [
        SqlSelectAlias(
            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(branch_id_column)),
            SqlAliasName("sys_id"),
        ),
        SqlSelectAlias(
            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(tip_revision_column)),
            SqlAliasName("current_tip_revision_id"),
        ),
        SqlSelectAlias(
            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(tip_revision_column)),
            SqlAliasName("_branch_tip"),
        ),
    ]
    if expected_tip_revision_id is not None:
        select_items.append(
            SqlSelectAlias(
                lower_scalar_source(expected_tip_revision_id, ctx),
                SqlAliasName("_expected_tip"),
            ),
        )
    for_update_clause = (
        SqlForUpdateClause(
            of_table=SqlTableName(branch_table),
            nowait=for_update_nowait,
        )
        if use_for_update
        else None
    )
    return SqlSelect(
        select=SqlSelectList(select_items),
        from_=SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName(branch_table)),
        where=SqlWhereClause(
            SqlBinaryOp(
                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(branch_id_column)),
                BinaryOp.EQ,
                lower_scalar_source(branch_id, ctx),
            ),
        ),
        for_update=for_update_clause,
    )


def _validate_fetch_branch_and_staged_result(
    *,
    raw_result: RawResult,
    branch_label: str,
    allow_empty: bool,
    expected_tip_raw: str | None,
) -> FetchBranchResult:
    del allow_empty
    if not raw_result:
        raise db_exc.ProgrammingError("Branch does not exist")

    first_row = raw_result[0]
    first_row_dict = dict(first_row) if not isinstance(first_row, dict) else first_row
    tip_raw = first_row_dict["_branch_tip"]
    current_tip = RevisionId(str(tip_raw)) if tip_raw else None

    if expected_tip_raw is not None:
        current_display = current_tip.unwrap_to_str() if current_tip is not None else "None"
        if current_display != expected_tip_raw:
            raise db_exc.ConcurrentBranchUpdateError(
                f"Branch {branch_label} tip has changed: "
                f"expected {expected_tip_raw}, "
                f"current {current_display}. "
                "Another transaction has committed. Please retry.",
            )

    staged_commit_ids: list[StagedCommitId] = []
    seen_staged: set[str] = set()
    for raw_row in raw_result:
        row_dict = dict(raw_row) if not isinstance(raw_row, dict) else raw_row
        raw_staged = row_dict.get("staged_commit_id")
        if raw_staged is None:
            continue
        staged_key = str(raw_staged)
        if staged_key in seen_staged:
            continue
        seen_staged.add(staged_key)
        staged_commit_ids.append(StagedCommitId(staged_key))

    return FetchBranchResult(
        current_tip_revision_id=current_tip,
        staged_commit_ids=staged_commit_ids or None,
    )

        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps._compile_server_ref import (
            get_scalar_server_ref_binding,
            lower_scalar_source,
        )

        revision_timestamp = self._config.revision_timestamp or datetime.now(UTC)
        compact_col = self._compact_col

        # Column order: sys_id, parent_revision_sys_id, parent_type, timestamp, session_id, ...rest
        target_cols: list[str] = [
            self._id_col,
            self._parent_id_col,
            self._parent_type_col,
            self._timestamp_col,
            self._session_id_col,
        ]
        parent_revision_expr: SqlRenderable
        parent_type_expr: SqlRenderable
        # The CAS tip coordinates publication but is not ancestry for a true root.
        # See docs/design/NER_1543_ATOMIC_TRUE_ROOT_PUBLICATION.rst.
        if self._config.legacy_parent_mode is _LegacyRevisionParentMode.NONE:
            parent_revision_expr = SqlParam(None)
            parent_type_expr = SqlParam(None)
        elif self._config.legacy_parent_mode is _LegacyRevisionParentMode.BRANCH_TIP:
            parent_revision_expr = SqlColumnRef(self._tip_revision_column)
            parent_type_expr = SqlParam("commit")

            assert_never(self._config.legacy_parent_mode)

            SqlParam(unwrap_literal_sql_value(self._revision_id)),
            parent_revision_expr,
            parent_type_expr,

        select_exprs.insert(3, compact_id_expr)

        # Add metadata columns
        for _key, column_name, value in self._metadata_db_columns:
            if column_name == compact_col:
                continue
            target_cols.append(column_name)
            select_exprs.append(SqlParam(value))

        branch_expr: SqlRenderable = lower_scalar_source(self._lazy_branch, ctx)

        where: SqlRenderable = SqlBinaryOp(
            SqlColumnRef(self._branch_id_column),

            object.__setattr__(self, "_publication_contract_cache_valid", False)
        stmt = SqlInsertFromSelect(
            target_table=SqlTableName(self._revision_table),
            target_columns=target_cols,
            source_table=SqlTableName(self._branch_table),
            select_exprs=select_exprs,
            where=where,
            returning=(SqlReturningClause([SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(col)) for col in target_cols]) if supports_returning else None),
        )
        contract = self.cte_publication_contract()
        output_shape = None
        result_relation = None
        column_type_hints = None
        if contract.columns:
            output_shape, result_relation, column_type_hints = _compiled_artifacts_from_contract(contract)

        return CompiledStep(
            output_shape=output_shape,
            grammar=stmt,
            result_relation=result_relation,
            column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
            auxiliary_ctes=_auxiliary_ctes_for_dependencies(ctx, self.sql_visible_dependencies()),
            needs_returning=supports_returning,
            closed_post_op=(
                scalar_column_post_op(
                    self._id_col,
                    scalar_coercion=ScalarCoercionKind.REVISION_ID,

class DemoteOldBranchTipAnchorStep(NonPublishingStep[None]):
    """L0: Replace the old branch-tip reason with its durable anchor reason.

    Non-root revisions become lineage entries. Root revisions remain replay
    anchors because no earlier revision can reconstruct their state.
    """

    def __init__(
        self: DemoteOldBranchTipAnchorStep,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        index_table: SqlTableName,
        lazy_branch: ScalarServerRef[BranchId],
        *,
        config: _DemoteOldBranchTipAnchorConfig | None = None,
        depends_on: DependencyRefs = frozenset(),
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        resolved_config = config or _DemoteOldBranchTipAnchorConfig()
        self._table = index_table
        self._lazy_branch = lazy_branch
        self._depends_on = resolved_config.depends_on | depends_on
        self._authorization_boundary = resolved_config.requires_authorization_boundary
        self._branch_table = resolved_config.branch_table_name
        self._revision_parents_table = resolved_config.revision_parents_table_name
        self._branch_id_column = resolved_config.branch_id_column
        self._tip_revision_column = resolved_config.tip_revision_column

    @property
    def level(self: DemoteOldBranchTipAnchorStep) -> int:
        return 0

    def result_cardinality(self: DemoteOldBranchTipAnchorStep) -> Cardinality:
        return Cardinality.NONE

    def is_read_only(self: DemoteOldBranchTipAnchorStep) -> bool:
        return False

    def step_tags(self: DemoteOldBranchTipAnchorStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({"write", "update", "grammar"})

    def supports_sql_batch_transport(self: DemoteOldBranchTipAnchorStep) -> bool:
        return True

    def requires_prior_step_boundary(self: DemoteOldBranchTipAnchorStep) -> bool:
        return self._authorization_boundary

    def scheduling_effects(self: DemoteOldBranchTipAnchorStep) -> frozenset[SchedulingEffect]:
        if _commit_prefix_attribution_enabled():
            return frozenset({SchedulingEffect.SQL_GROUP_BOUNDARY_AFTER})
        return frozenset()

    def tables_read(self: DemoteOldBranchTipAnchorStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({self._table, self._branch_table, self._revision_parents_table})

    def tables_written(self: DemoteOldBranchTipAnchorStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({self._table})

    def dependencies(self: DemoteOldBranchTipAnchorStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return self._depends_on | _collect_ref_dependencies(self._lazy_branch)

    def sql_visible_dependencies(self: DemoteOldBranchTipAnchorStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return _collect_ref_dependencies(self._lazy_branch)

    def planning_fingerprint(self: DemoteOldBranchTipAnchorStep) -> tuple[object, ...] | None:
        return _commit_step_fingerprint(
            self,
            self._authorization_boundary,
            str(self._table),
            str(self._branch_table),
            str(self._revision_parents_table),
            str(self._branch_id_column),
            str(self._tip_revision_column),
            _sorted_deps(self.dependencies()),
            env_sensitive=True,
        )

    def preprocess(self: DemoteOldBranchTipAnchorStep, resolved: ResolvedRefs) -> None:
        del resolved

    def compile(self: DemoteOldBranchTipAnchorStep, ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[None]:
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_compound import SqlSubquery

        old_tip_revision = SqlSubquery(
            SqlDynamicSelectStmt(
                from_table=SqlTableName(self._branch_table),
                columns=[self._tip_revision_column],
                where_conditions=[
                    SqlBinaryOp(
                        SqlColumnRef(self._branch_id_column, plain_text_hint=False),
                        BinaryOp.EQ,
                        _sql_param_or_cte_scalar(self._lazy_branch, ctx),
                    ),
                    SqlIsNull(SqlColumnRef(self._tip_revision_column), negated=True),
                ],
                limit=1,
            ),
        )
        old_tip_has_parent = SqlExists(
            SqlDynamicSelectStmt(
                from_table=self._revision_parents_table,
                columns=[SqlColumnName("revision_sys_id")],
                where_conditions=[
                    SqlBinaryOp(
                        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("revision_sys_id")),
                        BinaryOp.EQ,
                        old_tip_revision,
                    ),
                ],
                limit=1,
            ),
        )
        stmt = SqlUpdate(
            table=SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName(self._table)),
            set_items=[
                SqlSetItem(
                    SqlColumnName("anchor_reason"),
                    SqlCase(
                        whens=(
                            (
                                old_tip_has_parent,
                                SqlParam(RevisionAnchorReason.LINEAGE.value),
                            ),
                        ),
                        else_=SqlParam(RevisionAnchorReason.ROOT.value),
                    ),
                ),
                SqlSetItem(
                    SqlColumnName("anchor_depth"),
                    SqlCase(
                        whens=(
                            (
                                old_tip_has_parent,
                                SqlBinaryOp(
                                    SqlCoalesceExpr(
                                        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("anchor_depth")),
                                        SqlParam(0),
                                    ),
                                    BinaryOp.ADD,
                                    SqlParam(1),
                                ),
                            ),
                        ),
                        else_=SqlParam(0),
                    ),
                ),
            ],
            where=SqlWhereClause(
                sql_and(
                    SqlBinaryOp(
                        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("branch_sys_id")),
                        BinaryOp.EQ,
                        _sql_param_or_cte_scalar(self._lazy_branch, ctx),
                    ),
                    SqlBinaryOp(
                        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("anchor_reason")),
                        BinaryOp.EQ,
                        SqlParam("branch_tip"),
                    ),
                    SqlBinaryOp(
                        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("revision_sys_id")),
                        BinaryOp.EQ,
                        old_tip_revision,
                    ),
                ),
            ),
        )
        return CompiledStep(
            grammar=stmt,
            auxiliary_ctes=_auxiliary_ctes_for_dependencies(ctx, self.sql_visible_dependencies()),
        )

def _staged_branch_selector_where(
    *,
    staged_table_name: SqlTableName,
    branch_id: ScalarServerRef[BranchId],
    selector: _StagedCommitSelector,
    ctx: CompilationContext,
    source_qualifier: str | None = None,
) -> SqlRenderable:
    effective_staged = source_qualifier or _resolve_staged_source(staged_table_name, ctx)
    return sql_and(
        SqlBinaryOp(
            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("branch_id"), effective_staged),

        selector.match_expr(

            ctx=ctx,
        ),
    )

class AffectedStagedRowsStep(SqlRelationPublisherStep[list[dict[str, Any]]]):

        staged_table_name: SqlTableName,
