    async def _record_local_row_changes_async(
        self: _ReadThroughConnectionCore,
        before: Mapping[SqlTableName, Mapping[SysId, DatabaseObjectRow]],
        after: Mapping[SqlTableName, Mapping[SysId, DatabaseObjectRow]],
    ) -> None:
        """Record and persist exact local changes through the async cache."""
        from impl.read_through.coverage import (
            ReadThroughAuthorityOwnedTableRecord,
            ReadThroughLocalOverlayRecord,
            ReadThroughOwnershipProvenance,
        )
        from l2000_connection.connection import _async_transaction_active
        from l2000_connection.connection_plan_workflows import (
            AsyncWritePlanWorkflow,
            run_write_plan_workflow_async,
        )

        changed: list[ReadThroughLocalOverlayRecord] = []
        upstream_namespace, authority_namespace, catalog_fingerprint = self._local_overlay_authority()
        principal_user_id = self._authority_principal_user_id
        if principal_user_id is None:
            raise RuntimeError("Local overlays require an admitted principal")
        for table_name in before.keys() | after.keys():
            before_rows = before.get(table_name, {})
            after_rows = after.get(table_name, {})
            overlay = self._local_row_overlays.setdefault(table_name, {})
            for sys_id in before_rows.keys() | after_rows.keys():
                if before_rows.get(sys_id) == after_rows.get(sys_id):
                    continue
                row = after_rows.get(sys_id)
                overlay[sys_id] = row
                changed.append(
                    ReadThroughLocalOverlayRecord(
                        sys_id=ReadThroughLocalOverlayRecord.deterministic_id(str(table_name), str(sys_id)),
                        table_name=str(table_name),
                        object_id=str(sys_id),
                        deleted=row is None,
                        row_json="" if row is None else row.model_dump_json(),
                        upstream_namespace=upstream_namespace,
                        authority_namespace=authority_namespace,
                        catalog_fingerprint=catalog_fingerprint,
                        principal_user_id=principal_user_id,
                    ),
                )
            if overlay:
                self._tables_with_local_writes.add(table_name)
        cache = self._cache
        if not changed or not isinstance(cache, AsyncDatabaseConnection):
            return
        await self._bootstrap_cache_schema_if_missing_async(
            (ReadThroughAuthorityOwnedTableRecord, ReadThroughLocalOverlayRecord),
        )
        ownership_records = tuple(
            ReadThroughAuthorityOwnedTableRecord.for_table(
                SqlTableName(table_name),
                provenance=ReadThroughOwnershipProvenance.LOCAL_OVERLAY,
            )
            for table_name in {record.table_name for record in changed}
        )
        active_token = _async_transaction_active.set(False)
        try:
            cache_session_id = SessionId.schema()

            def build_evidence(txn: AsyncWriteTransaction) -> LazyResult[list[ReadThroughLocalOverlayRecord]]:
                result = txn.upsert_many_lazy(ReadThroughLocalOverlayRecord, changed)
                txn.upsert_many_lazy(ReadThroughAuthorityOwnedTableRecord, ownership_records)
                return result

            await run_write_plan_workflow_async(
                cache,
                AsyncWritePlanWorkflow[list[ReadThroughLocalOverlayRecord]](
                    session_id=cache_session_id,
                    build=build_evidence,
                    result_name=PlanScopeReturnName("local_overlay_evidence"),
                    commit=True,
                ),
            )
        finally:
            _async_transaction_active.reset(active_token)
        self._cached_tables.update(record.table_name for record in changed)

    def _persist_local_row_overlays(
        self: _ReadThroughConnectionCore,
        records: Sequence[ReadThroughLocalOverlayRecord],
    ) -> None:
        """Persist committed local overlay changes after the cache write commits."""
        from impl.read_through.coverage import (
            ReadThroughAuthorityOwnedTableRecord,
            ReadThroughLocalOverlayRecord,
            ReadThroughOwnershipProvenance,
        )
        from l2000_connection.connection_plan_workflows import SyncWritePlanWorkflow, run_write_plan_workflow

        cache = self._cache
        if not isinstance(cache, SyncDatabaseConnection):
            return
        self._bootstrap_cache_schema_if_missing(
            (ReadThroughAuthorityOwnedTableRecord, ReadThroughLocalOverlayRecord),
        )
        ownership_records = tuple(
            ReadThroughAuthorityOwnedTableRecord.for_table(
                SqlTableName(table_name),
                provenance=ReadThroughOwnershipProvenance.LOCAL_OVERLAY,
            )
            for table_name in {record.table_name for record in records}
        )
        cache_session_id = SessionId.schema()

        def build_evidence(txn: WriteTransaction) -> LazyResult[list[ReadThroughLocalOverlayRecord]]:
            result = txn.upsert_many_lazy(ReadThroughLocalOverlayRecord, records)
            txn.upsert_many_lazy(ReadThroughAuthorityOwnedTableRecord, ownership_records)
            return result

        run_write_plan_workflow(
            cache,
            SyncWritePlanWorkflow[list[ReadThroughLocalOverlayRecord]](
                session_id=cache_session_id,
                build=build_evidence,
                result_name=PlanScopeReturnName("local_overlay_evidence"),
                commit=True,
            ),
        )
        self._cached_tables.update(record.table_name for record in records)

    def _current_remote_authority_key(
        self: _ReadThroughConnectionCore,
    ) -> _ReadThroughAuthorityKey:
        """Return the authority key defined by READ_THROUGH_CLOSED_CACHE_FILL_ARCHITECTURE.rst."""
        from impl.remote.connection import SyncRemoteIntentConnection

        upstream = self._upstream
        if not isinstance(upstream, SyncRemoteIntentConnection):
            raise RuntimeError("Remote authority is unavailable for a non-remote upstream")
        authority = upstream.authority_context
        catalog_fingerprint = upstream.catalog_fingerprint
        if authority is None or catalog_fingerprint is None:
            raise RuntimeError(
                "The remote server did not return an explicit authority binding. "
                "Configure its session resolver to return RemoteAuthorityBinding before using a persistent read-through cache."
            )
        return _ReadThroughAuthorityKey(
            upstream_namespace=self._authority_namespace,
            authority_namespace=authority.namespace,
            authorization_epoch=authority.authorization_epoch,
            catalog_fingerprint=catalog_fingerprint,
        )

    def _publish_authenticated_authority(
        self: _ReadThroughConnectionCore,
        key: _ReadThroughAuthorityKey,
    ) -> None:
        """Publish the lease verified by this facade under the shared cache lock."""
        with self._authority_lease_lock:
            if self._shared_local_state.authority_key != key:
                self._authenticated_cache_sessions.clear()
                self._complete_prefetched_tables.clear()
            self._shared_local_state.authority_key = key
            self._authority_lease_key = key

        binding = ReadThroughSessionBindingRecord(
            sys_id=ReadThroughSessionBindingRecord.deterministic_id(requested_session_id),
            requested_session_id=requested_session_id,

            SyncWritePlanWorkflow[list[ReadThroughSessionBindingRecord]](

                build=lambda txn: txn.upsert_many_lazy(ReadThroughSessionBindingRecord, [binding]),

    def _invalidate_offline_cache_session(
        self: _ReadThroughConnectionCore,
        requested_session_id: SessionId,
    ) -> None:
        """Persist an explicit authentication rejection for one requested session."""
        from impl.read_through.coverage import (
            ReadThroughCoverageRecord,
            ReadThroughSessionBindingRecord,
            ReadThroughTableCoverageRecord,
        )
        from l2000_connection.connection_plan_workflows import SyncWritePlanWorkflow, run_write_plan_workflow

        cache = self._cache
        if not isinstance(cache, SyncDatabaseConnection):
            return
        self._authenticated_cache_sessions.pop(requested_session_id, None)
        evidence_models = (
            ReadThroughCoverageRecord,
            ReadThroughSessionBindingRecord,
            ReadThroughTableCoverageRecord,
        )
        if not all(cache._table_exists_uncached(SqlTableName(get_table_name(model_cls))) for model_cls in evidence_models):
            return

        def delete_evidence(txn: WriteTransaction) -> LazyResult[bool]:
            txn.query_lazy(ReadThroughCoverageRecord).filter(
                field(ReadThroughCoverageRecord.requested_session_id) == requested_session_id,
            ).delete_lazy()
            txn.query_lazy(ReadThroughTableCoverageRecord).filter(
                field(ReadThroughTableCoverageRecord.requested_session_id) == requested_session_id,
            ).delete_lazy()
            return txn.delete_by_id_lazy(
                ReadThroughSessionBindingRecord,
                ReadThroughSessionBindingRecord.deterministic_id(requested_session_id),
            )

        workflow: SyncWritePlanWorkflow[bool] = SyncWritePlanWorkflow(
            session_id=SessionId.schema(),
            build=delete_evidence,
            result_name=PlanScopeReturnName("rejected_session_evidence"),
            commit=True,
        )
        run_write_plan_workflow(cache, workflow)

    def _offline_cache_session(
        self: _ReadThroughConnectionCore,
        requested_session_id: SessionId,
    ) -> SessionId | None:
        """Return a prior session only while its exact persistent lease remains active."""
        from impl.read_through.coverage import (
            ReadThroughAuthorityLeaseRecord,
            ReadThroughSessionBindingRecord,
            ReadThroughTableCoverageRecord,
        )
        from l2000_connection.connection_plan_workflows import SyncReadPlanWorkflow, run_read_plan_workflow

        with self._authority_lease_lock:
            key = self._authority_lease_key
            session_id = self._authenticated_cache_sessions.get(requested_session_id)
            cache = self._cache
            if not isinstance(cache, SyncDatabaseConnection):
                return None
            existing = run_read_plan_workflow(
                cache,
                SyncReadPlanWorkflow[ReadThroughAuthorityLeaseRecord | None](
                    session_id=SessionId.schema(),
                    build=lambda txn: txn.select_one_lazy(
                        ReadThroughAuthorityLeaseRecord,
                        LazyResult.of(ReadThroughAuthorityLeaseRecord.singleton_id()),
                    ),
                    result_name=PlanScopeReturnName("offline_authority_lease"),
                ),
            )
            if existing is None or datetime.now(UTC) - existing.last_authenticated_at > _OFFLINE_AUTHORITY_MAX_AGE:
                return None
            existing_key = (
                existing.upstream_namespace,
                existing.authority_namespace,
                existing.authorization_epoch,
                existing.catalog_fingerprint,
            )
            if existing.upstream_namespace != self._authority_namespace or (
                key is not None
                and existing_key
                != (
                    key.upstream_namespace,
                    key.authority_namespace,
                    key.authorization_epoch,
                    key.catalog_fingerprint,
                )
            ):
                return None
            binding = run_read_plan_workflow(
                cache,
                SyncReadPlanWorkflow[ReadThroughSessionBindingRecord | None](
                    session_id=SessionId.schema(),
                    build=lambda txn: txn.select_one_lazy(
                        ReadThroughSessionBindingRecord,
                        LazyResult.of(ReadThroughSessionBindingRecord.deterministic_id(requested_session_id)),
                    ),
                    result_name=PlanScopeReturnName("offline_session_binding"),
                ),
            )
            if binding is None or (
                binding.requested_session_id != requested_session_id
                or binding.upstream_namespace != existing.upstream_namespace
                or binding.authority_namespace != existing.authority_namespace
                or binding.authorization_epoch != existing.authorization_epoch
                or binding.catalog_fingerprint != existing.catalog_fingerprint
            ):
                return None
            if session_id is not None and session_id != binding.cache_session_id:
                return None
            coverage_rows = run_read_plan_workflow(
                cache,
                SyncReadPlanWorkflow[Sequence[ReadThroughTableCoverageRecord]](
                    session_id=SessionId.schema(),
                    build=lambda txn: (
                        txn.query_lazy(ReadThroughTableCoverageRecord)
                        .filter(
                            field(ReadThroughTableCoverageRecord.requested_session_id) == requested_session_id,
                        )
                        .execute_lazy()
                    ),
                    result_name=PlanScopeReturnName("offline_table_coverage"),
                ),
            )
            self._complete_prefetched_tables.update(
                SqlTableName(row.table_name)
                for row in coverage_rows
                if row.upstream_namespace == existing.upstream_namespace
                and row.authority_namespace == existing.authority_namespace
                and row.authorization_epoch == existing.authorization_epoch
                and row.catalog_fingerprint == existing.catalog_fingerprint
            )
            self._authenticated_cache_sessions[requested_session_id] = binding.cache_session_id
            self._authority_principal_user_id = existing.principal_user_id
            self._authority_lease_key = _ReadThroughAuthorityKey(
                upstream_namespace=existing.upstream_namespace,
                authority_namespace=RemoteAuthorityNamespace(existing.authority_namespace),
                authorization_epoch=RemoteAuthorizationEpoch(existing.authorization_epoch),
                catalog_fingerprint=existing.catalog_fingerprint,
            )
            return binding.cache_session_id

    def _adopt_current_authority_for_remote_only_reads(self: _ReadThroughConnectionCore) -> None:
        """Prevent local replica state from becoming authoritative after an async authority change."""
        key = self._current_remote_authority_key()
        previous = self._authority_lease_key
        if previous != key:
            self._tables_with_local_writes.clear()
            self._verified_remote_compatibility.clear()
            self._publish_authenticated_authority(key)

    def _bind_cache_to_current_authority(self: _ReadThroughConnectionCore) -> None:
        """Exclusively bind persistent cache state to the authenticated authority."""
        from impl.read_through.coverage import (
            ReadThroughAuthorityLeaseRecord,
            ReadThroughAuthorityOwnedTableRecord,
            ReadThroughCachedTableRecord,
            ReadThroughCoverageRecord,
            ReadThroughLocalOverlayRecord,
            ReadThroughOwnershipProvenance,
            ReadThroughSessionBindingRecord,
            ReadThroughTableCoverageRecord,
        )
        from impl.remote.connection import SyncRemoteIntentConnection
        from l1300_session.session import Session, UserSession
        from l2000_connection.connection_plan_workflows import (
            SyncReadPlanWorkflow,
            SyncWritePlanWorkflow,
            run_read_plan_workflow,
            run_write_plan_workflow,
        )

        upstream = self._upstream
        if not isinstance(upstream, SyncRemoteIntentConnection):
            return
        key = self._current_remote_authority_key()
        authority = upstream.authority_context
        catalog_fingerprint = upstream.catalog_fingerprint
        authenticated_session_id = upstream.authenticated_session_id
        assert authority is not None
        assert catalog_fingerprint is not None
        if authenticated_session_id is None:
            raise RuntimeError("Remote authentication did not establish a cache session")
        with self._authority_lease_lock:
            self._bootstrap_cache_schema_if_missing(
                (ReadThroughAuthorityLeaseRecord, ReadThroughAuthorityOwnedTableRecord),
            )
            lease_id = ReadThroughAuthorityLeaseRecord.singleton_id()
            existing = run_read_plan_workflow(
                cast("Any", self._cache),
                SyncReadPlanWorkflow(
                    session_id=SessionId.schema(),
                    build=lambda txn: txn.select_one_lazy(
                        ReadThroughAuthorityLeaseRecord,
                        LazyResult.of(lease_id),
                    ),
                    result_name=PlanScopeReturnName("authority_lease"),
                ),
            )
            owned_table_records = run_read_plan_workflow(
                cast("Any", self._cache),
                SyncReadPlanWorkflow(
                    session_id=SessionId.schema(),
                    build=lambda txn: txn.query_lazy(ReadThroughAuthorityOwnedTableRecord).execute_lazy(),
                    result_name=PlanScopeReturnName("authority_owned_tables"),
                ),
            )
            matches = existing is not None and (
                existing.upstream_namespace,
                existing.authority_namespace,
                existing.authorization_epoch,
                existing.catalog_fingerprint,
            ) == (
                key.upstream_namespace,
                key.authority_namespace,
                key.authorization_epoch,
                key.catalog_fingerprint,
            )
            if matches:
                assert existing is not None
                renewed_lease = existing.model_copy(update={"last_authenticated_at": datetime.now(UTC)})

                def renew_authority(txn: WriteTransaction) -> LazyResult[list[ReadThroughAuthorityLeaseRecord]]:
                    return txn.upsert_many_lazy(ReadThroughAuthorityLeaseRecord, [renewed_lease])

                run_write_plan_workflow(
                    cast("Any", self._cache),
                    SyncWritePlanWorkflow(
                        session_id=SessionId.schema(),
                        build=renew_authority,
                        result_name=PlanScopeReturnName("renewed_authority_lease"),
                        commit=True,
                    ),
                )
            if not matches:
                same_principal = existing is not None and (
                    existing.upstream_namespace == key.upstream_namespace
                    and existing.authority_namespace == key.authority_namespace
                    and existing.catalog_fingerprint == key.catalog_fingerprint
                )
                ownership_table = get_table_name(ReadThroughAuthorityOwnedTableRecord)
                coverage_table = get_table_name(ReadThroughCoverageRecord)
                cached_table_record = get_table_name(ReadThroughCachedTableRecord)
                binding_table = get_table_name(ReadThroughSessionBindingRecord)
                table_coverage_table = get_table_name(ReadThroughTableCoverageRecord)
                overlay_table = get_table_name(ReadThroughLocalOverlayRecord)
                user_session_table = get_table_name(UserSession)
                metadata_tables = {
                    ownership_table,
                    coverage_table,
                    cached_table_record,
                    binding_table,
                    table_coverage_table,
                    user_session_table,
                }
                authority_owned_tables = set(metadata_tables)
                preserved_tables = {
                    SqlTableName(record.table_name)
                    for record in owned_table_records
                    if record.provenance is ReadThroughOwnershipProvenance.LOCAL_OVERLAY or record.preserve_on_same_principal
                }
                authority_owned_tables.update(
                    SqlTableName(record.table_name)
                    for record in owned_table_records
                    if not same_principal or SqlTableName(record.table_name) not in preserved_tables
                )
                if not same_principal:
                    authority_owned_tables.add(overlay_table)
                authority_tables = tuple(
                    SqlTableName(name)
                    for name in sorted(authority_owned_tables)
                    if self._cache._table_exists_uncached(SqlTableName(name))
                )
                lease = ReadThroughAuthorityLeaseRecord(
                    sys_id=lease_id,
                    upstream_namespace=self._authority_namespace,
                    authority_namespace=authority.namespace,
                    authorization_epoch=authority.authorization_epoch,
                    catalog_fingerprint=catalog_fingerprint,
                    admitted_session_id=authenticated_session_id,
                    principal_user_id=authority.principal_user_id,
                )

                def replace_authority(txn: WriteTransaction) -> LazyResult[list[ReadThroughAuthorityLeaseRecord]]:
                    for table_name in authority_tables:
                        sql_effect_result(cast("Any", txn), SqlDelete(SqlQuotedIdentifier(table_name)))
                    return txn.upsert_many_lazy(ReadThroughAuthorityLeaseRecord, [lease])

                run_write_plan_workflow(
                    cast("Any", self._cache),
                    SyncWritePlanWorkflow(
                        session_id=SessionId.schema(),
                        build=replace_authority,
                        result_name=PlanScopeReturnName("authority_lease"),
                        commit=True,
                    ),
                )
                self._cached_tables.clear()
                if not same_principal:
                    self._local_row_overlays.clear()
                    self._tables_with_local_writes.clear()
                self._verified_remote_compatibility.clear()
            self._bootstrap_cache_schema_if_missing((Session, UserSession))
            self._cache.bind_planning_models(Session, UserSession)
            session_row = UserSession(
                sys_id=authenticated_session_id,
                user_id=authority.principal_user_id,
            )
            run_write_plan_workflow(
                cast("Any", self._cache),
                SyncWritePlanWorkflow(
                    session_id=SessionId.schema(),
                    build=lambda txn: txn.upsert_many_lazy(UserSession, [session_row]),
                    result_name=PlanScopeReturnName("authority_session"),
                    commit=True,
                ),
            )
            self._authority_principal_user_id = authority.principal_user_id
            self._publish_authenticated_authority(key)

    async def _acquire_async_authority_lock(self: _ReadThroughConnectionCore) -> asyncio.Lock:
        """Serialize authority work and permit nesting by the owning async task."""
        binding = _shared_async_authority_binding(self._cache)
        lock = binding.lock
        task = asyncio.current_task()
        if task is None:
            raise RuntimeError("async authority ownership requires a current task")
        if binding.owner is task:
            binding.depth += 1
            self._authority_lease_lock.acquire()
            return lock
        await lock.acquire()
        try:
            self._authority_lease_lock.acquire()
        except BaseException:
            lock.release()
            raise
        binding.owner = task
        binding.depth = 1
        return lock

    def _release_async_authority_lock(
        self: _ReadThroughConnectionCore,
        lock: asyncio.Lock,
    ) -> None:
        """Release one reentrant cross-mode async authority ownership scope."""
        binding = _shared_async_authority_binding(self._cache)
        task = asyncio.current_task()
        if task is None or binding.lock is not lock or binding.owner is not task:
            raise RuntimeError("async authority lock released by a task that does not own it")
        self._authority_lease_lock.release()
        binding.depth -= 1
        if binding.depth == 0:
            binding.owner = None
            lock.release()

    async def _bind_cache_to_current_authority_native(
        self: _ReadThroughConnectionCore,
        *,
        authority_lock: asyncio.Lock | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        """Bind an async cache to the current persistent authority lease."""
        from impl.read_through.coverage import (
            ReadThroughAuthorityLeaseRecord,
            ReadThroughAuthorityOwnedTableRecord,
            ReadThroughCachedTableRecord,
            ReadThroughCoverageRecord,
            ReadThroughLocalOverlayRecord,
            ReadThroughOwnershipProvenance,
            ReadThroughSessionBindingRecord,
            ReadThroughTableCoverageRecord,
        )
        from impl.read_through.transaction import _AsyncCacheWriteTransaction
        from impl.remote.connection import SyncRemoteIntentConnection
        from l1300_session.session import Session, UserSession
        from l2050_transaction.transaction import TransactionState

        upstream = self._upstream
        if not isinstance(upstream, SyncRemoteIntentConnection):
            return
        key = self._current_remote_authority_key()
        authority = upstream.authority_context
        authenticated_session_id = upstream.authenticated_session_id
        assert authority is not None
        if authenticated_session_id is None:
            raise RuntimeError("Remote authentication did not establish a cache session")

        lock = authority_lock or _shared_async_authority_binding(self._cache).lock
        async with _AsyncAuthorityLockScope(lock=lock, acquire=authority_lock is None):
            await self._bootstrap_cache_schema_if_missing_async(
                (ReadThroughAuthorityLeaseRecord, ReadThroughAuthorityOwnedTableRecord),
            )
            lease_id = ReadThroughAuthorityLeaseRecord.singleton_id()

            read_context = self._cache._create_read_transaction_async(SessionId.schema())
            read_txn = await read_context.__aenter__()
            try:
                existing = await resolve_terminal_async(
                    read_txn,
                    "ReadThroughConnection.authority_lease_read",
                    read_txn.select_one_lazy(
                        ReadThroughAuthorityLeaseRecord,
                        LazyResult.of(lease_id),
                    ),
                )
                owned_table_records = await resolve_terminal_async(
                    read_txn,
                    "ReadThroughConnection.authority_owned_tables_read",
                    read_txn.query_lazy(ReadThroughAuthorityOwnedTableRecord).execute_lazy(),
                )
            finally:
                await read_context.__aexit__(None, None, None)
            matches = (
                isinstance(existing, ReadThroughAuthorityLeaseRecord)
                and existing.upstream_namespace == key.upstream_namespace
                and existing.authority_namespace == key.authority_namespace
                and existing.authorization_epoch == key.authorization_epoch
                and existing.catalog_fingerprint == key.catalog_fingerprint
            )
            if matches:
                assert isinstance(existing, ReadThroughAuthorityLeaseRecord)
                renewed_lease = existing.model_copy(update={"last_authenticated_at": datetime.now(UTC)})
                renewal_context = self._cache._create_write_transaction_async(SessionId.schema())
                renewal_txn = await renewal_context.__aenter__()
                if not isinstance(renewal_txn, _AsyncCacheWriteTransaction):
                    raise RuntimeError("Internal authority renewal transaction is not async-capable")
                try:
                    await resolve_terminal_async(
                        renewal_txn,
                        "ReadThroughConnection.authority_lease_renew",
                        renewal_txn.upsert_many_lazy(ReadThroughAuthorityLeaseRecord, [renewed_lease]),
                    )
                    await renewal_txn._serverplan_commit_async()
                    renewal_txn._state = TransactionState.COMMITTED
                except BaseException as exc:
                    await renewal_txn._serverplan_rollback_async()
                    renewal_txn._state = TransactionState.ROLLED_BACK
                    await renewal_context.__aexit__(type(exc), exc, exc.__traceback__)
                    raise
                await renewal_context.__aexit__(None, None, None)
            if not matches:
                same_principal = isinstance(existing, ReadThroughAuthorityLeaseRecord) and (
                    existing.upstream_namespace == key.upstream_namespace
                    and existing.authority_namespace == key.authority_namespace
                    and existing.catalog_fingerprint == key.catalog_fingerprint
                )
                table_names = {
                    SqlTableName(get_table_name(ReadThroughCachedTableRecord)),
                    SqlTableName(get_table_name(ReadThroughAuthorityOwnedTableRecord)),
                    SqlTableName(get_table_name(ReadThroughCoverageRecord)),
                    SqlTableName(get_table_name(ReadThroughSessionBindingRecord)),
                    SqlTableName(get_table_name(ReadThroughTableCoverageRecord)),
                    SqlTableName(get_table_name(UserSession)),
                }
                preserved_tables = {
                    SqlTableName(record.table_name)
                    for record in owned_table_records
                    if record.provenance is ReadThroughOwnershipProvenance.LOCAL_OVERLAY or record.preserve_on_same_principal
                }
                table_names.update(
                    SqlTableName(record.table_name)
                    for record in owned_table_records
                    if not same_principal or SqlTableName(record.table_name) not in preserved_tables
                )
                if not same_principal:
                    table_names.add(SqlTableName(get_table_name(ReadThroughLocalOverlayRecord)))
                authority_table_list: list[SqlTableName] = []
                for table_name in sorted(table_names):
                    if await self._cache._table_exists_uncached_async(table_name):
                        authority_table_list.append(table_name)
                authority_tables = tuple(authority_table_list)
                lease = ReadThroughAuthorityLeaseRecord(
                    sys_id=lease_id,
                    upstream_namespace=key.upstream_namespace,
                    authority_namespace=key.authority_namespace,
                    authorization_epoch=key.authorization_epoch,
                    catalog_fingerprint=key.catalog_fingerprint,
                    admitted_session_id=authenticated_session_id,
                    principal_user_id=authority.principal_user_id,
                )

                write_context = self._cache._create_write_transaction_async(SessionId.schema())
                write_txn = await write_context.__aenter__()
                if not isinstance(write_txn, _AsyncCacheWriteTransaction):
                    raise RuntimeError("Internal authority replacement transaction is not async-capable")
                try:
                    for table_name in authority_tables:
                        sql_effect_result(cast("Any", write_txn), SqlDelete(SqlQuotedIdentifier(table_name)))
                    await resolve_terminal_async(
                        write_txn,
                        "ReadThroughConnection.authority_lease_replace",
                        write_txn.upsert_many_lazy(ReadThroughAuthorityLeaseRecord, [lease]),
                    )
                    await write_txn._serverplan_commit_async()
                    write_txn._state = TransactionState.COMMITTED
                except BaseException as exc:
                    await write_txn._serverplan_rollback_async()
                    write_txn._state = TransactionState.ROLLED_BACK
                    await write_context.__aexit__(type(exc), exc, exc.__traceback__)
                    raise
                await write_context.__aexit__(None, None, None)
                self._cached_tables.clear()
                if not same_principal:
                    self._local_row_overlays.clear()
                    self._tables_with_local_writes.clear()
                self._verified_remote_compatibility.clear()

            await self._bootstrap_cache_schema_if_missing_async((Session, UserSession))
            self._cache.bind_planning_models(Session, UserSession)
            session_row = UserSession(
                sys_id=authenticated_session_id,
                user_id=authority.principal_user_id,
            )

            await self._write_cache_rows_async(
                UserSession,
                [session_row],
                operation_name="authority_session_write",
            )
            self._authority_principal_user_id = authority.principal_user_id
            self._publish_authenticated_authority(key)

    async def _delete_cache_model_rows_async[T: DatabaseObjectRow](
        self: _ReadThroughConnectionCore,
        model_cls: type[T],
    ) -> None:
        """Clear physical cache rowsets without invoking source-domain versioning."""
        table_name = get_table_name(model_cls)
        names: tuple[SqlTableName, ...]
        if issubclass(model_cls, VersionedObjectRow):
            family = get_versioned_table_names(model_cls)
            names = (
                family.tip,
                family.sparse,
                family.staged,
                logged_table_name(table_name),
                field_delta_table_name(table_name),
            )
        else:
            names = (SqlTableName(table_name),)
        await self._clear_cache_internal_async(names)

    async def _write_cache_rows_async[T: DatabaseObjectRow](
        self: _ReadThroughConnectionCore,
        model_cls: type[T],
        rows: Sequence[T],
        *,
        operation_name: str,
    ) -> None:
        """Upsert internal cache rows with native async transaction ownership."""
        from impl.read_through.transaction import _AsyncCacheWriteTransaction
        from l2050_transaction.transaction import TransactionState

        context = self._cache._create_write_transaction_async(SessionId.schema())
        txn = await context.__aenter__()
        if not isinstance(txn, _AsyncCacheWriteTransaction):
            raise RuntimeError("Internal cache write transaction is not async-capable")
        try:
            await resolve_terminal_async(
                txn,
                f"ReadThroughConnection.{operation_name}",
                txn.upsert_many_lazy(model_cls, rows),
            )
            await txn._serverplan_commit_async()
            txn._state = TransactionState.COMMITTED
        except Exception as exc:
            await txn._serverplan_rollback_async()
            txn._state = TransactionState.ROLLED_BACK
            await context.__aexit__(type(exc), exc, exc.__traceback__)
            raise
        await context.__aexit__(None, None, None)

    async def _clear_cache_internal_async(
        self: _ReadThroughConnectionCore,
        table_names: Sequence[SqlTableName],
    ) -> None:
        """Clear registered cache rows through native async transactions."""
        from impl.read_through.transaction import _AsyncCacheWriteTransaction
        from l2050_transaction.transaction import TransactionState

        for table_name in table_names:
            if not await self._cache._table_exists_uncached_async(table_name):
                continue
            context = self._cache._create_write_transaction_async(SessionId.schema())
            txn = await context.__aenter__()
            if not isinstance(txn, _AsyncCacheWriteTransaction):
                raise RuntimeError("Internal cache clear transaction is not async-capable")
            try:
                await resolve_terminal_async(
                    txn,
                    "ReadThroughConnection.delete_cache_rows",
                    sql_effect_result(
                        cast("Any", txn),
                        SqlDelete(SqlQuotedIdentifier(table_name)),
                    ),
                )
                await txn._serverplan_commit_async()
                txn._state = TransactionState.COMMITTED
            except Exception as exc:
                await txn._serverplan_rollback_async()
                txn._state = TransactionState.ROLLED_BACK
                await context.__aexit__(type(exc), exc, exc.__traceback__)
                raise
            await context.__aexit__(None, None, None)

    def _cache_invalidation_tables(
        self: _ReadThroughConnectionCore,
        table_name: SqlTableName | Unset,
    ) -> tuple[SqlTableName, ...]:
        """Select cache tables for sync and async public invalidation."""
        from impl.read_through.coverage import ReadThroughCoverageRecord

        coverage_table = SqlTableName(get_table_name(ReadThroughCoverageRecord))
        if table_name is not UNSET:
            self._tables_with_local_writes.discard(table_name)
            self._local_row_overlays.pop(table_name, None)
            self._complete_prefetched_tables.discard(table_name)
            self._cached_tables.discard(table_name)
            return (table_name,)
        table_names = tuple(
            SqlTableName(name)
            for name in self._cached_tables
            if not name.startswith("sys_")
            or name == coverage_table
            or name.startswith(("sys_embedding_", "sys_fts_"))
            or name in {"sys_graph_physical_keys", "sys_graph_node_physical_keys"}
        )
        self._tables_with_local_writes.clear()
        self._local_row_overlays.clear()
        self._complete_prefetched_tables.clear()
        for selected_table in table_names:
            self._cached_tables.discard(selected_table)
        return table_names

    def _delete_snapshot_coverage(self: _ReadThroughConnectionCore, table_name: SqlTableName) -> None:
        """Delete snapshot evidence only for one logical model."""
        from impl.read_through.coverage import ReadThroughCoverageRecord
        from l2000_connection.connection_plan_workflows import SyncWritePlanWorkflow, run_write_plan_workflow

        cache = self._cache
        if not isinstance(cache, SyncDatabaseConnection):
            return
        if not cache._table_exists_uncached(SqlTableName(get_table_name(ReadThroughCoverageRecord))):
            return
        workflow: SyncWritePlanWorkflow[int] = SyncWritePlanWorkflow(
            session_id=SessionId.schema(),
            build=lambda txn: (
                txn.query_lazy(ReadThroughCoverageRecord)
                .filter(field(ReadThroughCoverageRecord.model_symbol) == str(table_name))
                .delete_lazy()
            ),
            result_name=PlanScopeReturnName("deleted_snapshot_coverage"),
            commit=True,
        )
        run_write_plan_workflow(cache, workflow)

    def _delete_persistent_local_overlay(
        self: _ReadThroughConnectionCore,
        table_name: SqlTableName,
    ) -> None:
        """Delete durable local-row markers for one invalidated model."""
        from impl.read_through.coverage import (
            ReadThroughCachedTableRecord,
            ReadThroughLocalOverlayRecord,
            ReadThroughTableCoverageRecord,
        )
        from l2000_connection.connection_plan_workflows import SyncWritePlanWorkflow, run_write_plan_workflow

        cache = self._cache
        if not isinstance(cache, SyncDatabaseConnection):
            return
        if cache._table_exists_uncached(SqlTableName(get_table_name(ReadThroughTableCoverageRecord))):
            run_write_plan_workflow(
                cache,
                SyncWritePlanWorkflow[int](
                    session_id=SessionId.schema(),
                    build=lambda txn: (
                        txn.query_lazy(ReadThroughTableCoverageRecord)
                        .filter(field(ReadThroughTableCoverageRecord.table_name) == table_name)
                        .delete_lazy()
                    ),
                    result_name=PlanScopeReturnName("deleted_table_coverage"),
                    commit=True,
                ),
            )
        if cache._table_exists_uncached(SqlTableName(get_table_name(ReadThroughLocalOverlayRecord))):
            run_write_plan_workflow(
                cache,
                SyncWritePlanWorkflow[int](
                    session_id=SessionId.schema(),
                    build=lambda txn: (
                        txn.query_lazy(ReadThroughLocalOverlayRecord)
                        .filter(field(ReadThroughLocalOverlayRecord.table_name) == table_name)
                        .delete_lazy()
                    ),
                    result_name=PlanScopeReturnName("deleted_local_overlays"),
                    commit=True,
                ),
            )
        if cache._table_exists_uncached(SqlTableName(get_table_name(ReadThroughCachedTableRecord))):
            run_write_plan_workflow(
                cache,
                SyncWritePlanWorkflow[bool](
                    session_id=SessionId.schema(),
                    build=lambda txn: txn.delete_by_id_lazy(
                        ReadThroughCachedTableRecord,
                        ReadThroughCachedTableRecord.for_table(table_name).sys_id,
                    ),
                    result_name=PlanScopeReturnName("deleted_cached_table_marker"),
                    commit=True,
                ),
            )

    def _model_cache_tables(
        self: _ReadThroughConnectionCore,
        model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]],
    ) -> tuple[SqlTableName, ...]:
        """Return every physical cache table owned by one logical model."""
        table_name = SqlTableName(get_table_name(model_cls))
        if not issubclass(model_cls, VersionedObjectRow):
            return (table_name,)
        family = get_versioned_table_names(model_cls)
        return (
            family.tip,
            family.sparse,
            family.staged,
            logged_table_name(table_name),
            field_delta_table_name(table_name),
        )

    def invalidate_model_cache(
        self: _ReadThroughConnectionCore,
        model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]],
    ) -> None:
        """Delete all physical cache rows for one logical model."""
        self._check_not_read_only(ConnectionOperationName("cache invalidation"))
        table_name = SqlTableName(get_table_name(model_cls))
        self._tables_with_local_writes.discard(table_name)
        self._local_row_overlays.pop(table_name, None)
        self._complete_prefetched_tables.discard(table_name)
        self._cached_tables.discard(str(table_name))
        self._delete_snapshot_coverage(table_name)
        self._delete_persistent_local_overlay(table_name)
        self._clear_cache_internal(self._model_cache_tables(model_cls))

        self._tables_with_local_writes.discard(table_name)

        self._complete_prefetched_tables.discard(table_name)

    def clear_cache(self: _ReadThroughConnectionCore, table_name: str | None = None) -> None:
        """Delete cached application state while preserving schema and authority infrastructure."""
        self._check_not_read_only(ConnectionOperationName("cache clear"))
        selected_table = UNSET if table_name is None else SqlTableName(table_name)
        logical_tables = (
            tuple(SqlTableName(name) for name in self._cached_tables | self._local_row_overlays.keys() if not name.startswith("sys_"))
            if selected_table is UNSET
            else (selected_table,)
        )
        for logical_table in logical_tables:
            self._delete_snapshot_coverage(logical_table)
            self._delete_persistent_local_overlay(logical_table)
        self._clear_cache_internal(self._cache_invalidation_tables(selected_table))

    async def clear_cache_async(
        self: _ReadThroughConnectionCore,
        table_name: SqlTableName,
    ) -> None:
        """Delete cached application state through native async transactions."""
        self._check_not_read_only(ConnectionOperationName("cache clear"))
        await self._delete_snapshot_coverage_async(table_name)
        await self._delete_persistent_local_overlay_async(table_name)
        await self._clear_cache_internal_async(self._cache_invalidation_tables(table_name))

    def _clear_cache_internal(
        self: _ReadThroughConnectionCore,
        table_names: Sequence[SqlTableName],
    ) -> None:
        """Clear cache state for internal consistency recovery."""
        for table_name in table_names:
            if not self._cache._table_exists_uncached(table_name):
                continue
            stmt = SqlDelete(SqlQuotedIdentifier(table_name))
            with self._cache.session(SessionId.schema()).open_write_plan() as scope:
                sql_effect_result(cast(Any, scope.txn), stmt)
                scope.commit_plan()
                from l2000_connection.connection_deferred_modules import _imp_impl_l2070_execution_context

                with _imp_impl_l2070_execution_context().explicit_plan_execution_scope():
                    scope.execute_results()

    def _mark_cache_incomplete_after_write_through_failure(self: _ReadThroughConnectionCore) -> None:
        """Invalidate local cache state after a remote-first write-through commit gap."""
        try:
            self._clear_cache_internal(tuple(SqlTableName(name) for name in self._cached_tables))
        finally:
            self._cache.invalidate_table_exists_cache()
            self._cached_tables.clear()
            self._tables_with_local_writes.clear()
            self._verified_remote_compatibility.clear()

        msg = "raw_execute() was removed from read-through connections."

    def _execute_raw_sql(
        self: _ReadThroughConnectionCore,
        sql_str: RawSqlText,
        params: SqlParamTuple,
    ) -> None:
        """Execute raw SQL on the cache only."""
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.execution_context import raise_if_sql_execution_forbidden
        from impl.common.l2200_sql_dialect.sql_connection import SyncSqlConnection

        raise_if_sql_execution_forbidden(
            operation="_execute_raw_sql",
            path=f"{type(self).__name__}._execute_raw_sql",
        )
        if isinstance(self._cache, SyncSqlConnection):
            self._cache._driver_execute(sql_str, params)
        else:
            msg = f"Cache {type(self._cache).__name__} does not support raw SQL execution"
            raise NotImplementedError(msg)

        table_name: SqlTableName,
        ids: Sequence[SysId],
        returning_columns: tuple[SqlColumnName, ...] | None = None,
    ) -> tuple[DatabaseRecord, ...]:
        """Async delete many returning. Delegates to cache backend."""
        self._check_not_read_only(ConnectionOperationName("delete"))
        self._ensure_table_cached(table_name)
        self._tables_with_local_writes.add(table_name)
        rows = await self._cache.delete_many_returning_async(
            SqlTableName(table_name),
            ids,
            returning_columns,
        )
        return tuple(rows)

    def _begin_transaction(self: _ReadThroughConnectionCore, read_only: bool = True) -> None:
        """No-op connection-level transaction hook.

        Read-through transaction objects own the underlying cache/upstream
        transactions directly. Starting a second cache transaction here causes
        schema hydration to fail when a write needs to materialize a table on
        first access.
        """
        del read_only

    def _end_transaction(self: _ReadThroughConnectionCore) -> None:
        """No-op companion to ``_begin_transaction()``."""
        return

    async def _begin_transaction_async(self: _ReadThroughConnectionCore, read_only: bool = True) -> None:
        """No-op; async transaction state is owned by read-through transaction objects."""
        del read_only

    async def _end_transaction_async(self: _ReadThroughConnectionCore) -> None:
        """No-op; async transaction state is owned by read-through transaction objects."""
        return

    def _commit(self: _ReadThroughConnectionCore) -> None:
        """No-op; commits are handled by the read-through transaction object."""
        return

    async def _commit_async(self: _ReadThroughConnectionCore) -> None:
        """No-op; commits are handled by the async read-through transaction object."""
        return

    def _rollback(self: _ReadThroughConnectionCore, *, recreate_cursor: bool = False) -> None:
        """No-op; rollbacks are handled by the read-through transaction object."""
        del recreate_cursor

    async def _rollback_async(self: _ReadThroughConnectionCore) -> None:
        """No-op; rollbacks are handled by the async read-through transaction object."""
        return

    def _create_worker_connection(self: _ReadThroughConnectionCore) -> SyncDatabaseConnection:
        """Create a new independent connection for background worker use.

        Returns:
            A new unconnected _ReadThroughConnectionCore with worker connections
            for both cache and upstream.
        """
        cache_worker = self._cache._create_worker_connection()
        assert isinstance(cache_worker, _VersionedDatabaseConnectionCore)
        upstream_worker = self._upstream._create_worker_connection()
        if not isinstance(upstream_worker, SyncDatabaseConnection):
            raise TypeError("read-through worker upstream must be a sync connection")
        assert isinstance(upstream_worker, _DatabaseConnectionCore)
        return cast(
            "SyncDatabaseConnection",
            _ReadThroughConnectionCore(
                cache=cache_worker,
                upstream=upstream_worker,
                read_only=self.read_only,
                remote_mode=self._remote_mode,
                authority_namespace=self._authority_namespace,
            ),
        )

    def _fetchone(self: _ReadThroughConnectionCore) -> DatabaseRow | None:
        """Fetch one row from cache."""
        return self._cache._fetchone()

    def _fetchall(self: _ReadThroughConnectionCore) -> tuple[DatabaseRow, ...]:
        """Fetch all rows from cache."""
        return tuple(self._cache._fetchall())

    async def _fetchone_async(self: _ReadThroughConnectionCore, cursor: object) -> DatabaseRow | None:
        """Fetch one async row from cache."""
        return await self._cache._fetchone_async(cursor)

    async def _fetchall_async(self: _ReadThroughConnectionCore, cursor: object) -> tuple[DatabaseRow, ...]:
        """Fetch all async rows from cache."""
        return tuple(await self._cache._fetchall_async(cursor))

    def _rowcount(self: _ReadThroughConnectionCore) -> int:
        """Get row count from cache."""
        return self._cache._rowcount()

    def _create_read_transaction(self: _ReadThroughConnectionCore, session_id: SessionId) -> ReadTransaction:
        """Create a read transaction that checks cache then falls through to upstream.

        Returns:
            ReadThroughSyncReadTransaction instance
        """
        from impl.read_through.transaction import ReadThroughReadTransaction

        return cast(
            ReadTransaction,
            ReadThroughReadTransaction(self, session_id),
        )

    def _create_write_transaction(self: _ReadThroughConnectionCore, session_id: SessionId) -> WriteTransaction:
        """Create a write transaction that writes to cache only.

        Returns:
            ReadThroughSyncWriteTransaction instance
        """
        self._check_not_read_only(ConnectionOperationName("write transaction"))
        from impl.read_through.transaction import ReadThroughWriteTransaction

        return cast(
            WriteTransaction,
            ReadThroughWriteTransaction(self, session_id, self._connection_id),
        )

    def _create_read_transaction_async(
        self: _ReadThroughConnectionCore,
        session_id: SessionId,
    ) -> _AsyncReadTransactionContext:
        """Create an async-compatible read-through read transaction."""
        from impl.read_through.transaction import AsyncReadThroughReadTransaction

        return cast(
            _AsyncReadTransactionContext,
            AsyncReadThroughReadTransaction(self, session_id),
        )

    def _create_write_transaction_async(
        self: _ReadThroughConnectionCore,
        session_id: SessionId,
    ) -> _AsyncWriteTransactionContext:
        """Create an async-compatible read-through write transaction."""
        self._check_not_read_only(ConnectionOperationName("write transaction"))
        from impl.read_through.transaction import AsyncReadThroughWriteTransaction

        return cast(
            _AsyncWriteTransactionContext,
            AsyncReadThroughWriteTransaction(self, session_id, self._connection_id),
        )

    def _query[T: DatabaseObjectRow](self: _ReadThroughConnectionCore, model_cls: type[T]) -> WriteQuery[T]:
        """Create a query for the given model class."""
        self._ensure_model_cached(model_cls)
        return self._cache._query(model_cls)

    async def _execute_template_with_params_async(
        self: _ReadThroughConnectionCore,
        stmt: SqlRenderable,
        params: SqlParamTuple,
    ) -> None:
        """Execute grammar statement with params on the cache only."""
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.execution_context import raise_if_sql_execution_forbidden

        del stmt, params
        raise_if_sql_execution_forbidden(
            operation="_execute_template_with_params_async",

        msg = "_execute_template_with_params_async() was removed from read-through connections."
